articleTitle: Field envelope of high contrast gratings with finite length
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The complex band structure of HCG is solved with revised couple wave theory. Further, we analytically solved the field envelope for the HCG with finite length and investigate the impact on modes' Q factors.

articleTitle: Trapped ion implementation of memory-assisted extended quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss a practical scheme to implement memory-assisted measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution protocol using trapped ion systems with the potential to extend the range of conventional QKD by a factor of 2.

articleTitle: Interaction of flying electromagnetic doughnut with nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the electromagnetic properties of the single-cycle “flying doughnut” electromagnetic permutations in the context of their interactions with nanoscale objects, such as dielectric and plasmonic nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Four-wave mixing in silicon “photonic molecule” resonators with port-selective, orthogonal supermode excitation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose coupled-cavity resonators for four-wave mixing (FWM) that support strong nonlinear interaction between distributed pump, signal and idler modes, yet allow independent coupling of these modes to separate ports. We demonstrate seeded FWM and discuss applications of such orthogonal coupling.

articleTitle: Quantum fluids of light
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This tutorial reviews recent advances in the fundamental understanding and active control of quantum fluids of light in nonlinear optical media. Perspectives in the direction of strongly correlated photon systems are outlined.

articleTitle: Idler-resonant femtosecond optical parametric oscillator with high mid-infra-red beam quality
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an idler-resonant femtosecond optical parametric oscillator (OPO) with average output power of 520 mW, repetition-rate of 80 MHz, pulse duration of 90 fs and nearly diffraction-limited beam quality at ~2.4 μm.

articleTitle: Multidimensional coherent optical photocurrent spectroscopy of a semiconductor quantum well
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new technique for Multi-Dimensional Coherent spectroscopy of nano-structures. We measure the Four-Wave Mixing (FWM) amplitude and phase via photocurrent detection. The measurement is suitable for any nano-structures that can be electrically contacted.

articleTitle: Light emission from silicon photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review some of the most promising methods for generating light in the silicon photonics context; nonlinear effects, defects, dopants and germanium alloying have all shown promise and can be enhanced using photonic crystals.

articleTitle: High spatial resolution manipulation of the nitrogen vacancy center charge state in diamond
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We showed the high resolution charge state manipulation of NV center with optical method. The result was used to detect the spin state dynamics of NV- with sub wavelength spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Electron localization in quantum cascade heterostructures due to interface roughness
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The localization of electron wavefunctions due to interface roughness in a quantum cascade heterostructures is investigated by observing the electroluminescence spectra. Localization is more prominent in heterostructures with designed extended states.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical properties of SiGe waveguides in the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure the nonlinear response of CMOS-compatible SiGe waveguides in the mid-infrared. Comparing with numerical calculations, we extract the multi-photon absorption coefficients and the induced free-carrier absorptions for wavelengths between 3µm and 5µm.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of laterally-coupled MQW-DFB lasers in optical feedback
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Characterization of third-order grating LC-MQW-DFB lasers in free-running and feedback is reported for various operation conditions. Relative to free-running, line-width reduction of >15 times is measured in optical feedback, obtaining a minimum of 10 kHz.

articleTitle: X-ray emission from laser-accelerated electrons and its use as diagnostic of laser-plasma interaction
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: X-ray radiation emitted by electrons during their acceleration in a laser-plasma accelerator was used to evidence two distincts self-injection mechanisms (longitudinal and transverse) and to identify one source of angular-momentum growth in laser-plasma accelerators.

articleTitle: Temporal characterization of emitted field from autoionization state stimulated by isolated attosecond pulse
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterized field emission from autoionization transition in atomic neon stimulated by isolated attosecond field. The spectrum of the emitted field broadens approximately 1 eV bandwidth, which corresponds to shorter than 2.5 fs-duration.

articleTitle: Investigation of quantum dot—Quantum dot coupling at high hydrostatic pressure
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We performed photoluminescence and radiative lifetime measurements of quantum dots (QDs) showing different carrier dynamic mechanisms at elevated pressures that could reveal the inter-QD coupling as the QDs spacing decreases with increasing hydrostatic pressure.

articleTitle: Single-mode hollow-core fiber for portable acetylene sub-Doppler frequency reference
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A newly-developed, single-mode hollow-core fiber is employed for saturated absorption spectroscopy in a molecular gas. Lack of surface modes, ease of angle splicing, and single-modedness make it promising for portable frequency references.

articleTitle: Statistics of decay dynamics of quantum emitters in disordered photonic-crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a statistical analysis of the spontaneous emission of quantum dots coupled to Anderson-localized cavities in disordered photonic-crystal waveguides.We observe an average Purcell factor of ~ 5 with a maximum value of 24.

articleTitle: Octave spanning coherent supercontinuum generation by 46 fs pedestal free ultrashort pulse using similariton amplifier and Er-doped fiber laser with carbon nanotube
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 46 fs, 4.0 nJ pedestal free high power ultrashort pulse was generated using Er-doped similariton amplifier seeded by nanotube fiber laser. An octave spanning coherent supercontinuum was generated in highly nonlinear normal dispersion fiber.

articleTitle: Optical preparation of stable supercooled VO2 nanocrystals: A route towards reconfigurable photonic devices for telecom wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-domain VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanocrystals in a fused silica matrix exhibit an extremely large thermally and/or optically induced hysteresis around room temperature. We demonstrate optical imprinting of persistent diffraction gratings and repetitive (> 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>) cycling through the phase transition.

articleTitle: Ultrafast non-thermal response of plasmonic resonance in gold nanoantennas
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrafast thermalization of electrons in metal nanostructures is studied by means of pump-probe spectroscopy. We track in real-time the plasmon resonsance evolution, providing a tool for understanding and controlling gold nanoantennas non-linear optical response.

articleTitle: Optofluidic bio-lasers: Bridging photonics, nanotechnology, and biology
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The optofluidic bio-laser integrates microfluidics, microcavity, and biochemically related gain medium. I will introduce the unique and advantageous characteristics of the optofluidic bio-laser, describe its current implementations, and discuss the future research and development.

articleTitle: Photon lifetime and the linewidth in a superluminal laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a theoretical analysis of the cavity lifetime of a superluminal laser. In contrast to the naive intuition, the lifetime is only slightly shorter than that of conventional lasers, facilitating ultra-sensitive sensors.

articleTitle: High-q free-standing silicon nitride micordisk vertically coupled with on-chip waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We designed and fabricated silicon nitride micordisk-waveguide vertical coupling devices processed at a low temperature of 270°. We experimentally demonstrate an intrinsic quality factor of 7.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> in the disk with only 15µm radius operating near 1310nm.

articleTitle: High fidelity, general reflection-mode coherent diffractive imaging with a tabletop EUV source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the most general, highest fidelity, reflection mode coherent diffractive imaging to date. By combining tabletop high harmonics with ptychography and keyhole coherent diffraction techniques, images are reconstructed with < 3 nm axial resolution.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal (PC) waveguide based optical filters for dense integration of high sensitivity PC biosensors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic crystal (PC) waveguide based optical filter that enables dense integration of high sensitivity L55 PC microcavities for biosensor microarrays is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Strain tuning of a quantum dot strongly coupled to a photonic crystal cavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate reversible strain-tuning of a quantum dot strongly coupled to a photonic crystal cavity. We observe a clear anti-crossing between the quantum dot and the cavity using the strain tuning technique.

articleTitle: Semiconductor nanowire induced photonic-crystal nanocavity with selectable resonant wavelength
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic-crystal nanocavity is induced by a III/V nanowire in a line defect in a Si photonic crystal with several serially-connected lattice constants. The resonant wavelength changes by moving the nanowire along the line defect.

articleTitle: Observation of high-purity single photons hopping between optical cavities
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate high-purity single photons hopping coherently between coupled optical cavities. The system shows high performance also as a controllable single-photon source, which emits single photons with a negative Wigner function.

articleTitle: InGaN quantum dots for high efficiency blue and green light emitters
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: InGaN quantum dots at high densities (~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup> dots/cm<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) are demonstrated using metalorganic chemical vapor deposition combined with post growth processing of InGaN materials. Optical and structural studies are performed to characterize InGaN quantum dots.

articleTitle: Automated single molecule nucleic acid detection with a waveguide chip
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Lambda DNA (λ-DNA) molecules were labeled with SYBR Gold nucleic acid stain using a PDMS-based programmable microfluidic chip (Automaton). Single DNA molecules were detected in a vertically integrated liquid-core waveguide chip.

articleTitle: An on-chip all silicon passive optical diode based on photonic crystal L3 cavities
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An all-silicon passive optical diode based on cascaded photonic crystal L3 cavities is demonstrated. Nonreciprocal transmission ratio of 30.8 dB and insertion loss of 8.3 dB are realized in the device.

articleTitle: Light-assisted templated self-assembly of a gold nanoparticle array
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time the assembly of an array of gold particles using a guided-resonance mode of a photonic-crystal slab. The 200nm diameter particles form a triangular lattice with spacing of 1140 nm and exhibit high stability.

articleTitle: High-fidelity heralded polarization-state transfer of a photon onto a single atom
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate heralded absorption of a single laser photon by a single trapped atomic ion, thereby mapping the photonic polarization state onto the atomic spin state with 97.9(1)% average fidelity.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency in Si3N4 nanobeam optomechanical crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate electromagnetically induced transparency in sideband-resolved Si3N4 optomechanical crystals supporting optical modes in the 980 nm band and ≈ 4 GHz mechanical resonances, in both ambient conditions and at cryogenic temperatures.

articleTitle: Surface antireflection studies of GaN nanostructures with various effective refractive index profiles
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: GaN nanostructures with various effective refractive index profiles were numerically studied as broadband omnidirectional antireflection structures for concentrator photovoltaics, as compared to that of the conventional GaN with flat surface.

articleTitle: Nonlinear fluorescence spectra unmixing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a nonlinear spectral unmixing algorithm that separates fluorescence excitation-emission matrix of multiple fluorophores affected by the inner filter effect. We evaluate this technique on simulated data and demonstrate its superior performance experimentally for a mixture of fluorophores.

articleTitle: Terahertz Cherenkov radiation from ultrafast magnetization in terbium gallium garnet
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Terahertz Cherenkov radiation from a moving pulse of ultrafast magnetization optically induced in terbium gallium garnet is experimentally observed and analyzed for the characterization of the ultrafast inverse Faraday effect.

articleTitle: Cavity optomechanics with suspended carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate large optomechanical coupling between a carbon nanotube and an optical microresonator. We measured a dominantly dissipative optomechanical coupling coefficient of g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">κ</sub> = 1 MHz/nm.

articleTitle: A WDM CMOS photonic platform for chip-to-chip optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical interconnects play a continually-increasing role in the interconnect hierarchy of high-speed digital systems. We present our vision for photonically-interconnected many-chip modules and progress toward an ultra-dense, low-power silicon photonic technology that supports this vision.

articleTitle: Channel-spacing tunable multiwavelength erbium-doped fiber laser based on a microfiber Fabry-Perot filter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tunable multiwavelength fiber laser incorporating a microfiber Fabry-Perot filter with wideband and high extinction ratio is proposed and demonstrated. By adjusting the cavity length of the filter, the channel-spacing can be continuously tuned.

articleTitle: Transverse-mode instability in high power fiber amplifiers involving thermally-induced gratings without frequency offset
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-dependent coupled-mode theory predicts transverse-mode instabilities in high power fiber amplifiers originating from thermally-induced gratings possessing a spatial phase shift with respect to a beating pattern of two transversal modes of the same frequency.

articleTitle: Two-photon three-axis digital scanned light-sheet microscopy (2P3A-DSLM)
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new two-photon scanned light-sheet microscopy with diffraction-limited thickness and tailorable illumination area from 50×50 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 500×500 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, capable of multi-scale live imaging in one setup.

articleTitle: Hotspot dynamics in current carrying WSi superconducting nanowires
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measured the temporal dynamics of optically excited hotspots in current-carrying WSi superconducting nanowires as a function of bias current, temperature and excitation wavelength, observing an unexpected effect: hotspot relaxation depends strongly on bias current.

articleTitle: Tunable diode laser absorption spectrometer for detection of hydrogen fluoride gas at ambient pressure
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a tunable diode laser absorption spectrometer (TDLAS) sensor for hydrogen fluoride (HF) detection at ambient pressure operating around the fundamental R(1) transition at 2.476 μm. We achieve 38 ppt sensitivity for 1-s integration time.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical microscopy of single monolayer molybdenum disulfide flakes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use ultrafast optical microscopy to investigate carrier dynamics in single flakes of atomically thin molybdenum disulfide. By tuning the probe wavelength through the bandgap, we reveal the influence of layer thickness on carrier dynamics.

articleTitle: In vivo photo-thermal optical coherence tomography of targeted mouse brain tumors using gold nanostars
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present structural and molecular-contrast imaging of mouse brain tumors using photo-thermal optical coherence tomography (PT-OCT) in vivo. Based on strong PT response of gold nanostars, we demonstrate clear visualization of brain cancer margins.

articleTitle: Polarization multiplexed, dual-frequency ultrashort pulse generation by a birefringent mode-locked fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two orthogonally polarized soliton pulse trains with different repetition rates are stably generated from a passively mode-locked fiber ring cavity with a section of polarization maintaining fiber. The frequency difference can be varied as well.

articleTitle: Management of the photon orbital angular momentum at small scale
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The elaboration of photonic devices enabling the control of the optical orbital angular momentum at small spatial scales remains a contemporary challenge that needs to be addressed. We will discuss recent progresses and envisioned further developments.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic integrated circuit for fast distance measurement with frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a synthetic-wavelength interferometry system on a silicon photonic chip, comprising an interferometer with tunable power splitting ratio and photodetectors. The system enables distance measurements with errors below 5 μm and acquisition times of 14 μs.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse generation using supercontinuum generated by Er-doped fiber laser with carbon nanotube
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrashort pulse generation was demonstrated by dispersion compensation of coherent high quality supercontinuum generated by ultrashort pulse fiber laser with carbon nanotube and fiber amplifier system. A 22 fs ultrashort pulse was observed by X-FROG.

articleTitle: 17.6 THz waveform synthesis by phase-locked Raman sidebands generation in HC-PCF
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the generation of a periodic train pulse waveform with 17.6THz repetition rate and ~26fs pulse duration. The waveform is generated by an all-fiber set-up consisting of hydrogen-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Doubly-resonant mid-infrared AgGaSe2 optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A doubly-resonant AgGaSe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mid-infrared optical parametric oscillator (OPO) is synchronously pumped by a hybrid 2 μm Er:fiber/Tm:fiber femtosecond mode-locked laser. The OPO produces spectra ranging from 3-5 μm. Numerical simulations confirm the observed behavior.

articleTitle: Micro-optics technology supply chain as key-enabler for applied research and industrial innovation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present our polymer micro-optics technology supply chain and its key constituents. We show how it is a key-enabler for frontier applied research and demonstrate how it paves the way towards efficient technology take-up and effective industrial innovation.

articleTitle: Simple single-shot technique for measuring the complete spatiotemporal intensity and phase of a complex ultrashort pulse
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Our simple device measures the complete spatiotemporal field of an arbitrary ultrashort pulse complex in both space and time (x, y, t). We also demonstrate a method for displaying the resulting dual plots of complex four-dimensional data.

articleTitle: Coherent VUV emission from field-controlled bound states
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a dramatic enhancement of the below-threshold harmonics in the vicinity of atomic resonances. The dependence on the driving laser carrier-envelope phase suggests a nonperturbative mechanism. Phase matching promises scalability to microJoule pulse energies.

articleTitle: Third and fifth harmonic generation in transparent solids with few optical cycle mid-infrared pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a detailed investigation of third and fifth harmonics generation with 20 fs pulses at 2 μm in CaF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> crystal, revealing a negligible contribution of higher-order Kerr terms up to intensities of 15 TW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Observation of topological structures in photonic quantum walks
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an experimental observation of topological structure in 1D photonic discrete-time quantum walks. We probe the full topological landscape demonstrating emergence of localized bound states, and existence of extremely (de)localized non-Gaussian quantum states.

articleTitle: Experimental measurement of supercontinuum second order coherence
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental measurements of second-order coherence functions of supercontinuum light. The method is based on measuring separately the quasi-coherent and quasi-stationary contributions using a combination of interferometric and nonlinear gating techniques.

articleTitle: Quantum noise limit of the white-light-cavity assisted LIGO interferometer sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the quantum noise limited sensitivity curves for the LIGO interferometer incorporating the white light cavity, which shows broadening effect and dips of opto-mechanical resonances for different values of reflectivities of the auxiliary mirror.

articleTitle: Soliton mode-locked fiber laser using a modulator-based saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel saturable absorber based on a dual-drive modulator with a feed-forward path for soliton pulse shaping. The fundamentally mode-locked laser produces 16.7-MHz repetition rate pulse train with 1.4-ps pulse width.

articleTitle: Generating ultrashort hundreds-of-keV electron bunches using radially polarized laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Particle-in-cell simulations show that quasimonoenergetic electron bunches with one-femtosecond initial duration may be produced from direct acceleration in a low-density gas. These bunches could find applications in ultrafast electron diffraction experiments.

articleTitle: Quantum dot laser two-state self-mixing velocimetry: Simulation and experiment
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Compact two-state laser self-mixing is demonstrated. A Doppler signal, originating from the two-state interaction, yields the potential of high-velocity detection. Simulations verify the results and identify the quantum-dot-states carrier coupling as the relevant mechanism for the Doppler signal generation.

articleTitle: Spin cooling via incoherent feedback in an ensemble of cold 87Rb atoms
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an experimental study of a new technique for spin cooling an ensemble of ultracold atoms via quantum non-demolition (QND) measurement and incoherent feedback. We have demonstrated 12db spin noise reduction. This technique has direct application in generating highly entangled macroscopic singlet states.

articleTitle: Extracting the complex optical conductivity of true two-dimensional layers by ellipsometry
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple and robust technique to extract the complex optical conductivity of truly two-dimensional materials is developed. Applying the method to chemical-vapor-deposited graphene, we extract the complex conductivity, including Fermi level and scattering time.

articleTitle: Suppression of spin dephasing in diamond NV centers with microwave-dressed spin states
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a spectral domain technique for suppressing the nuclear-spin-bath induced dephasing of diamond nitrogen vacancy centers by employing microwave-dressed spin states. Reduction in spin dephasing by more than 10-fold is observed.

articleTitle: Highly efficient light extraction GaN-based light emitting diode with nano-rods in micro-holes compound structure
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a high-power GaN-based light emitting diodes (LEDs) which have micro-hole array and nano-rods compound structure by nanoimprint lithography (NIL). The nanorods structure inside the micro-hole could efficiently guide the trapped light from the GaN epilayer. Therefore, the light output power of LED with micro-hole array and nanorods was as high as 1.27 times, as compared with standard LED.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of sampling phase sensitivity in baud-rate sampled coherent receiver for Nyquist Pulse-shaped high-order QAM signals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally investigate the sampling phase dependence of baud-rate sampled and equalized coherent receiver for Nyquist Pulse-shaped high-order QAM signals on the modulation format and roll-off factors.

articleTitle: Low-temperature PECVD grown carbon-rich silicon carbide saturable absorber for sub-picosecond passively mode-locked fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The low-temperature PECVD grown carbon-rich silicon carbide film with thickness of 200 nm is employed to passively mode-lock the fiber laser with pulsewidth of 510 fs and linewidth of 5.46 nm.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the stability of harmonic mode-locking in quantum dot passively mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The stability of harmonic mode-locking in a two-section quantum dot passively mode-locked laser is examined using a Frequency Resolved Optical Gating pulse measurement system and shown for the first time to be a stable effect.

articleTitle: Hindered molecular reorientation of lithium ion doped succinonitrile in the terahertz range
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The THz range permittivity of succinonitrile exhibits Debye-like behavior in its plastic-crystal phase, with a characteristic Cole-Cole relaxation time of 65ps ±17ps which increases considerably in the presence of ionic dopants.

articleTitle: Dispersion-free monochromator for selecting a single high-order harmonic beam
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a method to monochromatize high-order harmonics to isolate a single beam of harmonic radiation comprising femtosecond pulses. This novel method uses a multilayer-mirror approach, and has broadband tunability and high reflectivity in the soft-x-ray region.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in a silica spiral waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A low-loss silica spiral waveguide is used for demonstrating on-chip supercontinuum generation. The broadest measured spectrum spans an octave (936 - 1888 nm) at -50 dB from peak when 2.17 nJ pulses are launched.

articleTitle: Strong optomechanical coupling in a nanobeam cavity based on hetero optomechanical crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hetero optomechanical crystal nanobeam cavity with high mechanical frequency of 5.88 GHz is proposed. By enhancing the overlap between optical and strain field, an optomechanical coupling rate as high as 1.31 MHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Plasmonic heating and temperature-sensing in the terahertz regime - Thermometry and imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Resonant near-infrared excitation induces localized heating of colloidal gold nanorod dispersions. We show that detection and imaging are possible using Terahertz (THz) waves, which possess absorption and refractive indices sensitive to water temperature change.

articleTitle: Classical and quantum opto-mechanics with plasmonics and metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Opto-mechanical phenomena on nano-scale change balance between macroscopic forces and introduce novel quantum effects. Manipulation and control over nano-objects dynamics with plasmonics and metamaterials emphasizing radiation reaction recoil and all-optical modulation will be discussed.

articleTitle: Relation between interband dipole and momentum matrix elements in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The relation between dipole and momentum matrix elements in crystals, treated with periodic boundary conditions, is revisited. A correction term to standard expressions is found to be large for bulk GaAs, small for THz transitions.

articleTitle: Rapid scanning cavity ring-down spectroscopy at the quantum noise limit
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an ultrasensitive cavity-enhanced technique for probing weak molecular absorptions. Recently, we have implemented heterodyne detection, which allowed for quantum-noise-limited detection and noise-equivalent absorption coefficients as low as 6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−14</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>·Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1/2</sup>.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser stimulated nanosystems for neuroscience applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The development of fast and robust chemical delivery systems is important step for nanomedicine. We demonstrate on-demand, sub-second, controlled release of a neuromodulator by applying femtosecond laser pulse trains to robust, liposome structures.

articleTitle: 40-GHz analog-to-digital converter based on sampling gate of silicon waveguide with ultra-low loss and high conversion efficiency
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An ultra-low loss and high conversion efficiency silicon waveguide is used as sampling gate via four waves mixing, and 5.2 effective number of bits of signal at 40-GHz is achieved by 2-GHz cavity-less pulse source.

articleTitle: Gain compression in a quantum cascade laser: Connection between high frequency tuning and bending of LI curve
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper studies relation between high-frequency chirping of a quantum-cascade laser and the curvature of its light-current characteristic. Assuming negligible thermal backfilling and a photon lifetime of 9ps, a gain-compression effect explains both experimental observations.

articleTitle: Build-up dynamics of degenerate excitons luminescence at sub-K temperature in a trap in cuprous oxide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate time- and space-resolved luminescence measurements of quantum degenerate paraexcitons in cuprous oxide. We report dynamics of ultracold excitons such as the drift in a trap potential, cooling process, and lifetime of exctions.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared ZnGeP2-based source with 0.2 J pulse energy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Mid-infrared (3-5 μm) pulses with up to 207 mJ energy at 1 Hz repetition rate are produced using nonlinear conversion in a ZnGeP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-based master oscillator-power amplifier, pumped by a cryogenic Ho:YLF oscillator.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal coherence of GaN excitons excited by an optical vortex with multiple orbital angular momentum
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The spatiotemporal coherence of excitons is investigated by degenerate four-wavemixing using optical vortices with multiple orbital angular momentum (OAM). The OAM-resolved signal indicates that the topological phase with large OAM is robust against spatial decoherence.

articleTitle: Tensile-strained, heavily n-doped germanium-on-insulator for light emitting devices on silicon
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong direct gap light emission is obtained from germanium-on-insulator (GOI) with tensile strain of 0.16% and ultra-high n-type doping concentration up to 1.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. Microdisk resonators are also fabricated on GOI and show modulated emission spectra.

articleTitle: Generic diffusion of phase singularities
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We find generic diffusion of phase singularities in microwave speckle patterns as the frequency is scanned and in numerical simulations in the time domain. These results give the photon diffusion coefficient through the random medium.

articleTitle: High power (>3 mW) quantum cascade superluminescent emitter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report high power (>3 mW) mid-infrared superluminescent emission around 2100 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> from Quantum Cascade devices. The superluminescent emission shows a Gaussian shape spectrum with FWHM of 80 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Multiphoton imaging and manipulation of biological systems
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Through the development of simultaneous spatial and temporal focusing, platforms that can ablate tissue with excellent axial precision, and perform high-speed multiphoton imaging are converging. Recent developments in these platforms are presented.

articleTitle: High-power single-frequency, single-polarization, thulium-doped all-fiber MOPA
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a high-power single-frequency, single-polarization, thulium-doped all-fiber MOPA system. The linearly-polarized thulium-doped fiber MOPA yielded 192 W of single-frequency output at central wavelength of 2001 nm with a polarization extinction ratio of >15 dB.

articleTitle: Continuum seeded OPCPA system driven by tandem fs Yb:KGW and ps Nd:YAG lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a compact TW-class continuum seeded multistage OPCPA system operated at 800 nm and pumped by femtosecond and picosecond pulses. 35 mJ pulse energies and compression to 9 fs are demonstarated.

articleTitle: Enhanced evanescent transport and Goos-Hanchen localization in a disordered dielectric multilayer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that disorder in dielectric structures made of multiple layers of deep subwavelength thickness can induce extremely short-ranged localization. Additionally, the disorder can convert evanescent waves into bulk localized modes, enhancing transport dramatically (*10,000).

articleTitle: Autoresonant harmonic generation in nonuniform crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An experiment of second harmonic generation in a nonuniform crystal is presented, and interpreted in terms of an autoresonant wave-mixing theory. A good agreement is found between numerical simulations, analytical solutions and experimental data.

articleTitle: Polarization-entangled photons from domain-engineered, periodically poled LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a domain-engineered, periodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> grating, we investigate polarization-entangled photon-pair generation near 1550 nm wavelength using type-II spontaneous parametric down-conversion.

articleTitle: 3rd order harmonic in inverse Compton scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report observations of strong-field effects in inverse Compton scattering via its X-ray characteristics using K-, L-edge, and attenuation filters. A CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser of a<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> ≈ 0.6 is collided by a 65-MeV electron beam.

articleTitle: Pulse compression of a high-energy thin-disk laser at 100 W of average power using an Ar-filled Kagome-type HC-PCF
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compressed a high-energy SESAM-modelocked thin-disk laser using an Ar-filled Kagome-type HC-PCF: launching 41-μJ, 1.17-ps pulses directly from a 3-MHz oscillator, we obtain 179-fs pulses at 100-W of average power, reaching 80% overall compression efficiency.

articleTitle: All-optical phase-preserving amplitude regeneration using coherent nonlinear wave mixing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an all-optical tunable phase-preserving scheme for amplitude regeneration of amplitude modulated signals and phase modulated signals based on coherent optical nonlinear wave mixing using HNLF. A regeneration factor of 7 for OOK and a regeneration factor of 2.9 for BPSK are achieved.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical properties of PbSe Nano-rods: One dimensional excitons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using Supercontinuum Transient Absorption Spectroscopy we observe new ultrafast exciton dynamics in PbSe Nanorods. We report distinct types of biexcitonic interactions, and propose a model to quantitatively describe the bleach using the predicted electronic structure.

articleTitle: Superfluid helium optomechanics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By evanescently coupling a helium film to a high-Q optical resonator we make the first observation of superfluid helium Brownian motion. This new system has applications in quantum optomechanics, and in understanding superfluid helium properties.

articleTitle: Controlling rogue wave statistics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a radically new way of rogue wave control, modifying the statistical distribution of events via suitable injection of dispersive waves. This allows reducing the frequency of rogue events rather than only increasing it.

articleTitle: Scalable high-frequency silicon carbide optomechanical microresonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate silicon carbide optomechanical microresonators with mechanical frequency up to 1.7GHz, mechanical quality above 5500 and optomechanical coupling around 100GHz/nm. The frequency can match the zero-field splitting of the defect spin in silicon carbide.

articleTitle: Inducing giant nonreciprocal effects in metamolecules, metasurfaces and metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss venues to realize magnetic-free nonreciprocal integrated components based on linear and/or nonlinear metamaterials. These solutions, being based on azimuthal spatiotemporal modulation or nonlinear effects, are ideally suited for newly-developed metasurfaces with giant nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Electrically driven light emission from an atomic monolayer crystal
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report electrically driven light emission from a two-dimensional monolayer tungsten diselenide (WSe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>). Our device is operated as a lateral p-n junction diode, formed by electrostatic doping.

articleTitle: An analytical field density function for all scattering regimes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an analytical density function for field statistics that applies in all scattering regimes, providing a new framework for the study of Anderson localization, and facilitating imaging in random media and random laser design.

articleTitle: Surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) using nanopillar arrays as functional substrates and an organic semiconductor DFB laser as excitation source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an organic semiconductor distributed feedback (DFB) laser as excitation source in surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS). SERS-active substrates comprising nanopillar arrays were fabricated by the technique of laser-assisted nano-replication.

articleTitle: Characterization of a 450-km-baseline GPS carrier-phase link using an optical fiber link
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Intercontinental frequency comparisons require satellite based techniques. We characterize a GPS carrier phase link with a baseline of 450 km using a long-distance phase-stabilized optical fiber link. Active hydrogen masers at both ends are compared via the GPS link and, via optical frequency combs at both ends, through the 920 km fiber link simultaneously. This technique allows us to independently assess the instability and accuracy of the GPS link with sub 1 μ 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup> resolution.

articleTitle: Graphene as a tunable reservoir for shaping the incoherent spectrum of a quantum dot via plasmonic effects
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a realistic quantum master equation we show that the Mollow triplet of a quantum dot can be tuned by adjusting its local density of states via biasing of a graphene monolayer.

articleTitle: Cherenkov radiation from electron vortex beams
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We find the Cherenkov radiation emitted by vortex electrons, and show that a properly designed photonic waveguide can increase the angular momentum of the electrons. We calculate the selection rules in a relativistic quantum formalism.

articleTitle: Switchable optical frequency comb in aluminum nitride microring resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Aluminum nitride is a promising nonlinear optical material with its strong Kerr and Pockels effects. Here we report optical frequency comb generation from aluminum nitride microring resonators and electrical switching of the comb.

articleTitle: Two color interferences and quantum phase shifts in above threshold ionization
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The two color (ω + 2ω) above threshold ionization spectrum of argon is measured at different intensity ratios and relative optical phase. We observe quantum phase shifts between interfering ionization pathways, indicating electron dispersion in strong-field ionization.

articleTitle: Advances in industrial grade TiSa PetaWatt lasers for accelerators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review the recent results achieved on industrial grade Titanium Sapphire PetaWatt lasers demonstrating clear improvements. Key enabling technologies are presented. Perspectives towards higher peak power of 10 PW are discussed.

articleTitle: Defect-assisted sub-bandgap avalanche photodetection in interleaved carrier-depletion silicon waveguide for telecom band
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate avalanche sub bandgap detection of light at 1550 nm wavelength via surface states using the configuration of interleaved PN junctions along a silicon waveguide. The device operates in a fully depleted mode.

articleTitle: Divergence angle as a quality parameter for fiber modes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We suggest using divergence angle as a quality parameter for pure fiber modes. We demonstrate a measurement of the divergence angle of an LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>-mode and obtain agreement with numerical predictions with 2-digit precision.

articleTitle: Development of high repetition rate 0.1 – 1 TW CO2 lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Amplification of 3 ps pulses to >20GW in a 1Hz CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser MOPA chain is described. Several ways and experimental progress towards increase of the peak power for 10 μm pulses are discussed.

articleTitle: 3D optoacoustic tomography: From molecular targets in mouse models to functional imaging of breast cancer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A review of our recent works advancing three-dimensional optoacoustic tomography systems and their applications in preclinical imaging using small animal models and clinical application in diagnostic imaging of breast cancer is presented. We also discuss benefits of the latest addition of the laser ultrasound tomography to the optoacoustic imaging system. Examples of preclinical and clinical images obtained with laser optoacoustic ultrasonic imaging system (LOUIS-3D are provided and challenges of achieving further progress are outlined.

articleTitle: Stimulated Brillouin scattering threshold variations due to bend-induced birefringence in a non-polarization-maintaining fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the SBS threshold variations due to the coiling-induced birefringence in a non-polarization-maintaining fiber high power amplifier. We demonstrate that a control of the output polarization can permit higher SBS threshold operation.

articleTitle: Raman rogue waves in a long cavity passively mode-locked fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-shot spectral measurements using the dispersive Fourier transformation reveal sporadic emission of parasitic Raman pulses at the output of an ultrafast Yb-doped, all-normal dispersion fiber laser. A statistical analysis reveals rogue-wave-like extreme energy fluctuations.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generations from Au nanorods coated with nonelectrically poled NLO polymer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Second order nonlinear optical susceptibility of Au nanorods coated with nonelectrically poled NLO polymer will be presented. The SHG conversion efficiency at fully Surface Plasmon resonance was 70 times higher than that at off-resonance conditions.

articleTitle: Buffering optical data with topological localized structures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Excitable systems (known for their all or nothing and well calibrated response to external perturbations) are obvious candidates for the handling of binary data. In this contribution, we demonstrate experimentally that a semiconductor laser based excitable system placed in an optical feedback loop can act as a buffer for optical data. In the process, we demonstrate the existence and control of topological localized states in optics.

articleTitle: Filament interaction with micro-water droplets
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The interaction of a laser filament with micro-sized water droplets was studied to further understand the energy dissipation of filaments in aerosol media. The analysis of the shockwave formation allows the quantification of the energy balance during the interaction and discuss the survival of filaments in perturbed propagation media.

articleTitle: Optical magnetic mirrors using all dielectric metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the magnetic mirror behavior of all-dielectric metasurfaces at optical frequencies through phase measurements using time-domain-spectroscopy. The unique boundary conditions of magnetic mirrors can lead to advances in sensors, photodetectors and light sources.

articleTitle: Higher-order equilibrium states of temporal soliton molecules
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Bound states of fiber-optic dispersion-managed solitons are investigated. When the pulse separation is increased, a sequence of alternatingly stable and unstable equilibria arises; it terminates at a point defined by the radiation background.

articleTitle: Characterization of optical fibers supporting OAM states using fiber bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The reflectogram of a fiber grating is used to characterize vector modes of an optical fiber supporting orbital angular momentum states. All modes, with a minimal effective index separation around 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, are successfully measured.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional nanostructuring in YIG ferrite with femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated forming nanostructures inside a substrate of cerium-substituted yttrium iron garnet by means of direct laser writing. The laser irradiation increases a refractive index by 0.7% and changes magnetic properties from hard to soft.

articleTitle: Nonlinear interactions in an organic polariton condensate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an organic polariton condensate that exhibits nonlinear interactions at room-temperature. Upon reaching threshold, we observe a superlinear power dependence, a power-dependent blueshift and the emergence of long-range spatial coherence resulting from polariton interactions.

articleTitle: Space charge effects in strong-field emission from a nanostructured Si cathode
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrafast photoemission from a nanostructured Si-cathode array comprised of nano-sharp tips (~5 nm radius of curvature) was studied. Total current yield and electron spectra indicate a transition from multiphoton to strong-field emission followed by virtual cathode formation.

articleTitle: Rashba effective spin-orbit coupling in photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically and experimentally the Rashba effect using light in two “counterpropagating” photonic lattices. We observe breaking of inversion symmetry in the resulting band structure.

articleTitle: Polarization-selective coupling to long-range surface plasmon-polariton waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use plasmonic antenna arrays to unidirectionally couple incident light in two different polarization states to long-range surface plasmon polariton waveguide modes propagating in opposite directions. The structures enable polarization-sorting with extinction rates in excess of 30dB.

articleTitle: Mode structure and temporal solitons in optical microresonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Temporal dissipative solitons in microresonators constitute a novel class of ultra-short optical pulse generators. Here we study the influence of resonator mode-structure, particularly avoided mode crossings, on soliton formation and derive resonator design criteria.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared noninvasive in vivo glucose detection in healthy human subjects
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel hollow-core fiber based mid-infrared noninvasive in vivo sensor, capable of clinically accurate predictions of glucose concentrations ranging from 80 - 160 mg/dL in healthy humans, is presented.

articleTitle: Study of the interaction between multiple filaments in air
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interaction between a large number of conventional infrared filaments in air leads to the emergence over meter long distance of plasma channels one order of magnitude denser than standard filaments. Simulations reproduce well these features.

articleTitle: Low insertion loss graphene based absorption modulator on soi waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a graphene based absorption modulator on SOI waveguide with very low insertion loss. The device showed a modulation of 16 dB and an insertion loss of only 3.3dB, surpassing GeSi based absorption modulators.

articleTitle: Self-compression to sub-cycle regime in kagome hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate sub-cycle gigawatt peak power pulses self-compressed by optical shock waves in a simple manner based on gas-filled kagome hollow-core photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Anomalous light bending with high efficiency by plasmonic phase-discontinuous air-slit array
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: V-shaped air slits inscribed in a metallic thin film is used to achieve cross-polarized anomalous refraction with high efficiency. The experimental refraction angles are in excellent agreements with theoretical values.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic fields produced by self-accelerating shape-preserving electrons in free-space
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A recent experiment confirmed the 35 years old prediction of Airy-shaped electron beams that accelerate in the absence of any potential. Yet their most intriguing property remained unclear: will such electrons emit radiation in free-space?

articleTitle: A lumped michelson interferometric modulator in silicon
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the operation of a low V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>, lumped, and compact Michelson modulator fabricated in SOI. The modulator operates up to 25 Gbps with measured error free operation up to 12.5 Gbps.

articleTitle: Power-scalable and efficient geometric XUV output coupling for cavity-enhanced high-harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate cavity-enhanced HHG with a tailored transverse mode simultaneously allowing for efficient conversion to the XUV and for unparalleled output coupling efficiencies. Due to its purely geometric nature, this method is power scalable.

articleTitle: Biological lasing in liquid microdroplets deposited on a superhydrophobic surface
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate lasing in water/glycerol microdroplets which stand on a superhydrophobic surface and contain purified Venus variant of the yellow fluorescent protein or dilute suspensions of E. Coli bacterial cells expressing stably the Venus protein.

articleTitle: Graphene supercapacitor as a voltage controlled saturable absorber for femtosecond pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: For the first time to our knowledge, we employed a graphene supercapacitor as a voltage controlled saturable absorber at bias voltages of 0.5-1V to generate 84-fs pulses from a solid-state laser near 1255 nm.

articleTitle: Optimizing the surface enhanced Raman signal for accurate identification of DNA base pairs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: DNA sequencing currently lacks optical based techniques such as Raman spectroscopy. We have identified previous issues that prevented sequencing with Raman measurements and proposed a solution for base pair identification via surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy.

articleTitle: THz imaging of free carrier density based on quantum cascade lasers under optical feedback
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a detectorless THz imaging based on quantum cascade lasers operating under optical feedback to monitor the spatial distribution of free electron plasma induced onto a semiconductor by photo-excitation with a reconfigurable pattern of NIR laser pump.

articleTitle: High-power 1230-nm quantum-dot tapered external-cavity laser, with 100 nm tunability
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A quantum-dot tapered waveguide external cavity laser is presented, with 100nm tunability. At 1230nm, a maximum power of 0.62W was achieved, representing a 16-fold increase compared with equivalent narrow-ridge lasers at the same current density.

articleTitle: Effect of femtosecond laser pulse energy and repetition rate on laser induced second and third harmonic generation in corneal tissue
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a quantitative study on the effect of femtosecond laser pulse energy and repetition rate on the intensity and duration of the laser induced second and third harmonic generation in fresh corneal tissue.

articleTitle: Control of lasing modes in semiconductor microdisks by shaping pump profile
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that by optimizing the spatial pump profile we can select different modes to lase in a semiconductor microdisk cavity, and suppress lasing in all other modes by increasing their thresholds.

articleTitle: Optical transition between Stark levels in (ErSc)2O3 epitaxitial films
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Toward quantum information applications, we control the interactions between Er ions by alloying epitaxial Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> with scandium and suppress energy transfer and inhomogeneous broadening of Stark levels in the intra-4f band of Er ions.

articleTitle: Optical second-harmonic generation induced by electric current in epitaxial graphene on vicinal SiC(0001)
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We find that surface second-harmonic generation (SHG) from epitaxial graphene on a vicinal SiC(0001) substrate is enhanced ~25% by direct electric current in graphene and that the enhanced SHG varies strongly with the measurement location.

articleTitle: Passive mode locking of a diode pumped Nd:Sc0.2Y0.8SiO5 laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate passive mode-locking of a Nd:Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</sub>Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> laser using a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror. The pulse train shows output power of 0.5 W and pulse duration of 3.5 ps at repetition rate of 118 MHz.

articleTitle: A two-octave broadband quasi-continuous mid-infrared supercontinuum generated in a chalcogenide glass waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have produced a stable 10mW, mid-infrared supercontinuum spanning the full functional group band from 1750nm to >7000nm spanning using a 1cm long chalcogenide waveguide pumped by a 20MHz train of 320fs pulses at 4μm.

articleTitle: Integrated Yb:fiber laser frequency comb with three photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a near all-fiber femtosecond Yb:laser frequency comb incorporated with three different photonic crystal fibers. The comb removes most of free-space components so that it is more compact and stable.

articleTitle: Contrast enhancements to petawatt lasers using picosecond optical parametric amplification and frequency doubling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nanosecond contrast of the Orion CPA beamlines is enhanced from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−10</sup> by inserting a picosecond OPA prior to the stretcher. In conjunction with frequency doubling post-compression this will enhance the contrast to ∼10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−18</sup>.

articleTitle: In vivo molecular imaging using Cerenkov luminescence
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Many radionuclides, upon decay, produce visible light via the Cerenkov effect. This allows radiotracers to be imaged using sensitive optical technologies providing opportunities for in vivo optical molecular imaging using Cerenkov luminescence.

articleTitle: PT symmetric large area single mode DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel class of large-area single-mode semiconductor lasers in which notions from parity-time symmetry is employed to reliably suppress higher-order modes. The feasibility of our design is investigated in InGaAsP quantum-well arrangements.

articleTitle: Emission and expansion features of ns and fs laser ablation plumes in an ambient environment
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated the emission and hydrodynamic expansion dynamics of ns and fs laser ablated metal plasmas in the presence of an ambient with pressures ranging from vacuum to atmospheric levels. The role of background pressure on spectral emission features, absolute line intensities, signal to background ratios, plume hydrodynamics, and ablation craters were studied. The structure and dynamics of both ns and fs plumes obtained from optical diagnostic tools were compared to continuum hydrodynamic model (CFD) results.

articleTitle: Investigation of hot photons in GaN/AlN high electron mobility transistor based on Stokes Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated hot phonons based on Stokes Raman scattering from a GaN/AlN high electron mobility transistor. Such a simple method is advantageous compared with the method based on Stokes and anti-Stokes Raman scattering.

articleTitle: Broad-bandwidth, high-efficiency adiabatic second-harmonic generation in chirped quasi-phase-matching gratings
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Second-harmonic generation of ultrashort pulses in the sufficiently chirped quasi-phase-matching (QPM) gratings is shown to obtain conversion efficiency approaching 100% with increasing pump intensities, and the wide bandwidth of the pulses is also preserved.

articleTitle: Broadband microresonator-based parametric frequency comb near visible wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate broadband frequency comb generation spanning over 700 nm from 830 to 1540 nm in a dispersion-engineered Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> microresonator. To our knowledge, this is the broadest parametric comb generated near the visible wavelength range.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared opto-nanofluidics for label-free on-chip sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A mid-infrared (mid-IR) label-free chemical sensor was developed using opto-nanofluidics consisting of a Si-liquid-Si slot-structure. A broadband mid-IR lightwave can be strongly confined within a nanofluidic capillary by utilizing the large refractive index contrast (?n ∼ 2) between the liquid core waveguide and the Si cladding. Through an optical-field enhancement together with a direct interaction between the probe light and the analyte, the sensitivity for chemical detection is increased by 50 times when compared to evanescent-wave sensing. This spectral characterization distinguished several common organic liquids (e.g., n-bromohexane, toluene, isopropanol) accurately, and could determine the ratio of chemical species (e.g., acetonitrile and ethanol) at low concentration (< 5 µL/mL) in a mixture through spectral scanning over their characteristic mid-IR absorption peaks. The combination of CMOS-compatible planar mid-IR microphotonics, and a high-throughput nanofluidic sensor system, provides a unique platform for chemical detection.

articleTitle: Beam focalization by chirped mirrors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel application of chirped dielectric mirrors for narrow beam focalization is proposed and demonstrated numerically and experimentally. Analogy to temporal dispersion compensation by chirped dielectric mirrors is discussed.

articleTitle: Mode-locking of a diode-pumped Yb:CLNGG laser using single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A diode-pumped Yb:CLNGG laser is mode-locked with a single-walled carbon nanotube saturable absorber achieving pulse durations as short as 90 fs at ~1049 nm and maximum average output power of 90 mW at 83 MHz.

articleTitle: Using nonlinear optical networks for optimization: primer of the ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using nonlinear Erbium doped optical fiber network we have implemented an optimization algorithm for the famous problem of finding the shortest path on the map for the ant colony to travel to the foraging area.

articleTitle: Laser-induced dispersion control
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present pump-probe measurements that reveal significant changes in the group delay dispersion of a femtosecond laser pulse being controlled by the relative delay between two pulses. We suggest applications for this time-domain shaping approach.

articleTitle: Strong coupling of surface plasmons to dye molecules: Tailoring dispersion and beyond
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In the presence of dye molecules, the dispersion curve of SPPs splits into three branches and demonstrates the avoided crossing characteristic of strong coupling. It is further modified by the optical gain in the system.

articleTitle: Method for Bi-directional conversion between fundamental Gaussian beams and spatially polarized beams using a spatial light modulator
