publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a method for bi-directional conversion between fundamental Gaussian beams and spatially polarized beams using a spatial light modulator with angular sliced phase pattern.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in hydrogenated amorphous silicon waveguides in the femtosecond regime
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Supercontinuum generation in CMOS compatible hydrogenated amorphous silicon waveguides with femtosecond pulses at telecommunication wavelengths is experimentally studied. It is shown that stable 540 nm broad supercontinua can be obtained in 1 cm-long waveguides.

articleTitle: Controlling quantum dot energies using submonolayer bandstructure engineering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate control of energy states in epitaxially-grown sub-monolayer quantum dots by engineering of the internal bandstructure of the dots. We show shifts of the quantum dot ground state energy from 1.38eV to 1.68eV.

articleTitle: Optical phase imaging using a synthetic aperture phase retrieval technique
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We perform quantitative phase imaging using phase retrieval to implement synthetic aperture imaging. Compared to digital holography, the developed technique is simpler, less expensive, and more stable.

articleTitle: Reservoir-assisted coherent control of a quantum dot spin
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical coherent manipulation of a quantum dot spin through coherent population trapping with a sub-linewidth spin splitting, enabled by the hyperfine interaction with a mesoscopic nuclear spin ensemble.

articleTitle: Metamaterial composite with an ultra-broadband usable range of over 25 terahertz
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a metamaterial composite, we demonstrate a bandpass filter that has only a single transmission mode from 0 to >25 THz. This usable bandwidth matches, or exceeds, that of currently used THz sources.

articleTitle: Shaping the future of biophotonics: imaging and manipulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This talk will describe the use of the generation, use and advantages of complex light fields for applications in light sheet imaging, targeted cell transfection and manipulation.

articleTitle: A technique to measure the correlation of optical frequencies using four-wave mixing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel technique to measure the correlation between two optical frequencies using a FWM scheme. To verify, we measure the evolution of de-correlation as a function of the path length difference between them.

articleTitle: Experimental Huygens' surface for NIR wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Huygens' surface that efficiently refracts normally incident light to an angle φ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> = 35° at telecommunication wavelengths is reported. This represents the first experimental demonstration of an isotropic metasurface that provides wavefront control for arbitrarily polarized light.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse mode-locking from a normal-dispersion on-chip Kerr frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband Kerr frequency comb and mode-locking in a globally-normal-dispersion microresonator. A record short on-chip pulse of 74-fs is directly measured. Supported by analytical theory and numerical modeling, we describe the mode-locking mechanism.

articleTitle: All-fiber optical parametric amplifier for life-science application
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an all-fiber optical parametric amplifier for life-science (OPALS) application. Optical amplification of megahertz serial time-encoded amplified microscopy (STEAM) images with a resolution of less than 2 μm is achieved with a 20-dB gain.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser-induced volume gratings in lithium niobate for noncollinear second-harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Noncollinear second-harmonic generation is induced by a volume grating which is directly written into a lithium niobate wafer by femtosecond laser pulses. The efficiency can be increased by Bragg matching of the fundamental wave.

articleTitle: Optical SSB modulation scheme based on phase-modulator and vertical-cavity-surface-emitting laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel optical single sideband (OSSB) modulation scheme is proposed based on a phase-modulator (PM) and a tunable optical band pass filter (TOBPF) composed by a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) and an optical circulator (OC).

articleTitle: Non-paraxial acceleration and rotation in curved surfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present non-paraxial shape-preserving accelerating electromagnetic wavepackets propagating in micro-sized curved surfaces, revealing exotic trajectories and polarization rotation dynamics caused by the interplay of interference effects and the curvature of space.

articleTitle: Approaching the atomic unit of time with isolated attosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Isolated attosecond pulses are powerful tools for studying electron dynamics in atoms, molecules and condensed matter. The shortest pulses achieved so far are 67 as. Challenges and approaches for further shortening such pulses are introduced.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength confinement in metamaterial filled-slot waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study a metamaterial-based optical waveguide formed by a silica-filled slot in a layered metal-dielectric slab. This geometry results in very strong confinement of a quasi-TE fundamental mode and gives smaller propagation losses than a purely metallic slot waveguide.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared GaN/AlxGa1−xN Quantum Cascade detectors grown by MOCVD
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A III-nitride-based Quantum Cascade detector grown by MOCVD is designed, fabricated and tested. Peak responsivity of 100 µA/W with detectivity of up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> Jones at ∼ 4 µm is measured.

articleTitle: Lab-on-chip silicon nitride microring sensor at visiblewavelength using glycoprotein receptors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A full biosensor system based on referenced and spectrally multiplexed arrays of silicon nitride microrings with glycoprotein receptors is demonstrated. Underlying system design guidelines and fundamental noise limits of the device are discussed.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of surface plasmon vortices with arbitrarily synthesized intensity patterns
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Surface plasmon vortices with arbitrary pattern are synthesized via geometrical designs. The resulting vortex intensity patterns are experimentally measured using a near-field scanning optical microscope and are in good agreements as compared to numerical results.

articleTitle: Nonparaxial Bessel-like beams following curved trajectories
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new class of nonparaxial optical beams with a Bessel-like profile that are capable to laterally shift along fairly arbitrary trajectories during propagation in free space. Numerical simulations confirm our theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Modifying the coherence properties of microresonator combs with feedback loop filtering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The coherence properties of a frequency comb generated by a SiN microring resonator is shown to be changed by the feedback through a self tracking, narrowband single longitudinal mode filter in an active fiber loop.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope phase sensitive strong-field photoemission from plasmonic nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong-field photoemission from plasmonic nanoparticles is demonstrated on the surface of a chip under ambient conditions. The photoemission shows a carrier-envelope phase-sensitive component with a 27 dB signal-to-noise ratio at a 0.78 Hz resolution bandwidth.

articleTitle: L3 photonic crystal nanocavities with measured Q-factor exceeding one million
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate ultra-high quality factors (Q = 1.45×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) in evolutionary optimized 2D L3 photonic crystal nanocavities fabricated in Si slabs. Together with ultra-small effective mode volumes ~ 0.96(λ/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, such a nanocavity offers a new platform in future integrated nanophotonics.

articleTitle: Development of entangled photon pair sources based on birefringent structures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe an in-line source of polarisation entangled photons, based on four-wave mixing in birefringent optical fibre. We also discuss the prospect of implementing this scheme in a birefringent, laser-written waveguide on a chip.

articleTitle: High power 20GHz photodiodes with microwave tuning circuits
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Modified uni-travelling-carrier (MUTC) photodiodes (PDs) with microwave open and shorted stubs having RF output power (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">RF_out</inf>) of 23 dBm and 21.6 dBm, respectively, at 20 GHz are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Single source 5-dimensional (space-, wavelength-, time-, polarization-, quadrature-) 43 Tbit/s data transmission of 6 SDM × 6 WDM × 1.2 Tbit/s Nyquist-OTDM-PDM-QPSK
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 43-Tbit/s transmission over 67.4-km seven-core fiber using a single source. Each of the 6 outer cores carries 6 Nyquist-WDM channels using 320-Gbaud Nyquist-OTDM-PDM-QPSK 330-GHz spaced, and the center core carries 10-GHz clock pulses.

articleTitle: Optics-free kagome fiber-aided laser micro-machining
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on focus-optics free laser micro-processing of several materials using up to milli-joule energy-level fs-pulses directly delivered by 10m-long hypocycloid-core kagome HC-PCFs. The ablation rate and depth were studied showing high-precision drilling.

articleTitle: 31 nJ sub-200 fs pulse generation from an Erbium-doped fiber amplifier similariton oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the highest femtosecond pulse energy from Erbium-doped fiber similariton or dissipative soliton oscillators (to our best knowledge). The output spectrum can be manipulated by waveplates and filter to support 86 fs transform-limited pulse.

articleTitle: Plasmon-enhanced third-order harmonic generation in plasmonic-organic photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present theoretical and experimental analysis of extraordinary third-order harmonic generation (THG) by organic materials on a plasmonic photonic crystal. The measurement shows that the hybrid nanostructure platform provides over 20 times enhancement in THG efficiency.

articleTitle: Transparent displays enabled by resonant nanoparticle scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We create a transparent display by projecting monochromatic images onto a polymer film embedded with nanoparticles that selectively scatter light at the projected wavelength. This approach features simplicity, wide viewing angle, scalability, and low cost.

articleTitle: Regenerative amplification of ultrashort pulses at 2µm with a Thulium-doped YAP crystal
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Seed pulses at nJ-level of a fiber-based pre-amplified Thulium oscillator are amplified to µJ-level at 1 kHz repetition rate in a regenerative amplifier based on a Thulium-doped YAP crystal with 355 fs compressed pulse duration.

articleTitle: Photonic topological insulators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review the recent progress on the first experimental demonstration of photonic topological insulators, along with a variety of new ideas associated with it.

articleTitle: CEP-stable, multi-mJ, 4.3 fs pulses from long stretched flexible hollow fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: CEP-stable 4.3fs pulses of 3mJ energy were generated by spectral broadening of circularly polarized 8mJ pulses in a differentially pumped 2-m-long hollow fiber. The pulses were characterized by a single-shot SHG FROG.

articleTitle: Simultaneous broadening of the depleted pump and signal from an optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optical parametric amplifier signal and its unconverted pump are studied as a method of waveform synthesis. Generating broad spectra with self phase modulation to create coherent multi-octave CEP stabilized pulses is discussed.

articleTitle: Exciton dynamics in conducting polymer polyaniline using ultrafast spin-polarized spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The non-equilibrium charge dynamics in conducting polymer polyaniline (PANI) have been barely understood. Utilizing ultrafast spin-resolved spectroscopy, we show that the charge dynamics in PANI is dominated by the excitonic photoresponse.

articleTitle: Highly efficient eigenstate-assisted long-distance quantum state transfer in photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new perfect state transfer protocol based on single-photon W-eigenstates of photonic lattices. Such W-eigenstates appear as impulse response of the system, e.g., when single photons are launched into single sites.

articleTitle: Polarization cross-coupling between microring and bus waveguide in double-layer SOI
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate polarization cross-coupling between modes of microring resonators and waveguides due to structural asymmetries. We experimentally demonstrate the coupling between a double-layer SOI waveguide fundamental TM mode and microring higher-order radial TE modes.

articleTitle: Photothermal heating enabled by plasmonic nanoantennas for electrokinetic manipulation and sorting of submicron particles
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The photo-induced collective heating enabled by a plasmonic nanoantenna array is for the first time harnessed for rapid concentration, manipulation and sorting of particles, with high throughput. This work could find application in biosensing, and surface enhanced spectroscopies.

articleTitle: A novel method to acquire ring-down interferograms using a double-looped mach-zehnder interferometer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel, simple and cost-effective method to acquire ring-down interferograms based on a double-looped Mach-Zehnder interferometer requiring only a few millimeters of scanning range. Internal loss characterization of two loops is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhanced spectral broadening and beam collimation from pulse-sequence induced filamentation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Filaments in air, induced by pulse trains of four ultrashort pulses, each separated by the rotational revival time of nitrogen exhibit an increased degree of spectral broadening and collimation over the single pulse filament case.

articleTitle: Infrared signal detection by upconversion technique
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated up-conversion assisted detection of a 2.05-µm signal by using a bulk periodically poled Lithium niobate crystal. The 94% intrinsic up-conversion efficiency and 22.58% overall detection efficiency at pW level of 2.05-µm was achieved.

articleTitle: Optical coherence imaging of microvascular oxygenation and hemodynamics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here, we present high-speed spectral domain OCT in the visible spectral range using a supercontinuum source that performs angiography, oximetry, and speed assessment of red blood cells in individual vessels of the mouse pinna in vivo.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation of ultrafast interaction between THz fields and crystalline materials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a quantum-mechanical molecular dynamics investigation of the interaction between strong single-cycle THz pulses and ionic crystals. We find nonlinearities in the response of the CsI crystals at field strengths higher than 10 MV/cm.

articleTitle: Effect of quantum confinement in Si-QD on free-carrier modulation bandwidth and cross-section of the SiOx:Si-QD waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The free-carrier cross-section of Si-QD is decreased from 5.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-17</sup> to 9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-18</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with shortened lifetime from 10 to 0.48 μs when shrinking Si-QD size from 4.3 to 1.7 nm due to the quantum confinement effect.

articleTitle: 3D optical invisibility cloak in the diffusive-light limit
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design, fabricate, and characterize three-dimensional macroscopic free-space omnidirectional polarization-independent visible-wavelength broad-bandwidth invisibility cloaks in the diffusive limit of light propagation. The simple core-shell geometries are inspired by near-field optics.

articleTitle: Ultrathin transmission visible spectrum filters with wide viewing angle
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report high angular tolerant transmission visible spectrum filters exploiting strong resonance behaviors in an ultrathin semiconductor layer between two metals. The angle robust property remains over a wide incident angular range up to ±70°.

articleTitle: High performance excited-state nanostructure lasers—Modulation response, frequency chirp and linewidth enhancement factor
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Excited-state lasing in quantum dot lasers is theoretically demonstrated to exhibit a broader modulation response, lower chirp-to-power ratio, and smaller linewidth enhancement factor in comparison with the conventional lasing in the ground state.

articleTitle: A high power directly diode pumped Ti:sapphire laser with synchronized Yb-fiber amplifier for nonlinear optical microscopy and optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple scheme of a compact femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser with synchronized Yb-fiber amplifier pumped by a powerful single tapered diode laser implemented in a combined coherent Anti-Stokes Raman and optical coherence tomography platform is presented.

articleTitle: Asymmetric heterogeneously integrated InP microdisk lasers on Si for optical interconnect and optical logic
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss properties and applications of heterogeneously integrated microdisk lasers coupled to an asymmetrically reflecting bus waveguide. Specific properties of interest for optical interconnect are unidirectionality and sensitivity to external feedback. We also discuss the application of such lasers for low power all-optical signal regeneration.

articleTitle: Double heterostructure AlGaAs/GaAs W-shaped waveguide Mach-Zehnder intensity modulator for 780 nm lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An integrated Mach-Zehnder intensity modulator for laser radiation at the wavelength 780 nm is demonstrated for the first time. The device features a double heterostructure GaAs/AlGaAs electro-optic phase modulator. The estimated insertion loss is less than 2.5 dB and the extinction ratio is 3.3 dB.

articleTitle: QCL based absorption sensor for simultaneous trace-gas detection of CH4 and N2O
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A quantum cascade laser (QCL) absorption sensor system operating at 7.83 µm was developed for simultaneous dual-species monitoring of CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O using a novel compact multipass gas absorption cell with a sampling volume of 225 mL.

articleTitle: Measuring coherence dynamics of methanol using transient coherent spontaneous Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the measurement of vibrational state coherence dynamics in liquid methanol using transient coherent spontaneous Raman scattering. The resulting lifetimes and quantum beat frequency agree with frequency-domain and coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering measurements.

articleTitle: THG of ZnO nanorods for efficient third order interferometric FROG
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Efficient third harmonic generation was found in ZnO nanorod layers grown by phase transport and low temperature chemical bath deposition method. Interferometric frequency-resolved optical gating of few cycle fs pulses was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nonlocal response in transition metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate resonant enhancement of light in transition metamaterials under the local and nonlocal response function approximations, and analyze the influence of nonlocality on the field distribution in the near-zero region.

articleTitle: High repetition rate kJ-class nanosecond to femtosecond lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using novel liquid cooled slab laser amplifier technology we have developed laser systems capable of amplifying nanosecond laser pulses to energy of ~1 kJ at repetition rate up to 0.1 Hz. The design and performance of these liquid cooled amplifiers at 18 cm aperture will be described along with plans to scale this technology to larger aperture and higher repetition rate.

articleTitle: Terahertz carrier dynamics in graphene and graphene nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photoexcited charge carriers in 2D graphene and in 1D graphene nanostructures were studied with optical pump-THz probe spectroscopy. We find efficient hot-carrier multiplication in 2D graphene, and predominantly free carrier early-time response in 1D nanostructures.

articleTitle: Q-switched fiber laser with MoS2 saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-based saturable absorber is fabricated using wet chemistry techniques. We use it to passively Q-switch a fiber laser at 1068 nm.

articleTitle: Extraordinary transmission-inspired dual-band THz quarter-wave plate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a very compact metasurface that works as a quarter-wave plate at two different frequencies, 1 THz and 2.2 THz. The fractional bandwidth of the first band is remarkably 32.2%, beyond the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser processing for mobile display manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The development of new display technologies, such as organic LEDs and flexible displays, put stringent requirements in terms of manufacturing processes. We report on new results aiming at improving processing quality and yield.

articleTitle: Laser Additive Manufacturing LAM - Fundamentals of Selective Laser Melting SLM and Laser Material Deposition LMD
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: With Additive Manufacturing AM, parts can be manufactured for design instead of being designed for manufacture. This tutorial introduces the two laser based AM processes, Selective Laser Melting SLM and Laser Material Deposition LMD.

articleTitle: Control of chemical reactions in the vicinity of hyperbolic metamaterials and metallic surfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that photo-oxidation of organic semiconducting films can be controlled by geometry and composition of metallic and metal/dielectric substrates, in agreement with increase of the chemical reaction rate by the density of photonic states.

articleTitle: High-temperature flow sensing using regenerated gratings in self-heated high attenuation fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a high-temperature flow sensing technique based on thermally regenerated fiber Bragg gratings in high attenuation fibers. It can provide flow rate measurements up to 800 °C with compensation for ambient temperature variations.

articleTitle: Tunable Raman soliton self-frequency shift via an asymmetric Airy pulse
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study soliton self-frequency shift initiated by an Airy pulse in an optical fiber. The asymmetric features associated with the pulse exhibiting leading or trailing oscillatory tails are revealed through the effect of Raman scattering.

articleTitle: High gain frequency domain optical parametric amplifier (FOPA) preserves ps pulse contrast
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 800nm, nJ level pulses are amplified >2.000 times in a single 2mm BBO crystal, pumped by picosecond 400nm pulses. Experiments evidence that the picosecond pulse contrast within the pump window remains unchanged upon amplification.

articleTitle: Graphene metadevices and metamaterials for linear and nonlinear THz applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Graphene metadevices and metamaterials are promising especially for the control of THz waves. Among various possible functional devices and materials, THz graphene memory metadevices and THz graphene metamaterial saturable absorbers are introduced as illustrative examples.

articleTitle: Broadly tunable single-mode slot quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Broadly tunable single-mode quantum cascade laser at ∼10 µm with a monolithically integrated two-section slot structure is presented. The device shows ∼80 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> tuning range and ∼20 dB side mode suppression ratio by adjusting the currents and temperature.

articleTitle: Observation of visible-wavelength electric and magnetic resonances on silicon nanorods
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricated silicon nanorods on silica substrates, and show that they support electric and magnetic resonances by simulation and experiment. Due to these resonances, the nanorods appear vivid colors when observed by optical microscopy.

articleTitle: Pulse energy scaling of modelocked oscillators: Moving from 80 µJ to >100 µJ from SESAM-modelocked thin disk lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An Yb:YAG SESAM-modelocked thin-disk laser delivering 1.07 ps pulses with record-high pulse energy of 80 μJ at 242 W of average power is presented. Improved SESAM designs and nonlinearity limits are explored towards multi-100 μJ modelocked oscillators.

articleTitle: Recent progress in near-infrared vertical external cavity surface emitting laser (VECSEL) grown by metal organic vapour phase epitaxy (MOVPE)
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Summary form only given. The application of a specific metal organice vapour phase epitaxy (MOVPE) growth process for (GaIn)As-based VECSEL using thermally more efficiently decomposing MO-group-V-sources results in an extended wavelength range and facilitates the necessary strain compensation of the highly compressive-strained (GaIn)As-quantum well layers by tensile-strained Ga(PAs) barrier layers. Applying a closed-loop-design concept of detailed microscopic modelling and experimental realization as well as laser characterization allows for an efficient optimization of these complex laser devices. Recent developments for the realization of high-power VECSEL with continuous wave (cw) output powers in excess of 100 W will be presented and discussed. The detailed understanding of the mounting technology as well as the optimization of the thermal resistance of the VECSEL-structures is of key importance to achieving these output characteristics. Besides cw high output power operation these VECSEL device structures form also the basis for improved femto-second pulse, mode-locked VECSEL-structures [6, 7].

articleTitle: Recent advancements of strained silicon as an optically nonlinear material
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present several improvements to the understanding of strained silicon's second-order optical nonlinearity. In addition to incorporating the material into electro-optic modulators and wave-mixers, we analyze the nature of the optical nonlinearity on the nanoscale.

articleTitle: Optimizing birefringence of polarization-maintaining photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a theoretical and experimental investigation to demonstrate that the birefringence of a commercial polarization-maintaining photonic crystal fiber (PMPCF) can be enhanced almost one order of magnitude by scaling its diameter down to ~50 μm.

articleTitle: Measuring the local environment of a quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a survey of the solid state environment of a quantum dot utilizing resonance fluorescence as a sensitive probe. Nuclear field fluctuations are identified with 10µs correlation times by comparison to a theoretical model.

articleTitle: Control of the emitted polarization in a 1310 nm spin-VCSEL subject to circularly polarized optical injection
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first optical injection experiment on a dilute nitride 1300 nm spin-VCSEL at room temperature. Effective control of the polarization of the light emitted by the spin-VCSEL is theoretically predicted and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Directional emission from quantum dots in a hyperbolic metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Directional light extraction from high-k modes in a hyperbolic metamaterial (HMM) is demonstrated by direct coupling of resonance cones from quantum dots (QDs) underneath a metal-dielectric composite to a high index bulls-eye grating structure.

articleTitle: Modulated beating signal generation via bias modulations of micro-heaters integrated on dual-mode laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple and compact method of generating modulated beating signals from a dual-mode laser via bias modulation of integrated micro-heaters is proposed and successfully demonstrated. The proposed scheme will enrich the continuous-wave terahertz system applications.

articleTitle: Growth of device-quality orientation-patterned gallium phosphide (OP-GaP) by improved hydride vapour phase epitaxy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Substantial increases in substrate temperature, super-saturation, and V/III ratio have dramatically improved vertical domain propagation during hydride vapour phase epitaxy of orientation-patterned gallium phosphide, leading to device-quality quasi-phasematched layer thicknesses exceeding 400 microns.

articleTitle: Indirect excitons in high magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transport, relaxation, and correlation effects are observed for indirect excitons in high magnetic fields.

articleTitle: Surface-enhanced raman scattering immuno-assay using diatom frustules
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An immunoassay based on surface-enhanced Raman scattering has been developed using diatom frustules to detect antigens with high sensitivity. It was found that the diatom frustules provide 6× higher sensitivity than traditional glass substrates.

articleTitle: Optical time-stretch microscopy using Bessel spectral shower illumination
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate optical time-stretch microscopy with one-dimensional Bessel spectral shower illumination for ultrafast extended depth-of-field imaging at a single-shot scan rate of 26.3 MHz.

articleTitle: High power single frequency 1014.8 nm Yb-doped fiber amplifier and frequency quadrupling to 253.7 nm
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 19 W linearly-polarized single-frequency 1014.8 nm fiber amplifier working at room temperature is developed. Both absorption and saturated absorption spectra of atomic mercury are measured with this radiation after frequency quadrupling to 253.7 nm.

articleTitle: 52-mJ, kHz-Nd:YAG laser with diffraction limited output
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present Nd:YAG, diode pumped amplifier system emitting up to 52-mJ pulse energy with 1.6-ns pulse duration and near diffraction limited beam, operating at 0.75-kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Optical Anderson localized modes switched electronically
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Electronic on-off switching control over optical Anderson localized modes is demonstrated for the first time, using a lithographically-fabricated CMOS-compatible silicon photonic waveguide infiltrated by about 100 sub-micron-scale p-n junction diodes.

articleTitle: Excellent color rendering index quantum dots white light-emitting diode with distributed bragg reflector structure
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This study demonstrated the high CRI and excellent uniformity colloidal quantum dot white-light-emitting diodes with the DBR structure at different correlated color temperature from 2500 K to 4500K.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared plasmonic inductors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Expanding ideas from microwaves, we demonstrate experimentally a terahertz inductor by using meander-lines in a canonical extraordinary transmission (ET) hole array leading to a strong resonance's redshift and an unprecedented enlargement of the operation bandwidth.

articleTitle: Monolithic Fan-out PPMgSLT device for cascaded 355nm generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Monolithic fan-out periodically-poled MgO doped near stoichiometric LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3 (</sub>PPMgSLT) device is demonstrated to generate third harmonic generation from 1064nm laser. By integrating single and fan-out quasi phase matching (QPM) structures into one device, 100mW of third harmonic was obtained without any critical tunings.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of optical nonlocalities in metal-dielectric multilayer metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The optical nonlocalities in metal-dielectric multilayer metamaterials are characterized as functions of incident angles for different polarizations. The measured epsilon-near-zero frequency shifts due to nonlocal effects agree with the theoretical analysis developed from transfer-matrix method.

articleTitle: Wide dynamic range sensing in photonic crystal microcavity biosensors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Typical L-type photonic crystal (PC) microcavities have a dynamic range of approximately 3-4 orders of magnitude in biosensing. We experimentally demonstrated that multiplexing of PC sensors with different geometry can achieve a wide dynamic range covering 6 orders of magnitude with potential for 8 or more orders with suitable optimization.

articleTitle: 650-km fiber link for optical frequency dissemination and remote clocks comparison in Italy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We realized a 650-km optical fiber link in Italy for frequency dissemination and remote clocks comparison. We present its implementation and characterization at the 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-19</sup> uncertainty level, discussing its future applications.

articleTitle: Relevance of the transversal phase-matching in high-order harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically and experimentally the relevance of the transversal coherence length in high-order harmonic generation (HHG). We present results in which transversal phase matching plays the leading role in the macroscopic HHG.

articleTitle: State of the art optical materials for lithographic systems for semiconductor manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 193 nm lithography has enabled semiconductor manufacturing to achieve nm resolution. Highest quality optical materials and optics are an essential part of this. Important optical properties of and test methods for these materials will be reported.

articleTitle: Optical beat noise suppression in OFDMA PON uplink transmission by using RF clipping tone
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A technique of suppressing optical beat interference (OBI) noise in OFDMA PON is proposed and verified experimentally by applying RF clipping tone. We achieve reliable 8Gbit/s 20km uplink transmission with spectral efficiency 2.7bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Rotation induced cooling of an optically trapped microgyroscope in vacuum
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optical trapping of a microgyroscope rotating at MHz rates in vacuum. The particle is cooled to 40K. This is a major step towards measuring the Casimir force resulting in rotational quantum friction.

articleTitle: Molding surface plasmons by spinoptical Rashba metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a spin-based surface plasmon directional excitation by spinoptical Rashba metasurfaces. The light-matter interaction control via the geometric design of the metasurface symmetry ushers in a new era of light manipulation.

articleTitle: Coherent detection of phase modulated ultrashort optical pulses using time-to-space conversion at 1.55µm
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Phase information is preserved and faithfully recovered in a time-to-space conversion process of ultrashort optical pulses for the first time. Spatial interference between the pulse image and a coherent reference is used for phase detection.

articleTitle: Ultrafast multi-terahertz nanoscopy with sub-cycle temporal resolution
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We combine ultrafast multi-terahertz spectroscopy and near-field microscopy to achieve sub-wavelength spatial (~15 nm) and sub-cycle temporal (~9 fs) resolution. We apply our novel system to photoexcited InAs nanowires and resolve femtosecond carrier dynamics - spatially, temporally and spectrally.

articleTitle: Extreme Events in Resonant Radiation from 3-dimensional light bullets
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate rogue event statistics of dispersive waves from 3-dimensional spatiotemporal light bullets. Similarities to fibre solitons, with the added complexity related to spatiotemporal dynamics render this system ideal for future rogue wave studies

articleTitle: Controlling ablation mechanisms in sapphire by irradiation with temporally shaped femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of temporally shaped femtosecond laser pulses is shown to enable the control of ablation mechanisms in Sapphire ranging from gentle over strong ablation to explosive boiling.

articleTitle: Coherent attosecond beams carrying orbital angular momentum
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a theoretical study of high-order harmonic generation and propagation driven by an infrared field carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM). We show that extreme-ultraviolet high-OAM vortices with helical attosecond pulse structure are generated.

articleTitle: Maximizing strong coupling between metasurface resonators and intersubband transitions
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyze strongly coupled systems that use metasurface resonators and provide an electrodynamic model based on the quasi-static electric near fields that can be used to predict and maximize Rabi splitting varying resonator geometry.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nanowire continuum light source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optically pumped gold nanowire, 330 nm in diameter imbedded into silicate optical fiber produces broadband, highly collimated radiation (in the range 470-900 nm) with divergence of less than 4 mrad.

articleTitle: Temporal soliton generation in chip-based silicion nitride microresonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate temporal dissipative soliton generation in silicon nitride microresonators for the first time. Temporal soliton states allow for low-noise RF-generation, smooth frequency comb spectra and produce ultra-short optical pulses on a chip.

articleTitle: Femtosecond-laser inscription via local modification of the glass composition in phosphate glasses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Femtosecond laser inscription of high performance active/passive waveguides is demonstrated in phosphate glass via local modification of the glass composition. La-K cross diffusion plays a key role in the performance of the generated structures.

articleTitle: Control of Turing patterns in a coherent quantum fluid
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A generalization of Turing patterns, originally developed for chemical reactions, to patterns in quantum fluids can be realized with microcavity polaritons. Theoretical concepts of formation and control, together with experimental observations, will be presented.

articleTitle: Sub-Rayleigh imaging via speckle illumination and correlation measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a sub-Rayleigh imaging technique based on speckle illumination and the second-order correlation measurement. The image resolution is related to the speckle size or the lateral coherence length of the pseudothermal light.

articleTitle: Numerically stable reconstruction of wavelength-scale objects with sub-wavelength resolution
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present numerically stable expansion basis for diffraction-based far-field computational imaging systems and demonstrate the capabilities of reconstructing wavelength-scale objects with wavelength/20 resolution.

articleTitle: Polarization splitting at infrared wavelengths using silicon nanoridges
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a polarization splitting method based on near-field interference. Unlike conventional polarizers, our design does not absorb the undesired polarization but rather deflects light in a polarization-dependent manner. This could enable high efficiency polarization-resolved-imaging.

articleTitle: Selective excitation of pure higher order modes in hollow-core PCF via side-coupling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Side-coupling enables the selective excitation of individual higher order modes in hollow-core PCF, permitting the complex near-field modal patterns to be cleanly observed at any wavelength. Modal phase indices and losses can be accurately measured.

articleTitle: High-temperature plasmonic thermal emitter for thermo-photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use titanium nitride (TiN) to demonstrate an ultra-thin plasmonic thermal emitter operating at high temperatures (830 K). The spectrally selective emitter exhibits a large emittance at around 2.5 µm and below, and suppresses emission at longer wavelengths.

articleTitle: Manipulating microwave signals using plasma-based metamaterial structures in air
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work, we theoretically and numerically demonstrate several new plasma filament-based structures used for increasing the angular and range resolution of microwave radar systems, and show that they can survive in adverse environments.

articleTitle: Direct observation of pulse dynamics, influencing high-order harmonic emission along a filament
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present in-situ measurements of pulse dynamics along a femtosecond filament. Pulse-splitting has been observed, resulting in self-compression to 5.3 fs, influencing high-order harmonic generation along the filament.

articleTitle: Monitoring the frequency detune of harmonically modelocked Fourier domain mode locked fiber laser using the supermode noise peaks
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The intensity of supermode noise peaks of a harmonically mode-locked Fourier domain mode-locked fiber laser will drop significantly with the increase of frequency detune, which can be used to monitor the laser output quality.

articleTitle: Collection of remote optical signals by air waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that long-lived air waveguides can efficiently collect remote, isotropically emitted optical signals. Signal-to-noise enhancements of ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> are possible for standoff measurements at 100 m, with even higher increases possible at longer distances.

articleTitle: Self-accelerating beams of photons and electrons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The properties of optical, electron and plasmon beams that preserve their shape, while propagating along curved trajectories in free-space or on a surface are discussed. Methods to generate these beams and potential applications are presented.

articleTitle: How to guide light around sharp corners: Topologically protected surface waves without magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new design of bi-anisotropic meta-waveguide exhibiting topologically protected edge mode which can be guided around sharp corners without external magnetic field. The geometry is very simple and easy to be experimentally implemented.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of rotational wavepackets of nitrogen molecules by strong-field-ionization induced air lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on diagnostics of rotational wavepackets coherently generated in strong-field-ionized nitrogen molecules with a seed-amplified air lasing scheme, and the first observation on Raman scattering of neutral nitrogen molecules with such an “air laser”.

articleTitle: Group delay compensation of spectrally-filtered picosecond pulses for stimulated raman microscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Wavelength-tunable pulses with a constant group delay are successfully generated through spectral filtering of broadband pulses in a modified 4-f configuration. This technique effectively improves the reproducibility of spectral data in stimulated Raman spectral microscopy.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal optical coherence (STOC) manipulation and its possible applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel method of spatiotemporal optical coherence (STOC) manipulation, in which the effective coherence properties of the optical field are adjusted by modulating the phase of the spectral degree of coherence.

articleTitle: Ultrafast imaging of shocked material dynamics with X-ray fee electron laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first single-shot images of a laser-driven shock wave interacting with micron-scale materials inhomogeneities taken with an X-ray free electron laser. Materials dynamics under high strain-rate loading is important to a range of problems.

articleTitle: Sagnac based polarimetric analysis of EBC: Experimental relationship to blood glucose
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a novel polarimeter based on fiberoptic gyroscope. We have discovered that there is a good correlation between optical rotation of EBC (exhaled breath condensate) and blood glucose levels using this polarimeter.

articleTitle: Long range correlations of light intensity inside photonic nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measured directly long-range spatial intensity correlations inside quasi-two-dimensional disordered photonic waveguides. Enhancement of long-range correlations is observed in narrower waveguides due to stronger localization effects, which enables manipulation of intensity correlations inside random media.

articleTitle: Femtosecond mode-locked VECSEL from widely cw-tunable gain chips
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe passively mode-locking of an InGaAs quantum well laser, comparing different dielectric coatings applied to the same gain wafer. A 7-fold variation in pulse duration down to 817 fs was observed.

articleTitle: Two-photon fluorescence resonance energy transfer stoichiometry in living cells
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using phase-shaped pulses, we perform, for the first time, a proof-of-principle demonstration of two-photon fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) microscopy for studying the stoichiometry of intermolecular interactions within living cells.

articleTitle: Demonstration of watt-class high-power photonic-crystal lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate watt-class high output power (1.5 W) operation in single-chip photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers under room-temperature continuous-wave condition. The beam quality factor M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> has been found to be kept at 1.0 up to 0.5 W.

articleTitle: Silicon waveguide to hybrid plasmonic waveguide polarization rotator and coupler
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a polarization rotator and coupler that rotates the TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> mode in a silicon waveguide and couples to the hybrid plasmonic (HP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>) mode. Coupling factor of ~ 60% and polarization conversion efficiency of ~ 90% is achieved.

articleTitle: Momentum-resolved electron energy loss spectroscopy (q-EELS) for quantum plasmonics and metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on experimental and theoretical results on EELS from 12nm single-crystal gold films. Our results show that momentum resolution of the electrons gives insight into signatures of non-locality and quantum nature of the excitations.

articleTitle: Stand-off spectroscopy and chemical sensing using a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fourier-transform spectroscopy using a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator is demonstrated. Specifically, this system is used to detect a thiodiglycol droplet from concrete and aluminum surfaces and atmospheric water vapor at a 2-m stand-off distance.

articleTitle: High-contrast, CEP-controlled double-CPA laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first CEP stable double-CPA laser system, producing 8 mJ, 22 fs pulses and featuring high temporal contrast (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup>) for performing relativistic intensity laser-plasma interactions at 1 kHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Nanopatterned multilayer hyperbolic metamaterials for enhancing spontaneous light emission
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that nanopatterned hyperbolic metamaterials made of Ag-Si multilayers enhance the spontaneous emission rate of dye molecules by 76-fold at tunable frequencies and the emission intensity by ~80 fold compared to metamaterials without nanostructuring.

articleTitle: Ultra-short pulse lasers as versatile tools in the fabrication of medical micro implants
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We give an overview of the application of ultra-short pulse (USP) lasers in the fabrication of miniaturized medical implants and devices like stents. Furthermore, we estimate the economic requirements to be fulfilled by USP lasers.

articleTitle: Improving broad-band mid-span spectral inversion performance for fiber nonlinearity compensation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate design approaches for improving the performance of broad-band mid-span spectral inversion. Simulations show at least 0.7 dB peak Q improvement of a 160-GHz wide 16-QAM OFDM super channel after 800 km transmission.

articleTitle: 130 MW peak power femtosecond laser pulses in a Kerr lens mode-locked thin-disk ring oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report generation of 860 W average power, 440 fs pulses in a 15.2 MHz thin-disk ring oscillator by placing a Kerr lens mode-locking setup in a low-pressure chamber.

articleTitle: Visible-frequency unidirectional transmission device incorporating a hyperbolic metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate that unidirectional transmission of visible light can be provided by a reciprocal and passive planar device of wavelength-scale-thickness, incorporating subwavelength-pitch gratings and a hyperbolic metamaterial.

articleTitle: Towards simultaneous measurement of OH and HO2 in combustion using Faraday rotation spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Preliminary results from the development of a dual wavelength Faraday rotation spectrometer for simultaneous quantification of HO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and OH in combustion research are presented.

articleTitle: Third-harmonic spectroscopy of all-dielectric oligomers with both electric and magnetic resonances
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize experimentally the nonlinear optical response of silicon nanodisk oligomers using third-harmonic generation spectroscopy and reveal the contributions of magnetic and electric dipolar resonances, local field enhancement, and nonlinear interference.

articleTitle: Generation of 17-µJ mid-infrared ultrafast laser pulses by SiC crystal based noncollinear optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A femtosecond OPA system for mid-infrared ultrafast laser is established. Pulse energy of 17-μJ is obtained from SiC crystal at central wavelength of 3.75-μm, which proves SiC an ideal nonlinear crystal for mid-infrared pulse generation.

articleTitle: Scattering super-lens: Subwavelength light focusing and imaging via wavefront shaping in complex media
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel optical method exploiting multiple scattering to achieve sub-wavelength focusing and imaging using visible light. The evanescent near-field information are controlled by or transferred into far-field components by scattering from disordered nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Surface emission quantum cascade lasers combining first and second order DFB gratings
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By combining first and second order DFB gratings, a new solution for surface emission QCL is presented. A QWS mode and a buried hetero-structure process allow single mode emission and low dissipation devices.

articleTitle: Narrowband four wave mixing in InGaP photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the first narrowband parametric interaction in a semiconductor (GaInP) photonic crystal waveguide. A pulsed pump, propagating in the normal dispersion regime yields a conversion efficiency of -10 dB with a moderate peak pump power of 650 mW.

articleTitle: 62-fs pulse generation from a SESAM modelocked Yb:CALGO thin disk laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the shortest pulses of any modelocked thin disk laser (TDL): a SESAM modelocked Yb:CALGO TDL generates 62-fs pulse duration at 5.1 W average power and we present new noise characterization.

articleTitle: Terahertz-driven non-resonant magnetization dynamics in cobalt
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate non-resonant magnetization dynamics in the ferromagnetic cobalt thin film induced by a high-field Terahertz pulse. The magnetization dynamics are coherent and exactly follow the THz carrier oscillations.

articleTitle: 1-to-32 H-tree optical distribution on adhesively bonded silicon nanomembrane
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed an adhesive bonding process to integrate silicon nanomembranes onto silicon chips. A grating-coupled 1-to-32 H-tree optical distribution is experimentally demonstrated with an excess loss of 2.2 dB and a uniformity of 0.72 dB.

articleTitle: Intracavity Raman lasers at 990 nm and 976 nm based on a three-level Nd:YLF fundamental laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This is the first time that significant Stokes output power of 0.88 W at 990 nm has been achieved using a three-level fundamental transition (quasi-cw Nd:YLF laser) with stimulated Raman scattering in a KGW crystal.

articleTitle: Unidirectional chip-to-fiber grating couplers in unmodified 45nm CMOS technology
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the first asymmetric unidirectional grating couplers fabricated in a 45nm unmodified CMOS process. Measured coupling efficiency from fiber-to-chip is ~40 %. Simulations show >70% efficiency is achievable with same design.

articleTitle: Waveform-dependent laser spectral compression through pulse propagation in a dispersion-increasing fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Waveform dependence of laser spectral compression in a dispersion-increasing fiber is investigated. Experimentally, record-high spectral compression ratios of 35.3 and 41.7 are respectively achieved using a stretch-pulse mode-locked fiber laser and an all-normal dispersion laser.

articleTitle: Entanglement in a Bragg Reflection waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that an integrated photonic Bragg Reflection waveguide (BRW) inherently produces polarization entangled photons.

articleTitle: Bandwidth shaping of parametric frequency combs via dispersion engineering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate experimentally and theoretically the role of higher-order-dispersion on the bandwidth of microresonator-based parametric frequency combs. Our results demonstrate that fourth-order dispersion plays a critical role in determining the spectral bandwidth.

articleTitle: PMD monitoring scheme for direct-detection optical OFDM systems using code-assisted optical subcarriers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A PMD monitoring scheme is proposed for direct-detection optical OFDM systems by adding a pair of code-assisted optical subcarriers. Code correlation technique is used to retrieve DGD values over 0–25ps with <2-ps average monitoring error.

articleTitle: Wide repetition rate tunable fetmtosecond laser with a pair of CFBGs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an Er-doped fiber femtosecond laser having a wider repetition rate tuning range by introducing a pair of chirped fibre Bragg gratings (CFBGs) which magnifies the cavity length change by 15 times.

articleTitle: Diffraction-assisted micropatterning of silicon surfaces by ns-laser irradiation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-pulse (532 nm, 10 ns) micropatterning of silicon surfaces through a pinhole is demonstrated using scanning electron and atomic force microscopy. The results are compared to the Fresnel diffraction theory and physical mechanisms are discussed.

articleTitle: Fiber strain sensor using spectral linewidth of FBG reflection through optical filter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The FBG reflective spectrum was coupled to a optical filter for linewidth monitoring in strain sensing applications. The sensitivity was typically demonstrated as 48-MHz/με and the strain sensing limitation could achieve ~nε with kHz narrow resolution bandwidth.

articleTitle: Graphene enabled 3 µm pulsed fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Graphene has emerged as innovative and effective saturable absorber for mid-infrared lasers. Pulsed erbium- and holmium-doped ZBLAN fiber lasers in the 3 μm region based on graphene saturable absorbers are reported.

articleTitle: Enhancement of output laser power in high-power Nd/Cr:YAG ceramic amplifiers based on cross-relaxation effect under solar-pumping
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Marked increase in output laser power of a high-power Nd/Cr:YAG ceramic amplifier based on the cross-relaxation effect at high temperature under quasi-solar light pumping was observed. The solar-pumped laser is applicable to renewable energy production.

articleTitle: X-ray absorption spectroscopy of iron tris(bipyridine) using superconducting microcalorimeters
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We are developing a tabletop apparatus for time-resolved X-ray absorption spectroscopy. Short X-ray pulses are generated by focusing a pulsed 800 nm laser onto a water jet target. X-rays that pass through a sample of interest are detected using energy-resolving superconducting microcalorimeter detectors. We have successfully observed EXAFS features from iron tris(bipyridine) in a water solution. We discuss details of the microcalorimeter spectra and describe the steps that remain before the intrinsic sub-picosecond sensitivity of the apparatus can be realized.

articleTitle: High-sensitivity chiral molecular sensing with optical metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Determination of the absolute handedness of single enantiomer at small quantities is essential in chiral drug developments. Here we provide theoretical insights, numerical analysis and experimental demonstrations of high sensitivity to zepto moles of chiral molecules using optical metasurfaces. We introduce a figure of merit (FoM) for metasurfaces that can be extracted from simple far-field scattering measurements at visible to near-infrared frequencies, establishing the optimal performance to detect molecular handedness. Our results experimentally show opposite signs of FoM for different molecular chirality. The properly designed metamaterial serves as an ultra-sensitive probe to enhance circular dichroism measurements at frequencies for which these signals would be otherwise undetectable.

articleTitle: Doppler-assisted tomography of photonic crystal fiber structure by side-scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a non-destructive side-scattering technique, the internal structure of a microstructured fibre is determined. The rotating fiber is illuminated by a laser beam and an inverse Radon transform is applied to the frequency-modulated scattered signal.

articleTitle: Apertureless optical near-field imaging of localized modes of silicon nanodisks
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure near-field distributions of Mie-type optical modes of silicon nanodisks using apertureless near-field optical microscopy. Excellent agreement with numerical predictions is obtained, further enabling multipole analysis of the observed modes.

articleTitle: 2D-material based nano-photonics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a nanophotonic platform based on 2D materials coupled to photonic crystal cavities. We show strong enhancement (~60 times) of light emission due to the photonic crystal.

articleTitle: A polarization-singularity photonic crystal waveguide design to enable quantum dot spin to photon entanglement on-chip
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show the importance of polarization and phase engineering when designing quantum information devices. Using the example of a photonic-crystal waveguide we demonstrate, for the first time, designs for an integrated quantum dot spin-photon interface.

articleTitle: High speed Si modulators with high modulation efficiency and low free carrier absorption by depleting carriers through fringe field junctions
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high speed Si modulator with fringe field junctions is presented. Low carrier absorption (1.3 dB/mm) and V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>L (1.8 V-cm) are demonstrated. The measured modulation speed and depth are 11.8-GHz and 8-dB.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband cueing receiver based on spatial-spectral holographic rainbow spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A spatial-spectral holographic channelizer and cueing receiver capable of operating 1-110 GHz with sub-MHz resolution, high dynamic range, and 1000 variably programmable channels is presented, along with initial test results in the 10-20 GHz band.

articleTitle: Real-time optical time-stretch statistical characterization of supercontinuum suppression by minute continuous wave
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that a minute continuous-wave becalms Raman soliton and thus actively suppresses supercontinuum. The effects are characterized in detail by real-time spectrally-resolved statistical analysis enabled by optical time-stretch.

articleTitle: High-dimensional time-energy entanglement-based quantum key distribution using dispersive optics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We implement a high-dimensional quantum key distribution protocol secure against collective attacks. We transform between conjugate measurement bases using group velocity dispersion. We obtain > 3 secure bits per photon coincidence.

articleTitle: Ultrafast fiber ring lasers with a pair of chirped fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The performance of mode-locked fiber ring lasers incorporating two opposite-dispersion chirped fiber Bragg gratings is presented in different dispersion regimes. Pulses of nanojoule energy and duration well below 100 fs are generated.

articleTitle: Toward a quantum network based on semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent advances in quantum dot based quantum technology are presented: scalable fabrication of bright sources of single photons or entangled photon pairs, optical non-linearities at the few photon scales and first implementations of quantum gates.

articleTitle: Four-wave mixing and Bragg scattering in resonant seed modulation instability in optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We interpret physically the dynamics of resonant seed modulation instability of quasi-continuous picosecond pulses in terms of cascaded four-wave mixing and Bragg scattering. We also report a critical condition to excite the resonant seeding effect.

articleTitle: Electrically driven single-photon emission from site-controlled InGaN/GaN quantum dots
