publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report single-photon emission from electrically driven site-controlled InGaN/GaN dot-in-nanowires, fabricated from a planar single InGaN quantum well LED using a top-down approach. Each dot-in-nanowire's formation site, diameter, height and material compositions were precisely controlled.

articleTitle: High speed single-pixel imaging via time domain compressive sampling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a high speed single-pixel microscopic imaging method by compressive sampling accomplished with time-stretch technique. By this method, we demonstrate a single-pixel imaging system with 1000 times faster than the conventional single-pixel cameras.

articleTitle: Multiphoton GRIN endoscope for evaluation of human prostatic tissue ex vivo
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize the diagnostic performance of a multiphoton GRIN endoscope using human prostate samples obtained from radical prostatectomy surgery. Ex vivo images of benign and tumor areas and images of peri-prostatic tissue are shown.

articleTitle: Wavelength control of resonant photonic modulators with balanced homodyne locking
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a robust method for control of resonant modulator wavelength that is integrated with an on-chip balanced detector. Experimental results demonstrate long-term locking with low bit error rate over greater than 55 Kelvin.

articleTitle: Colored hybrid photovoltaics with angle invariance
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present hybrid photovoltaic cells with distinct and angle-insensitive colors based on efficient photon manipulation. Up to 3% of power conversion efficiency is achieved by using tens of nm thick amorphous silicon active layer.

articleTitle: Studying momentum distributions in all aspects reveals important insight
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong field ionization momentum distribution contains much information. The angular distribution indicates real tunneling delay time, the center shows ellipticity dependent Coulomb effects, and the longitudinal momentum spread challenges the assumption of zero initial momentum.

articleTitle: In-vivo urodynamic pressure measurement with fiber-optic EFPI pressure probes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Urodynamic analysis carried out with biocompatible catheterized fiber-optic probes, for dual measurement of pressure in bladder and in rectum, is presented. Medical tests have been performed in-vivo on seven patients; main highlights are reported.

articleTitle: 3D hollow nanostructures for multifunctional plasmonics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel top-down technique allows precise control over the vertical axis; we fully exploit its potential by manufacturing plasmonic devices, to be employed in optoelectronics, microfluidics and biosensing.

articleTitle: Integrated silicon optomechanical transducers and their application in atomic force microscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present integrated optomechanical transducers with exposed tips and demonstrate ultrahigh force sensitivity and large bandwidth. The transducer is implemented as an atomic force microscope probe in the contact mode and nanoscale resolution is demonstrated.

articleTitle: High power guiding and electron acceleration in pure N5+ plasma channels
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We examine the interaction of relativistic laser pulses with plasma channels formed in a nitrogen cluster jet. We observe creation of nearly pure N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5+</sup> plasma channels and ionization injected wakefield beams with energies >100 MeV.

articleTitle: Zenneck THz surface waves-assisted imaging of subwavelength dielectric particles
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Electromagnetic Zenneck THz surface waves propagating on a bow-tie antenna are employed for time-resolved near-field imaging of subwavelength-size SrTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> particles. This approach provides high contrast, high-spatial resolution imaging through enhancing the fieldparticle interaction.

articleTitle: High pulse-energy generation in a monolithic Yb-doped all-fiber dual-cavity oscillator with fiber-based passive Q-switcher
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel high pulse-energy Yb-doped all-fiber dual-cavity laser with large core-diameter fiber-based passive Q-switcher is reported. The monolithic fiber oscillator generates pulses with peak power of 3.4 kW and single pulse energy of 484 µJ.

articleTitle: Shot-noise driven self-oscillations of ultra-low dissipation silicon carbide nanowires
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report ultra-low threshold optically induced self-oscillations of a ultra-low dissipation nanowire. We interpret the asymmetrically observed responses as a signature of the laser shot noise drive, consistent with our system's parameters.

articleTitle: Dynamic tuning of surface plasmon polaritons via thermally controlled liquid crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a thermally controlled plasmonic substrate in contact with a liquid crystal offering spectral tunings ~18.7 nm within ~18°C at LC nematic phase. Nematic/isotropic transition also enables ~12 nm spectral change only within ~1°C.

articleTitle: Sub-kHz-linewidth mid-infrared optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a transfer oscillator scheme between the pump and signal modes of a singly resonant optical parametric oscillator, emitting in the reange 2.7–4.2 mm, demonstrating sub-kHz linewidth of the idler mode.

articleTitle: Noble-metal-free sunlight harvesting meta-surface for water evaporation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present ultrathin multilayer metamaterial absorbers based on abundant, low-cost materials, to effectively harness solar energy for heating and evaporation of water.

articleTitle: Nonlinear THz conductivity in graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the nonlinear THz conductivity of graphene. The heating of charge carriers by strong THz pulses results in a reduction of the high-frequency conductivity of graphene, in spite of reduced scattering for high-energy carriers.

articleTitle: Quantum secret sharing with phase-encoded photons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate single-qubit quantum secret sharing using phase-encoded photons. The intermediate node is designed to be inserted directly between Alice and Bob, with no need for additional compensation schemes.

articleTitle: Accessing the magnetic dipole and electric quadrupole of quantum dots with light
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: One of the central assumptions in quantum electrodynamics is to invoke the dipole approximation because (quantum) emitters are much smaller than the wavelength of light. The main consequence is that only the electric dipole plays a role in light-matter interactions at optical frequencies. In this paper we show that semiconductor quantum dots possess large magnetic-dipole and electric-quadrupole moments, which can be accessed with light. Moreover, quantum dots are capable of mediating electric-dipole, magnetic-dipole and electric-quadrupole interactions on dipole-allowed transitions and therefore are fundamentally different than atoms.

articleTitle: Passive synchronization between two-color mode-locked lasers with long-term stability and subfemtosecond timing jitter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate passive synchronization between Ti:sapphire and Yb-doped fiber mode-locked lasers with long-term stability for 6 h with the aid of active temperature stabilization. A timing jitter of 0.75 fs was achieved between two-color pulses.

articleTitle: Lower bound on the speed of nonlocal correlations without locality and measurement choice loopholes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here, we strictly closed the loopholes by observing a 12 h continuous violation of the Bell inequality and concluded that the lower bound speed of spooky action was 4 orders of magnitude of the speed of light.

articleTitle: Efficient diode-pumped Tm,Ho:KLuW laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Output powers exceeding 1 W are achieved with a diode-pumped Tm,Ho:KLu(WO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser at 2078 nm at slope efficiency of ∼30% with respect to the absorbed power. Continuous tuning is possible over ∼180 nm.

articleTitle: Single-nanoparticle study of switchable exciton-plasmon coupling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the single-nanoparticle study of switchable exciton-plasmon coupling. The wavelength-dependent peak shifts in localized surface plasmon resonances (LSPRs) of metal nanoparticle-spiropyran hybrids depend on the combined effects of material dispersion and sensitivity of LSPRs.

articleTitle: Ultra-long duration time-resolved spectroscopy with enhanced temporal resolution of high-Q nano-optomechanical modes using interleaved asynchronous optical sampling (I-ASOPS)
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transient responses of high-Q nano-optomechanical modes are characterized with Interleaved-ASOPS, where pump-induced transients are interrogated with multiple probe pulses. Temporal resolution increases linearly with probe-pulse-number beyond conventional ASOPS, achieving sub-ps resolution over μs durations.

articleTitle: MV/cm Terahertz transients in the THz gap (1–20 THz) from organic crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate highly efficient Terahertz production and absolute phase control in the hardly accessible THz frequency gap by optical rectification in organic crystals leading to single-cycle field oscillations beyond 150 MV/m and 0.5 Tesla.

articleTitle: Adaptive optics for single-photon fiber coupling of ions
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new adaptive-optics technique for the optimization of photon collection from a simulated ion. Our technique uses a genetic algorithm to correct wavefront aberrations via deformable mirror before coupling into a single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Plasmonic photomixers for increased terahertz radiation powers at 1550 nm optical pump wavelength
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an order of magnitude higher radiated power from a 1550 nm photomixer with plasmonic contact electrodes in comparison with an analogous photomixer without plasmonic contact electrodes in the 0.25-2.5 THz frequency range.

articleTitle: Measurement of sub-pulse-width temporal delays via spectral interference induced by weak value amplification
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental results of a scheme based on the concepts of weak measurements and weak value amplification to measure temporal delays, much smaller than the pulse width, by means of spectral interference

articleTitle: Emission of time-energy entangled photon pairs from an integrated silicon ring resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated silicon source of time-energy entangled photons. Entanglement is proved using a Franson type experiment, obtaining visibility exceeding 90% and a violation of the Bell's inequality by more than 10 standard deviations.

articleTitle: Frequency conversion of narrowband single photons from a SPDC pair source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on frequency down conversion of single photons from a photon pair source resonant with an atomic transition of Calcium ions. The temporal correlation between the photon pair is preserved in the conversion process.

articleTitle: 1.3 µm InAs/GaAs quantum dot lasers on SOI waveguide structures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 1.3-μm InAs/GaAs quantum dot laser on a silicon-on-insulator waveguide structure with a threshold current density of 300 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and lasing temperatures greater than 100°C is fabricated by direct wafer bonding and layer transfer.

articleTitle: Serial time-encoded amplified microscopy (STEAM) by fully incoherent noise
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By introducing a time-lens in the serial time-encoded amplified microscopy (STEAM), its input temporal aperture is greatly enlarged. Therefore, the light source with arbitrary waveform can be applied, especially the amplified spontaneous emission noise.

articleTitle: Ultra-low voltage wide bandwidth electro-optic modulators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Wide bandwidth, ultra-low voltage modulators based on substrate removal technology and loaded line traveling wave electrodes are presented. Drive voltage product is 0.06 V-cm and 2 mm long devices have electrical-to-electrical bandwidths exceeding 80 GHz.

articleTitle: Efficient storage at telecom wavelength for optical quantum memory
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report high efficient storage at telecom wavelength using the recently proposed ROSE protocol. The bandwidth is analyzed to increase the multiplexing capacity.

articleTitle: Experiments on cascaded quadratic soliton compression in unpoled LN waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Experiments on cascaded quadratic soliton compression in unpoled phase-mismatched lithium niobate waveguides are presented. Pulse self-phase modulation dominated by an overall self-defocusing nonlinearity is observed, with an variation of pump wavelength and waveguide core width.

articleTitle: Impact of laser resonance phase noise on the wavelength conversion of DQPSK signals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show through simulations and with supporting experimental results that the performance of four-wave mixing based wavelength conversion of DQPSK signals is severely limited by resonance enhanced phase noise on the pump source.

articleTitle: Polarization-diversified, multichannel orbital angular momentum (OAM) coherent communication link demonstration using 2D–3D hybrid integrated devices for free-space OAM multiplexing and demultiplexing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present dual-polarization QPSK link transmission performance below the FEC limit with simultaneous transmission of three OAM states carrying 14×10-GBd WDM channels using silica 2D-3D hybrid integrated devices for OAM state multiplexing/demultiplexing capacity of 1.68 Tb/s.

articleTitle: Terahertz surface plasmon polaritons on freestanding multi-walled carbon nanotube aerogel sheets
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that multi-walled carbon nanotubes exhibit highly anisotropic terahertz polarization behavior. We accomplish this by measuring the complex index of refraction of planar and periodically perforated carbon nanotube sheets for two orthogonal nanotube orientations.

articleTitle: Electron tunneling and acceleration at gold nanostructures driven by ultrashort mid-infrared pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong-field photoemission from resonant and non-resonant gold nanostructures is studied using ultrashort mid-infrared pulses. The photoelectron yield and kinetic energy spectra are governed by both antenna resonances and optical near-field distributions.

articleTitle: Arbitrary photonic wave plate operations on-chip: Realizing Hadamard and Pauli-X gates for polarization encoded qubits
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present arbitrary wave plate operations on-chip based on the reorientation of the waveguide's optical axis caused by additional stress fields. A successful implementation of Hadamard and Pauli-X gates for quantum light is shown.

articleTitle: Demonstration of strong near-field radiative heat transfer between nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate soliton fission induced by free-carriers for the first time. Using time-resolved near-field measurements, we directly observe the nonlinear pulse evolution along the 1.5 millimeter nanophotonic waveguide in-situ, a record short fission length.

articleTitle: Generation of sub-100-fs pulses in an Yb: CaGdAlO4 regenerative amplifier by tailored control of linear and nonlinear phase
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Generation of sub 100 fs pulse has been obtained in an Yb:CALGO regenerative amplifier using nonlinear effects. It exhibits 97fs pulses at 1047nm with up to 24µJ energy with a spectral bandwidth of 19nm.

articleTitle: Measurement of nonlinear refraction dynamics of CS2
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nonlinear refractive dynamics of CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are measured with the beam deflection technique. A response function model is fit, from which the pulse width dependent n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,eff</sub> is calculated and compared to Z-scan measurements.

articleTitle: Opaque film metrology using PULSE Technology
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: PULSE Technology™ involves generation and detection of acoustic waves in opaque layers using ultrafast laser pulses. Its application in advanced semiconductor and packaging industry for single and multi-layer thin film metrology is presented.

articleTitle: Simultaneous detection of multiple gases by Raman spectroscopy with hollow-core fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Raman spectroscopy of gas flowing through a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber (HC-PCF) provides simultaneous detection of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, and CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, with detection limits between 300 and 1000 ppm for 30 s of signal averaging.

articleTitle: Tuning the visible-to-infrared reflectance spectra of arrays of vertical Ge nanowires
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that, by varying their diameter, the visible-to-infrared reflectance spectra of arrays of vertical Ge nanowires can be tuned. The results could enable future nanowire-based photodetectors with tailored responsivity spectra.

articleTitle: Bowtie plasmonic aperture for single quantum emitter absorption measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Bowtie apertures with gap sizes of less than 30nm are fabricated successfully by lift-off process. Numerical modeling shows that they have mode area as small as 0.011(λ/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which is two orders smaller than a conventional tightly focused laser spot.

articleTitle: Experimental exploration of symmetry breaking in plasmonic meta-surfaces exhibiting double-continuum Fano resonances
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have examined the effect of gradual breaking of symmetry on a Fano resonant metamaterial, and have been able to understand the features using theoretical models and simulations. This study should provide a basis for choosing a specific structure for a given purpose. We have been able to obtain a continuous range of Q of 7 to 13.

articleTitle: High-resolution measurement of the joint spectral density of quantum correlated photon pairs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the characterization of the quantum correlations generated by a photon-pair source can be directly performed via a classical measurement leading to an unprecedented spectral resolution and a shorter integration time.

articleTitle: Cavity quantum electrodynamics in quantum dot-photonic crystal nanocavity coupled system with large g/κ
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report experimental progresses in cavity quantum electrodynamics using H1 and H0-type photonic crystal nanoacvities embedding single quantum dots. Strong coupling and enhanced optical Stark effect in these systems with large g/κ will be discussed.

articleTitle: Widely-detuned all-fiber photon pair source in standard telecom fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate photon pair generation in the telecom O- and L-bands thru spontaneous four-wave mixing in fiber. These wavelengths have low loss in fiber and are widely detuned from the pump, which simplifies filtering and reduces Raman.

articleTitle: Non-invasive integrated light probe
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Non-perturbative on-chip light observation is achieved in silicon photonics waveguides by a novel integrated photonic probe. Light intensity monitoring is performed over 40 dB dynamic range, -30 dBm sensitivity, and microsecond scale time response.

articleTitle: 500 MHz Yb:fiber laser frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report direct generation of 500MHz Yb:fiber laser frequency comb. The offset frequency was stabilized more than 6 hours in an open air environment. The stabilized repetition rate has an in-loop tracking stability of 4.46×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−13</sup>/τ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup>.

articleTitle: Terahertz plasmonic structures based on a spatially varying conductivity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new technique for fabricating terahertz plasmonic structures that incorporates a spatial variation into the conductivity of the metallic layer using inkjet printing of a conductive and resistive ink simultaneously.

articleTitle: All-optical continuously tunable delay of single photons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first demonstration of all-optical continuously tunable delay imparted on single photons using a frequency conversion-dispersion technique. Delays tunable over 23 times the photon duration are demonstrated with on/off efficiency of 20-55%.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of fundamental bounds in quantum measurements for estimating quantum states
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the conditions of an optimal measurement for estimating quantum states with minimal disturbance and maximal reversibility, and experimentally implement it in three-dimensional quantum states encoded by the single photon's polarization and path.

articleTitle: Generation of Raman comb over two octaves with picosecond pulse laser in hydrogen-filled Kagome HC-PCF
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on 33 W picosecond pulse laser pumped Raman comb generation with fifty spectral lines over two frequency octaves from the visible to the near infrared range obtained in hydrogen-filled hypocycloid-core Kagome hollow core photonic crystal fibre HC-PCF.

articleTitle: Highly efficient generation of narrow-band single-mode photon pairs from a whispering gallery mode resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a highly efficient narrow-band pair-photon source based on a crystalline whispering gallery mode resonator, which emits photons in exactly one spatiotemporal mode.

articleTitle: Controlled coupling of rolled-up microtubes integrated with silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, the controlled coupling of rolled-up microtubes integrated with silicon waveguides by thermally tuning the coupling gap. Then we realize coupling modulation utilizing the dynamic tuning effect.

articleTitle: Long-term stabilization of mode-locked Er-fiber lasers with 1.2 fs timing jitter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new phase-locking technique for long-term and high-precision stabilization of mode-locked Er-fiber lasers by direct optical-microwave phase detection without high-speed photodiodes and mixers. The excellent locking performance reaches 2.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−18</sup> at 4000-s averaging time.

articleTitle: Quantum effects in four-wave mixing: Collapse and revival of bi-photon interference
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We explore the classical-to-quantum transition with light produced by broadband spontaneous FWM in fibers. Observing bi-photon quantum interference and its dependence on internal loss, we demonstrate quantum collapse and revival of the interference contrast.

articleTitle: Self-organization of waveguides toward luminescent targets in novel organic/inorganic hybrid materials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate self-organization of an optical waveguide toward a luminescent target by self-focusing to enable “optical solder,” namely, a self-aligned coupling of two multimode optical fiber cores in a photo-sensitive organic/inorganic hybrid material, SUNCONNECT®.

articleTitle: FM mode-locked optical parametric oscillator: Pulse formation and spectral characteristics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report pulse formation and spectral characteristics of a FM mode-locked OPO in the mid-IR. The singly-resonant OPO based on MgO:PPLN, pumped by a cw Yb-fiber laser at 1064 nm, generates 236ps pulses at 80MHz.

articleTitle: Non-invasive beam detection in a high average power electron accelerator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A non-invasive, real time, method for measuring the longitudinal emittance of electron bunches can be realized by using electro-optic (EO) detection schemes. Implementation of an EO beam diagnostic within the Colorado State University and Jefferson Laboratory beamlines necessitates investigation into how high average power beams affect various EO crystals. Damage mechanisms from proximity to the e-beam from heavy radiation and beam halo damage can affect the viability of such a procedure. This study seeks to characterize these effects and determine a suitable EO diagnostic procedure for electron bunches in the CSU and J-Lab facilities.

articleTitle: Enhanced plasmonic performance in ultrathin silver structures using Gas Cluster Ion Beam Irradiation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the use of Gas Cluster Ion Beam (GCIB) nanoprocessing technology for producing ultrathin silver waveguide and disk structures with smoother surfaces and wider grain sizes for enhanced surface plasmon propagation.

articleTitle: Chiral mono-crystalline silicon nano-cone fabrication by optical vortex pumping
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We for the first time demonstrated a chiral mono-crystalline cone-shaped silicon structure (chiral Si nano-cone). It was fabricated on a nano-scale by transferring the optical angular momentum of optical vortex to a mono-crystalline Si substrate.

articleTitle: Entangling color-different photons via time-resolved measurement and active feed-forward
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an experiment of entangling independent color-different photons by using time-resolved measurement and active feed-forward. Our work provides an approach to solve the frequency mismatch problem for the interconnection between dissimilar quantum systems in a quantum network.

articleTitle: Few-cycle, broadband, mid-infrared parametric oscillator pumped by a 20-fs Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a broadband mid-IR femtosecond OPO tunable across 2179–3732 nm, pumped by 20-fs pulses at 790 nm, generating idler pulses of 4.3 optical cycles (33 fs) at 2282 nm, with high stability and beam-quality.

articleTitle: Polarization-resolved imaging using elliptical silicon nanowire photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate photodetectors comprising silicon nanowires with elliptical cross sections, and show that their spectral responsivities depend on the incident light's polarization state. We perform polarization-resolved imaging using these photodetectors.

articleTitle: A femtosecond thulium holmium co-doped fiber laser based on graphene oxide evanescent filed interaction
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an all fiberized, passively mode-locked thulium holmium co-doped fiber laser operating at a wavelength of ~1.95 μm using the graphene-oxide evanescent field interaction. A temporal pulse width of ~590 fs is experimentally obtained at 33.25 MHz.

articleTitle: Parity-time (PT)-symmetric optical microcavities
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first demonstration of PT-symmetry and its breaking in a system of two directly-coupled on-chip whispering-gallery-mode microresonators[1]. We observed strong nonreciprocity due to strong-field localization and enhanced nonlinearity in the broken PT-symmetry phase.

articleTitle: 15 mW of CW emission at 193 nm using the crystal KBBF
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a narrow-band continuous-wave laser source in the deep-ultraviolet with an output power of > 15 mW at 193 nm. We see applications of this laser source in semiconductor metrology and high-resolution spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Radiofrequency spectroscopy of the active fiber heating under condition of high-power lasing generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel precise method for measurement of active fiber temperature in high-power fiber lasers and amplifiers is proposed. This method allows determination of the temperature distribution along the active fiber.

articleTitle: Surface nonlinearities in plasmonics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Plasmonic nanostructures can manipulate nonlinear optical phenomena via local field enhancement, but also can serve as strong nonlinear sources themselves. Surface second-harmonic effects in nanoparticles, surfaces, and metamaterials will be analyzed via advanced hydrodynamic model.

articleTitle: Back-action of continuum on solitons and the resulting energy oscillations in a mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a resonant phenomenon that exists in all mode-locked lasers with non-negligible anomalous chromatic dispersion and self-phase modulation. Numerical simulation and experiment are also performed, and good agreement with the analytic results was found.

articleTitle: Ablation of polymethylmethacrylate by two-color femtosecond synthesized waveform
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated femtosecond laser ablation of PMMA using 2-color waveform synthesis. A modest and yet clear modulation in ablated area versus relative phase between the ω and 2 ω beams is observed.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive amplification in communications and signal processing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent progress in low-noise optical amplification and signal processing has raised prospects of practical devices operating below the conventional quantum limit. We review basic principles, practical implementation, and performance of such devices.

articleTitle: Electro-optic modulation of small disk microcavity through gated graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Monolayer graphene sheet has been integrated on top of small disk optical resonator in SOI platform. Electro-optic interaction between graphene and whispering gallery mode of the cavity has been demonstrated and studied for modulation application.

articleTitle: Room temperature bloch surface wave polaritons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate strong coupling between Bloch surface waves in a Ta<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> multilayer and J-aggregate excitons. The measured Rabi splitting is 290 meV. The mode dispersion curves are investigated by means of attenuated-total-reflection and photoluminescence experiments.

articleTitle: Photoinduced absorption with ultrafast decay constants in a large single crystal of BiFeO3
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using near-infrared pump probe technique, we demonstrate ultrafast photoinduced absorption with a decay constant as short as 100 fs in a large single crystal of bismuth ferrite with high quality grown by floating zone method.

articleTitle: Metal nanorods array embedded silicon waveguide polarization beam splitter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a polarization beam splitter with a metal nanorods array embedded between two silicon waveguides. Localized surface plasmon resonance of the metal array introduces the birefringence with short coupling length and broad bandwidth.

articleTitle: 3D Optical manipulation of a single 50 nm particle with a scanning evanescent nano-tweezers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Herein,we demonstrate stable optical trapping and accurate 3D manipulation of a single dielectric nanoparticle with a scanning optical near field probe.

articleTitle: Improved signal processing for distributed sensing network based on Chirped Laser Dispersion Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A centralized detection in a network of Chirped Laser Dispersion Spectroscopy (CLaDS) sensors requires efficient signal processing. The optimization of CLaDS signal processing and development of a custom digital signal processing unit in place of conventional bench-top instruments that prevent previously developed CLaDS systems from achieving optimum performance is discussed.

articleTitle: Helical filaments
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the use of non-diffracting beams to control and organize multiple filamentation in air. Here, a pair of laser filaments which twist about the optical axis during propagation is obtained using a Bessel beam superposition.

articleTitle: A silicon integrated BaTiO3 electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Si-integrated modulator based on epitaxial ferroelectric BaTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> thin films is demonstrated with gigahertz modulation bandwidth and an effective Pockels coefficient of 213 ± 49 pm/V.

articleTitle: Low-energy self-defocusing soliton compression at optical communication wavelengths in unpoled lithium niobate ridge waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Self-defocusing soliton compression supported by the cascaded phase-mismatched second-harmonic generation process is numerically demonstrated in unpoled lithium niobate ridge waveguides where nano-joule pulses are operated and quasi-phase-matching is unnecessary. The soliton range is 1100–1800 nm.

articleTitle: Complex wavefront control for enhancing penetration depth in 2-D optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the enhancement of signal and penetration depth in 2-D imaging in optical coherence tomography by suppressing multiple scattering via complex wavefront shaping. Up to 92% enhancements of the penetration depth were observed for a highly scattering sample.

articleTitle: Optimal quantum control by composite pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel design of high-fidelity composite pulse sequences for dynamical suppression of amplitude noise with applications to NMR and QIP. We derive exact analytic formulas for the composite phases.

articleTitle: Dynamical two-dimensional accelerating beams and enhancement of their peak intensities
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analytically study the propagation dynamics of two-dimensional accelerating beams in a generalized way and propose an optimized method to enhance their peak intensities. Our theoretical analysis is confirmed by experimental results.

articleTitle: 16QAM silicon-organic hybrid (SOH) modulator operating with 0.6 Vpp and 19 fJ/bit at 112 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon-based 16QAM modulator with a record-low drive voltage of 0.6V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub> and an energy consumption of 19fJ/bit. The device employs silicon slot waveguides with electro-optic organic cladding and enables data transmission at 112Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Femtosecond time-and-angle-resolved EUV photoemission spectroscopy with mid-IR pumping
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy directly enables observation of electron dynamics in condensed matter. Using EUV high harmonic probe extends the observation window in energy and momentum. Tunable mid-infrared pumping allows control of excitation mechanisms.

articleTitle: Widely-tunable monolithic terahertz quantum cascade laser sources based on difference-frequency generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate monolithic tunable terahertz quantum cascades laser sources with a tuning range over 580 GHz at room temperature by integrating electrically separated distributed feedback section and distributed Bragg reflector section into a single device.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of hybrid SPP waveguides for ultrahigh-bandwidth low-penalty 1.8-Tbit/s data transmission (161 WDM 11.2-Gbit/s OFDM 16-QAM)
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design and fabricate a vertical hybrid surface plasmon polariton (SPP) waveguide. The suitability of ultrahigh-bandwidth data transmission through the proposed waveguide by transmitting 1.8-Tbit/s (161 wavelength 11.2-Gbit/s) WDM OFDM 16-QAM is studied. The BERs of all 161 channels are less than 1e-3.

articleTitle: 1010 electromagnetic SERS enhancement in a nanosphere-plane junction under radially polarized focused excitation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A monolayer of MGITC molecules in a gold nanosphere-plane junction is excited by focusing a radially polarized laser beam. A record electromagnetic enhancement factor of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> for deterministic SERS experiments has been obtained.

articleTitle: Suspended MIM optical waveguides with optical nano-antennas
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work we experimentally demonstrate suspended gold-air-gold (MIM) plasmonic waveguides operating at the NIR wavelengths. The waveguide interfaces with the far field using optical nano-antennas with main beams normal to the structure.

articleTitle: Towards doppler-free QCL-based metrological THz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: New frontiers for high precision THz spectroscopy are presented. Current limits can be overcome by exploiting saturation effects on molecular transitions and coupling THz QCL radiation to an optical cavity.

articleTitle: Power scaling a Cr:ZnSe thin disk laser by increasing pump diameter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 500 μm Cr:ZnSe thin disk gain element was pumped at five different pump diameters. Laser output versus pump power was measured. Slope efficiency, threshold, and maximum power versus pump spot size were then extracted.

articleTitle: Electrically-tunable multi-color ultrafast Cherenkov fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the broadband electrical tunability of ultrafast fiber laser output across the visible range, from the deep blue to the infrared.

articleTitle: Low-threshold dielectric-cavity microlasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present low-threshold dielectric-cavity surface-emitting microlasers working at room temperature under continuous-wave electrical injection with device diameter down to 2 µm. Size-dependent lasing properties are predicted theoretically and demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Active modulation of terahertz wave front
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel method is proposed to dynamically modulate the THz wave front with photo-generated carriers. Some special wave fronts are generated using this method. This new method is structure free, high resolution, and broadband.

articleTitle: Investigation of photoluminescence from Ge1−xSnx: A CMOS-compatible material grown on Si via CVD
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photoluminescence (PL) from Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> grown on Si by CVD was investigated for Sn composition of 0.9, 3.2, 6, and 7%, respectively. The direct and indirect band transitions were analyzed at different temperatures.

articleTitle: Observation of the Imbert-Fedorov effect via weak value amplification
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of the Imbert-Fedorov shift via weak value amplification.

articleTitle: Table-top hard x-ray source driven by sub-100 fs mid-infrared pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Powerful 90 fs pulses at a midinfrared wavelength of λ = 3.9 µm drive a femtosecond hard x-ray source (Cu Kα: ℏω = 8.05 keV). Up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> X-ray photons/pulse are generated which is twice as many as with 800 nm drivers of a 100 times higher peak intensity.

articleTitle: Sensitivity in Synthetic Aperture Ladar imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Ladar (SAL) imaging experiments show that cross-range compression, including image based phase error correction, can be performed at very low return light levels. This includes images where the precompression shot-noise-limited signal-to-noise ratio is much less than unity.

articleTitle: Graphene-based passive Q-switching of a Tm3++:ZBLAN short-infrared waveguide laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a passively Q-switched 1.9 μm thulium ZBLAN waveguide laser based on an extended cavity containing a flake-graphene saturable absorber film. The 790nm diode-laser-pumped laser produces up to 6 mW with ~1.4 μs pulses at ~25 kHz.

articleTitle: Optical properties of Er-doped fluoride glasses for solar-pumped laser applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical properties required for the design of a solar pumped fiber laser were evaluated for Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-fluoride glass. The quantum efficiency of the emission band at 1530 nm was about 35 %. The product of the stimulated emission cross-section and the emission lifetime σ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sub>τ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</sub> was about 46×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-24</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>·s.

articleTitle: A novel intensity modulator for photonic ADCs using an injection-locked mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel intensity modulator for pulsed light is proposed and demonstrated here for the first time. This has been realized by introducing an injection-locked AlGaInAs mode-locked laser into one arm of a Mach-Zehnder interferometer.

articleTitle: Zn+ implanted silicon waveguide photodiodes for on-chip mid-infrared detection
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of Zn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> implanted Si waveguide photodiodes for 2.2-2.4 μm operation. Preliminary responsivities > 65 mA/W are measured, suggesting suitability for on-chip sensing and communications applications in the mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of an efficient unidirectional coupler for surface plasmons with wide-angle efficiency
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a wide-angle unidirectional excitation of surface plasmon modes. Employing the plasmonic critical angle phenomenon in conjunction with the grating effect, a wide incident angular full-width-half-maximum (AFWHM=25°) with high unidirectionality of extinction ratios better than 10dB was realized.

articleTitle: Light transport in PT photonic structures with hidden symmetries
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a bosonic quantization technique for generating PT photonic structures that possess hidden symmetries. We investigate light transport in these geometries under linear and nonlinear conditions and we demonstrate a host of new effects.

articleTitle: Test of higher-order nonlinearity via low-order harmonic generation revisited
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure the ratio between fifth- and third-harmonic signals from air as a function of the laser intensity determined by mode measurements. Our results do not support the presence of a higher-order Kerr nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of an apodized aperture for receiving a data-carrying orbital-angular-momentum beam
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an apodized aperture for receiving OAM beams carrying 50-Gbaud QPSK channels. The performance in terms of power in desired mode and leakage to neighboring modes is compared with a hard aperture.

articleTitle: Synchronization phenomena in modelocked parametric frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the modelocking dynamics in parametric frequency combs is equivalent to synchronization phenomena that occur in many physical systems as described by the Kuramoto model for coupled oscillators.

articleTitle: Open-access microcavities for optofluidic sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Open-access microcavities are an original approach for lab-on-a-chip optofluidic sensing since they offer a direct access to the confined electromagnetic field. This work describes their basic characteristics for refractive index and nanoparticle sensing.

articleTitle: Ultra-long fibre-based random lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The emerging science and applications of ultra-long random fibre lasers will be overviewed. The lasers with cavity length up to several hundred km exploit random distributed feedback provided by Rayleigh scattering amplified through Raman effect.

articleTitle: Kerr-lens mode-locked femtosecond mid-IR laser oscillations in polycrystalline Cr2+:ZnSe and Cr2+:ZnS
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate Kerr-lens mode-locked polycrystalline Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnSe and Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnS lasers with estimated pulse duration of 125 fs, 160 MHz pulse repetition rate and output power of 60 mW (Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnSe) and 30 mW (Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnS).

articleTitle: Coherent plasmonics: Optimized for sensing and energy transfer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Metallic nanostructures give rise to bright and dark plasmon modes, and through their interactions can support a variety of coherent phenomena more typically associated with atomic systems, providing new sensing and energy transfer strategies.

articleTitle: Locally and reversibly control the coupling of photonic crystal cavities using photochromic tuning
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a method to control the coupling interaction in a coupled-cavity photonic crystal molecule by using a local and reversible photochromic tuning technique. This method is promising for development of integrated photonic devices with large number of cavities.

articleTitle: Highly-directional plasmonic lasing in the visible with subwavelength hole arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate directional plasmonic nanolaser emission using subwavelength hole arrays perforated in metal film as plasmonic nanocavities. The lasing exhibits a single mode in the red wavelength region.

articleTitle: Power-controllable multicasting of a single Gaussian mode to multiple orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate power-controllable multicasting of OFDM 64-QAM signal from single Gaussian mode to multiple OAM modes using a single phase-only spatial light modulator assisted by a feedback control. The precision of power control is less than 1 dB.

articleTitle: Optical properties on demand: Reconfigurable and coherently controlled metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transmission and reflection properties, anisotropy, chirality, optical nonlinearity and luminescent of metamaterials can be controlled at will using dynamic nanostructures reconfigurable with electromagnetic forces or by exploiting structured illumination with coherent light.

articleTitle: Absorption enhancement and electrical transport in thin-film solar cells with randomly rough textures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: With rigorous electro-optical calculations we study randomly rough silicon solar cells approaching the Lambertian Limit of absorption. We determine the efficiency dependence on the absorber thickness and discuss the role of surface recombination.

articleTitle: Whispering gallery mode biosensing using back-scattered light
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new technique for whispering gallery mode biosensing involving direct detection of the back-scattered light. This results in suppressing laser frequency noise by 27 dB, and gives an absolute sensitivity of 76 kHz.

articleTitle: Feedback-enhanced entanglement of photons from a biexciton cascade
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The entanglement of photons from a biexciton cascade is strongly diminished by exciton fine-structure splitting. We demonstrate an optical feedback mechanism to counteract this loss and to control the photon entanglement.

articleTitle: Optical magnetometry of single NV center scanning local magnetic field in micro fluid devices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By combining magnetic nanoparticle 3D positioning system and NV ESR measurements in micro-fluid device, we demonstrate sensing of magnetic fringe field of a magnetic bead repeatedly displaced and mapping field profile of the magnetic dipole.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a variable bandwidth, shape and center-frequency RF photonics filter using a continuously tunable optical tapped-delay-line and having an optical output
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the RF photonics filter using optical tapped delay line based on an optical frequency comb and a PPLN waveguide as the multiplexer. RF filters with variable bandwidth, shape and center-frequency are implemented.

articleTitle: Nano-patterning based on two-surface-plasmon-polariton-absorption using 400nm femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nano-patterning with linewidth of ∼55 nm is demonstrated utilizing two-surface-plasmon-polariton-absorption (TSPPA) at the wavelength of 400 nm. The SPP field generated by plasmonic mircolens is recorded by the TSPPA showing a new way for recording the SPP field in micro/nano structures.

articleTitle: Twisting light using nano-waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that an array of subwavelength channels with a spiral size distribution milled in a metal film can be used to manipulate the phase front of light beam and produce a vortex beam.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic demonstration of optical frequency division for erbium silicon photonics integrated oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using fiber-optic components, we demonstrate an optical frequency division scheme for a proposed erbium silicon photonics integrated oscillator. An 80-dB division ratio from 192 THz to 1 GHz is achieved without an f-2f interferometer and carrier-envelope-phase locking.

articleTitle: Silicon wire refractive index characterization using microring resonator effective length from interferograms
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The optical low-coherence interferometry built with an optical ruler was proposed to demonstrate silicon-wire transverse-magnetic polarized indices of refraction and birefringence as 2.02 and 0.64, respectively, from the microring resonator effective length using various interferograms.

articleTitle: Metal-clad subwavelength semiconductor lasers with temperature-insensitive spontaneous hyper-emission
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Accounting for the temperature dependence of the cavity resonances and gain medium, we investigate a metal-clad subwavelength semiconductor laser with a spontaneous emission factor, β, approaching unity for all temperatures.

articleTitle: Robust multimaterial tellurium-based chalcogenide glass infrared fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the scalable production of the first robust tellurium-based chalcogenide glass fibers provided with a built-in polymer jacket and transmit mid-wave and long-wave infrared light across the 3 – 12 micron window.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of light induced conical intersections in a diatomic molecule
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe quantum interferences in the angular distributions of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> photodissociation arising from the geometric singularity induced by strong laser fields. This is the first experimental observation of light induced conical intersections in diatomic molecules.

articleTitle: Photon-efficient high-dimensional quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate two high-dimensional QKD protocols - secure against collective Gaussian attacks - yielding up to 8.6 secure bits per photon and 6.7 Mb/s throughput, with 6.9 bits per photon after transmission through 20 km of fiber.

articleTitle: High-responsivity 1.7-µm-long InGaAs photodetectors based on photonic crystal with ultrasmall buried heterostructure
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: InGaAs-embedded photonic crystal photodetectors were demonstrated towards realizing photoreceivers with small junction capacitance. A 1-A/W responsivity and a 40-Gb/s eye opening were successfully confirmed for the 1.7-μm-long device.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic EFPI/FBG dual sensor for monitoring of radiofrequency thermal ablation of liver tumors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A dual extrinsic Fabry-Perot interferometer fibre Bragg grating (EFPI/FBG) pressure and temperature sensing architecture, biocompatible and with minimum cross-sensitivity, is presented. The system performs online monitoring of radiofrequency thermal ablation in liver tumor, detecting the physical phenomena; ex-vivo experiments are reported.

articleTitle: Enhancing refractive index sensing capability with infrared plasmonic perfect absorbers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an infrared refractive index sensor based on plasmonic perfect absorbers for glucose concentration sensing, with the figure of merit (FOM*) around 55 and a bulk wavelength sensitivity around 600nm/RIU.

articleTitle: Hand-Held plasmonic biosensor for high-throughput sensing for point-of-care applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a hand-held biosensor based on large-area plasmonic microarrays coupled with a lens-free computational imaging system for high-throughput biosensing. Our light-weight device, 60 g and 7.5 cm, is highly suitable for point-of-care applications for field-settings.

articleTitle: Analysis and experiments on harmonic mode locking in an optical microcavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated harmonic mode locking in a microcavity with split-step Fourier method and demonstrated it experimentally. Harmonic mode locking in an ultra-small cavity allows us to obtain ultra-high repetition rate pulse trains.

articleTitle: Sub-diffraction imaging via surface plasmon decompression
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically propose a novel scheme for sub-diffraction imaging based on a process of adiabatic decompression of the local wavelength of a surface plasmon polariton supported by two adjoining curved metal surfaces.

articleTitle: Photodetectors based on atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present phototransistors based on atomically thin layers of molybdenum disulfide and van der Waals heterostructures of transition metal dichalcogenides.

articleTitle: Hybrid plasmonic strip and slot waveguides for deep subwavelength nanofocusing of TE and TM modes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We identify a hybrid plasmonic slot waveguide capable of millimetre range transport and deep subwavelength nanofocusing by varying slot width. Convenient integration with the SOI platform provides an important bridge between plasmonics and silicon photonics.

articleTitle: Optical broadband angular selectivity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We tailor the overlap of the bandgaps of multiple one-dimensional photonic crystals, each with a different periodicity, in such a way we enables transparency throughout the visible spectrum at one angle, the generalized Brewster angle, and reflection at every other viewing angle.

articleTitle: Ultrafast beam modulation and delivery for embossing and digital printing applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optimized ps laser processing is used to improve laser engraving of embossing rollers. The optimized ablation process is characterized by the condition that the ablation depth of a single pulse is just as deep as the effective penetration depth of the energy. In this case the fluence F of the pulse is only a little above the threshold fluence e.g. for a top hat beam F = e · Fth. High power fiber laser combined with ultrafast modulation and scanning techniques are used for digital printing based on laser induced forward transfer (LIFT). We demonstrated the large area printing at scan speed up to 2100 m/s for screen resolutions of 600 dpi on different common substrates and with common inks from the printing industry.

articleTitle: Soliton trapping in a Tm fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Soliton trapping is demonstrated in an all-fiber Tm fiber laser. The central wavelength shift between the two orthogonal polarized components of the vector soliton is determined by the cavity birefringence.

articleTitle: Atom interferometry in an optical cavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate interference fringes using the first atom interferometer in an optical cavity. We discuss the advantages of using an optical cavity and applications ranging from inertial sensors to tests of gravity in quantum mechanics.

articleTitle: Aperiodic single-pixel angle-modulated plasmonic color sorter and angle sensor
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the design, simulation and experimental realization of a single aperiodic slit-groove plasmonic device that exhibits angle-selectable RGB color response at optical frequencies, as well as a high quality factor and optical contrast.

articleTitle: Multi-kHz, high energy, femtosecond diode-pumped Yb:CaF2 regenerative amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an efficient, high-energy, diode-pumped Yb:CaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> regenerative amplifier. Energies up to 1.02 mJ at 1045-nm and 5 kHz-repetition rate in 324 fs-long pulses have been obtained with a beam quality factor of M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> =1.1.

articleTitle: Topological edge states in silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the robustness of topological edge states in a photonic system of coupled microring resonators. Using direct imaging and transmission analysis, we show that the edge states are robust to lattice disorders.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of nonlinear carrier-envelope phase changes in hollow fiber compression
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a single-shot, in-situ interferometric method for measuring phase changes experienced by laser pulses upon nonlinear propagation. With this method we characterized the intensity-dependent phase fluctuations emerging in hollow fiber compressors.

articleTitle: Sub-4-cycle pulses directly from an all-collinear, high-repetition-rate, mid-IR OPCPA
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an ultra-broadband OPCPA system operating at 3.4 μm delivering 41.6-fs pulses. The average output power is currently 600 mW, corresponding to 12 μJ of pulse energy at a repetition rate of 50 kHz.

articleTitle: Compact subwavelength cavities using reflecting metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Subwavelength cavities are obtained by replacing conventional mirrors with reflecting metasurfaces that introduce arbitrary phase-shifts compensating for reduced accumulated phase through the ultra-small cavity. 100-nm cavities showed resonance in the range (0.6 – 1.1µm).

articleTitle: Simulation of two-mode squeezing in photonic waveguide lattices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show how classical light can be used to simulate a nonclassical quantum process. Specially modulated optical waveguides were utilized to emulate two-mode squeezed vacuum states as the light amplitudes in our arrays correspond to the photon number distribution of the squeezed states. In our experiments demonstrate a transition from photon number growth to periodic Bloch oscillations for increased phase mismatch.

articleTitle: Shape optimization of nanophotonic devices using the adjoint method
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use an adjoint method integrated with a classical Maxwell solver to optimize several nanophotonic devices, providing an adaptable and efficient tool for photonics design.

articleTitle: Broadband mode-evolution-based four-port polarizing beam splitter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The first demonstration of a four-port integrated polarizing beam splitter is reported. The device was fabricated on a silicon-on-insulator platform and exhibits crosstalk level < −10dB over a 150nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: New techniques in optical trapping and sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Micrometer-sized dielectric scatterers suspended in fluid can act as sensitive, dynamic probes of surface forces and optical near-fields. We demonstrate several new techniques that expand our current capabilities of optical trapping and sensing. This includes the use of nearly diffractionless beams for particle confinement, effective optical traps for particles with lower index than surrounding fluid, and high precision tweezing and sensing near reflective/metallic surfaces. Finally, we demonstrate the application of a combination of these techniques in the successful measurement of near-field optical and double-layer forces.

articleTitle: Nanobeam photonic crystal cavity based multifunctional gas-phase chemical sensor
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By applying chemical functionalization to a nanobeam photonic crystal cavity, an ultrasensitive gas-phase chemical sensor was demonstrated. Its nonlinear thermo-optical bi-stability is utilized to realize a novel threshold detector for cumulative chemical exposure.

articleTitle: Electronic switching mechanism in aperiodic DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: For the first time, we present direct experimental evidence of the presence of spatial hole burning within switchable aperiodic DFB terahertz quantum cascade lasers. This will lead towards the development of quasicontinuous tuneable terahertz lasers.

articleTitle: Large photo-induced group delay variations in chalcogenide-on-silicon Mach-Zehnder interferometers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The rapid post-fabrication trimming of the group index in hybrid chalcogenide-onsilicon Mach-Zehnder interferometers is demonstrated. Index changes of 0.065 are achieved through photo-induced mass transfer in an As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">90</sub> layer.

articleTitle: Tilted transmission grisms for pulse compression with dispersion control up to the fourth order
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a grism compressor designed to compensate the second, third and fourth order dispersions of a 1.5m SF57 stretcher at 800nm.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of near-infrared epsilon-near-zero multilayer metamaterial slabs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Near-infrared epsilon-near-zero metamaterial slabs based on Ag-Ge multilayers are experimentally demonstrated and numerically analyzed. A post-annealing process and multilayer grating structures are introduced to reduce the optical loss and also tune the epsilon-near-zero wavelength.

articleTitle: Boosting the photon-extraction efficiency of nanophotonic structures by deterministic microlenses
