abstract: The use of ultrafast laser writing for fabricating advanced 3D waveguide components is presented and demonstrated. Couplers for space division multiplexing allowing beyond Shannon limit spectral efficiency, and 3D hybrid integration capabilities are discussed.

articleTitle: Colliding quasiparticles with intense terahertz fields
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong quasi-cw terahertz fields accelerate and recollide electron-hole pairs injected by a near-ir laser into GaAs quantum wells. A frequency comb is emitted, with up to 18 teeth separated by twice the terahertz frequency.

articleTitle: Non-invasive 3D optical imaging of tissue microstructure and microcirculations in vivo
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the ability of OCT microangiography to visualize tissue blood flow at capillary level for a variety of biomedical applications, some of which (along with the OCT basics and the enabling technologies) will be highlighted.

articleTitle: Silicon-chip mid-infrared frequency comb generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first on-chip integrated mid-infrared frequency comb using a silicon optical parametric oscillator ring resonator. We demonstrate a 750-nm-wide comb centered at 2.6 um.

articleTitle: Low-loss, low return-loss coupling between SMF and single-mode, hollow-core fibers using connectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the first low-loss, low-return-loss FC/PC connector for a single-mode, hollow-core fiber. Connector loss of 0.3dB and return loss of -31.3dB was measured, and a 200m HCF jumper with connectors on both ends was fabricated.

articleTitle: Monolithic travelling-wave Mach-Zehnder transmitter with high-swing stacked CMOS driver
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a 20 Gb/s monolithically integrated transmitter with stacked CMOS driver and periodic-loaded PN-junction Mach-Zehnder modulator fabricated in IBM's sub-100nm technology node. Transmitter extinction ratios of 10 dB at 20 Gb/s are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Commercially packaged optical true-time-delay devices with record delays of wide bandwidth signals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Commercially packaged optical true-time-delay devices were developed utilizing ultra-low loss silicon nitride microresonators, achieving record tunable delay of 535ps for a 20GHz wide signal, 632ps for a 10GHz wide signal, with tunable loss of 3dB.

articleTitle: Single-shot ultrafast imaging using parallax-free alignment with a tilted lenslet array
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate single-shot, two-dimensional imaging of ultrafast phenomena using a streak camera and a tilted lenslet array. We derive conditions for parallax-free imaging and experimentally verify the geometry by observing scattering of femtosecond pulses.

articleTitle: High-brightness single-mode tapered laser diodes with laterally coupled high-order surface grating
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 913 nm tapered diode lasers with 23th order laterally coupled grating is fabricated. Power of over 560 mW/facet and lateral divergence angle of 2.1° are achieved. Measured side mode suppression ratio is about 27 dB.

articleTitle: A multimode fiber-coupled photon-counting optical receiver for the Lunar Laser Communication Demonstration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We designed and successfully demonstrated a multimode fiber-coupled photon-counting optical receiver at 1550 nm for the Lunar Laser Communications Demonstration that achieves low coupling loss through atmospheric turbulence without requiring adaptive optics.

articleTitle: Generation of SSB optical signals with dual-EML modulated with wideband OFDM
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The generation of optical SSB signals by a Dual-EML is generalized for wideband modulating signals. The feasibility of the proposed technique is demonstrated by transmitting 5.3 GHz baseband OFDM signal in an optical SSB context.

articleTitle: Hyper-dimensional analysis for label-free high-throughput imaging flow cytometry
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an imaging flow cytometer capable of capturing phase and intensity images of individual unlabeled cells at 36 million frames/second to generate multi-dimensional scatter plots, leading to a considerable enhancement in cell classification sensitivity.

articleTitle: Management of slow light dispersion and delay time characteristics with SNAP bottle resonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The nanoscale radius variation of a bottle microresonator with the required dispersion characteristics is determined theoretically. Experimentally, a microresonator with the footprint 0.08 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> exhibiting 20 ns/nm dispersion compensation of 100 ps pulses is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Transmitter sensitivity to high PAPR in coherent optical OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate degradation of QPSK CO-OFDM system due to components most susceptible to high PAPR. We vary transmitter design parameters and uncover appropriate working conditions and clipping effectiveness regions.

articleTitle: Spectral linewidth reduction of single-mode and mode-locked lasers using a feed-forward heterodyne detection scheme
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel feed-forward laser linewidth reduction scheme. The linewidth of a DFB laser is reduced from 9.4MHz to 37.2kHz. Sixteen modes of a mode-locked laser are simultaneously reduced from ~20MHz to below 300kHz.

articleTitle: A receiver for the Lunar Laser Communication Demonstration using the optical communications telescope laboratory
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss the design and implementation of a receiver for the Lunar Laser Communication Demonstration based on a 12-pixel array of tungsten silicide superconducting nanowire single photon detectors. The receiver was used to close a software communication link from lunar orbit at 39 and 79 Mbps.

articleTitle: Free-space 120 Gb/s reconfigurable card-to-card optical wireless interconnects with 16-CAP modulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper, we propose and experimentally demonstrate reconfigurable card-to-card optical wireless interconnects architecture with 16-Carrierless-Amplitude/Phase modulation. Results show that 3×40 Gb/s interconnection is achieved with 2 mW transmission power.

articleTitle: In vivo three-photon calcium imaging of brain activity from layer 6 neurons in mouse brain
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate three-photon microscopy (3PM) at 1300-nm excitation for imaging neuronal activity as deep as layer-6 (L6) of adult mouse cortex using genetically-encoded calcium indicators. In vivo imaging of subcortical, GFP-labeled neurons is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Error-free 25-Gbit/s direct modulation of lateral-current-injection DFB laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a lateral-current-injection InP-based DFB laser consisting of a pn junction fabricated by using Zn thermal diffusion and Si ion implantation. An error-free direct modulation with a bit rate of 25 Gbit/s is achieved.

articleTitle: Photonic generation and wireless transmission of W-band arbitrary waveforms with high time-bandwidth products
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report photonic radio-frequency arbitrary waveform generation in the W-band, enabled through optical pulse shaping and a near-ballistic uni-traveling-carrier photodiode. Example waveforms spanning 75-110GHz with long time apertures are generated and measured after wireless propagation.

articleTitle: 25 Gb/s data transmission over a 1.4 m long multimode polymer spiral waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Data transmission studies of a 1.4 m long multimode polymer spiral waveguide using an 850 nm VCSEL are presented. Error-free 25 Gb/s data transmission is demonstrated over that waveguide length, achieving a record bandwidth-length product of 21 GHz×m.

articleTitle: Crosstalk in a ROADM supporting spatial superchannels for space division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report crosstalk measurements among spatially-multiplexed subchannels in a ROADM supporting spatial superchannels. Aggregate crosstalk can reach −23dB when express paths are routed on adjacent fibers, but >6dB improvement results when paths are interleaved.

articleTitle: First demonstration of single trench fiber for delocalization of higher order modes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an ytterbium-doped single-trench fiber ensuring a high losses ratio (~1000) and low power fraction (~0.7) between the higher-order-modes and fundamental-mode with excellent bend robustness and 85% laser efficiency at a wavelength of 1040nm.

articleTitle: Photonic RF-channelized receiver based on wideband parametric mixers and coherent detection
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a photonic RF-channelized receiver based on parametric multicasting and LO generation. Using frequency locking and coherent detection, contiguous channelization of 12 sub-channels is achieved covering 24-30GHz. System analysis and characterizations are presented.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of optical regeneration of DP-BPSK/QPSK using polarization-diversity PSA
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally investigate a polarization-diversity phase-sensitive amplifier (PSA) for phase regeneration of 25-Gbaud DP-BPSK and DP-QPSK signals and show effective reduction on phase noise in both polarizations. BER measurements and reduced phase noise are achieved for both polarizations.

articleTitle: 1 Joule, 100 Hz repetition rate, picosecond CPA laser for driving high average power soft x-ray lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A diode-pumped cryogenic Yb:YAG CPA laser that produces 1J, 5ps pulses allowed for the first time the uninterrupted generation of 1.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> sub-20nm wavelength laser pulses with microjoule energy at 100Hz repetition rate on a table-top.

articleTitle: Coincidence detection with graphene excitable laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a photonic coincidence detection circuit with a graphene excitable laser. This technology is a potential candidate for applications in novel all-optical devices for information processing and computing.

articleTitle: Add-drop microring resonator for electro-optical switching and optical power monitoring
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Microring based silicon depletion modulators with high extinction ratios (>25dB) are used for high frequency modulation and as resonant photodetectors at 1340nm (O-band). Photocurrent and power enhancement are investigated for mircorings with different Q-factors.

articleTitle: Distributed electrode Mach-Zehnder modulator with double-pass phase shifters and integrated inductors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel high-speed Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM) fully integrated into a 90 nm CMOS process is presented. The MZM features ‘double-pass’ optical phase shifter segments, and the first use of integrated inductors in a ‘velocity-matched’ distributed-electrode configuration.

articleTitle: Latch-to-latch CMOS-driven optical link at 28 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 3.4-pJ/bit CMOS-driven VCSEL link incorporating latched half-rate inputs and outputs operating error-free at 28 Gb/s over a few meters of multimode fiber.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous integration on silicon
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Aurrion's heterogeneous integration process enables high performance active components such as lasers, modulators, and photodetectors to be elegantly integrated on a silicon photonics platform with high performance passive components.

articleTitle: High temperature sensor based on supermode interference in multicore fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high temperature fiber optic sensor based on multicore fiber is presented. Experimental results show the sensor operating stably at temperatures up to 1000°C with the capability to multiplex sensors in a single chain.

articleTitle: Generation of a train of ultrashort pulses by simply inserting transparent plates on the optical path
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate generation of a train of ultrashort pulses with a nearly TL pulse duration of 1.78 fs by simply inserting transparent plates on the optical axis and adjusting their thicknesses precisely.

articleTitle: High-speed flow imaging utilizing spectral-encoding of ultrafast pulses and compressed sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using chirp processing and pseudorandom bit modulation we demonstrate high-speed structured illumination for compressed sensing imaging of 1-D flows.

articleTitle: Optical nonlinearities in high confinement SiC waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate strong nonlinearities of n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> = 8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> in single crystal silicon carbide at a wavelength of 2360nm. We use a high confinement SiC waveguide fabricated using a modified smart-cut process.

articleTitle: Maximally efficient imaging through multimode fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Polarization diverse images are generated at the end of a multimode fiber using spatial light modulators to completely characterize propagation through the fiber in terms of the eigenmodes.

articleTitle: Novel BCH code design for mitigation of phase noise induced cycle slips in DQPSK systems
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that by proper code design, phase noise induced cycle slips causing an error floor can be mitigated for 28 Gbaud DQPSK systems. Performance of BCH codes are investigated in terms of required overhead.

articleTitle: Generation of CW terahertz waves in the 3 THz range using a MZM-based flat comb generator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: THz waves in the 3 THz range have been generated by photonic down-conversion using a Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator. THz waves were detected by a hot electron bolometer mixer with a quantum cascade laser.

articleTitle: A high-Q tunable interior-ridge microring filter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tunable interior-ridge microring filter is demonstrated with a high quality factor of 1.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>, while achieving a thermal tuning efficiency of 5.5µW/GHz. The filter demonstrates a record low insertion-loss <0.05dB over an uncorrupted 4-THz free-spectral-range.

articleTitle: Spatially and temporally resolved imaging of modal content in photonic-bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The principles of spatially and spectrally resolved (S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) imaging are extended to include spectral phase information which yields a measurement which is resolved both spatially and temporally (S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sup>).

articleTitle: Progress towards a near IR single-photon superconducting nanowire camera for free-space imaging of light
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe our progress towards building a free-space coupled array of nanowire detectors with a multiplexed readout. The cryogenic, optical, and electronic packaging to readout the array will be discussed.

articleTitle: 50% power conversion efficiency on a non-oxide VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Over 50% power conversion efficiency (PCE) has been reached in an oxide-free VCSEL. VCSELs with very small size (2 μm) have shown high single transverse mode selectivity and good lasing characteristics.

articleTitle: 1.3 kW average output power Yb:YAG thin-disk multipass amplifier for multi-mJ picosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An Yb:YAG thin-disk multipass amplifier delivering sub-8 ps laser pulses with an average output power of 1.3 kW at a repetition rate of 300 kHz, corresponding to a pulse energy of 4.4 mJ is presented.

articleTitle: Novel polarization-assisted phase sensitive optical signal processor requiring low nonlinear phase shifts
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new scheme to achieve binary step-like phase response and high phase-sensitive extinction ratio at low powers. Phase-sensitive operation is achieved by polarization filtering phase-locked signal/idler in a degenerate dual-pump vector parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Simultaneous ranging and remote sensing utilizing chirped laser dispersion spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Simultaneous ranging and laser-spectroscopic gas-sensing is demonstrated for the first time with a non-pulsed sensing technique. Besides remote sensing, spectroscopy with highly multi-mode cells will become calibration-free. Extension to a simultaneous multi-path measurement is possible.

articleTitle: Electrical, parametric down-conversion methodology for high-speed, low-noise, and narrow-bandwidth photodetection
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate methods to modulate the photodiode responsivity for high-speed photodetection, i.e., parametric down-conversion. Electrical modulation is preferred over optical modulation and gives near optimum efficiency of ∼20%. Applications are near- and mid-infrared spectroscopy methods.

articleTitle: Silicon on lithium niobate: A hybrid electro-optical platform for near- and mid-infrared photonics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A thin layer of silicon is transferred onto a lithium niobate substrate, forming a hybrid electro-optical platform, on which ring resonators are fabricated and characterized at 1550 nm, showing an optical loss of 3.0±0.5 dB/cm.

articleTitle: Compact 10 TW laser to generate multi-filament arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The design and construction of a compact 10 TW Ti:sapphire CPA system for the generation of filament arrays is presented. The design and implementation challenges are discussed, in particular the optimization of beam quality.

articleTitle: Ceramic Cr:ZnS laser mode-locked by graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a high-power graphene mode-locked ceramic Cr:ZnS-laser, producing 3.9 nJ, 140 fs pulses with 45 nm spectral bandwidth at 270 MHz repetition rate, at output power for the first time exceeding 1 W level.

articleTitle: Octave spanning mid-infrared frequency comb generation in silicon nanophotonic wire waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A mid-infrared octave spanning frequency comb is generated in a silicon waveguide. By beating the generated comb on a photodetector with a narrow linewidth light source the linewidth of the lines is measured to be <;100kHz.

articleTitle: Spectro-temporal characterization of all channels in a sub-optical-cycle parametric waveform synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present FROG characterization of all three amplification channels of a two-stage sub-optical-cycle parametric waveform synthesizer covering more than two octaves in bandwidth. A flexible dispersion compensation scheme will permit compression at the multi-mJ level.

articleTitle: Efficient FIR filter configuration to joint IQ imbalance and carrier-phase recovery in 16-QAM coherent receivers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose an efficient configuration of FIR-filter for joint quadrature-imbalance (IQ) compensation and carrier-phase-recovery 16-QAM optical coherent receivers. Through computer simulation we demonstrate proposed scheme can mitigate wide-range of phase-noise and IQ-mismatch of optical front-end.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable optical sub-harmonic clock recovery based on inverse temporal self-imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel, simple and efficient sub-harmonic optical clock recovery technique from RZ-OOK data based on temporal self-imaging, involving temporal phase modulation and dispersion, with a reconfigurable rate division factor.

articleTitle: Bandwidth tunable, high suppression RF photonic filter with improved insertion loss
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a scheme for minimising the insertion loss of an RF photonic filter, by exploiting the phase response of stimulated Brillouin scattering. We achieve a filter with high suppression, tunable bandwidth and low loss.

articleTitle: Optical quilt packaging: A new chip-to-chip optical coupling and alignment process for modular sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A wide-bandwidth, highly efficient method of inter-chip waveguide coupling suitable for on-chip, mid-infrared sensing is discussed. Simulations and preliminary fabrication work on laser-to-waveguide coupling are presented, with losses predicted to be better than 6 dB.

articleTitle: Intrinsic temperature compensation of interferometric and polarimetric fiber-optic current sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally demonstrate a method to achieve insensitivity to temperature to within <;±0.1% from -40 to 85°C for fiber-optic current sensors with dynamic and static phase biasing and different types of sensing fiber.

articleTitle: All-optical demultiplexing of Nyquist OTDM using a Nyquist gate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an approach to all-optical demultiplexing of ultrafast Nyquist OTDM signals using four-wave mixing with a Nyquist gate. Our design does not suffer from the tradeoff between SNR and ISI of existing approaches.

articleTitle: Active stabilization and continuous phase control of time-bin entanglement interferometers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a technique for stabilizing and enabling continuous phase control of fiber-based time-bin entanglement interferometers. This technique reuses the pair creation pump, which coexists with and co-propagates with the entangled photons.

articleTitle: Fiber-seeded, 10-ps, 2050-nm, multi-mJ, cryogenic Ho:YLF CPA
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the first picosecond cryogenic Ho:YLF CPA system with Er:Tm:Ho fiber seeder. The system delivers energy-scalable 13-mJ pulses with 10-ps duration at 100 Hz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Simulating atmospheric turbulence using a spatial light modulator based on Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an atmospheric turbulence simulator based on a spatial light modulator, using phase screens generated by Fourier Transform method. The effects of different atmospheric turbulence on laser beam are successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Orbit angular momentum multiplexing in 0.1-THz free-space communication via 3D printed spiral phase plates
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a proof of concept demonstration of THz free-space communication employing orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing. Two different OAM modes are multiplexed and de-multiplexed in experiment via 3D printed spiral phase plates.

articleTitle: Quantum random number generation using spontaneous raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate a quantum random bit-string at 650kb/s by frequency binning spontaneous Raman scattered photons from a highly-nonlinear As2S3 glass detected using superconducting single photon detectors. The bit-sequences pass all the NIST statistical randomness tests.

articleTitle: Real-time absolute frequency measurement of CW-THz wave based on dual THz combs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a frequency measurement of CW-THz wave referring to dual THz frequency comb in real time. The absolute frequency of the CW-THz wave is measured with an accuracy of 3.5*10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> 10ms each.

articleTitle: Rapid, wideband cavity ringdown spectroscopy for the detection of explosives
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present results from a variant of CRDS that allows large spectral bandwidths to be analysed in real time. We have applied the technique to the analysis and detection of explosives and related compounds.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of the coexistence of continuous-variable quantum key distribution with an intense DWDM classical channel
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have experimentally performed continuous variable quantum key distribution over up to 50 km, in coexistence with a dense-wavelength-multiplexed channel of several dBms. This opens new perspectives for QKD integration over existing optical network architectures.

articleTitle: Time-to-frequency conversion based on nonlinear pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A precise time-to-frequency conversion based on nonlinear pulse shaping is demonstrated. Simulation results also show the scheme can be applied to arbitrary waveform.

articleTitle: Phase-locked multicore fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Arraying fiber lasers is being focused for power and energy scaling and multicore fibers can be a promising format. Phase locking in evanescently-coupled multicore fiber lasers by various in-phase mode selection methods is presented.

articleTitle: Passive Q-switching of a diode-pumped Tm,Ho:YLF laser using Cr:ZnSe saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on passive Q-switching of a Tm,Ho:LiYF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> laser with Cr:ZnSe saturable absorber achieving for the first time short (∼50 ns) pulse durations and high (∼640 W) peak power from such a diode-pumped Ho-laser.

articleTitle: Nonlinear-optical-loop-mirror-based, phase-preserving 2R regeneration of a high-duty-cycle RZ-DPSK signal
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use a NOLM with a directional attenuator for regeneration of 50% duty-cycle RZ-DPSK signal and demonstrate eye-opening improvement of 1.5 dB for a signal degraded by a combination of ASE noise and amplitude jitter.

articleTitle: Dynamic displacement measurement system with auto calibration using deeply-phase modulated light
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate dynamic displacement measurement with phase-modulated light. Auto calibration using deep phase modulation makes the measurement independent of driving conditions of the modulator. Displacement of several tens nm for more-than-1-MHz vibration is successfully measured.

articleTitle: Stimulated emission tomography
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the reconstruction of the polarization state of entangled photon pairs by stimulated emission tomography.

articleTitle: Controlling the phase front of optical fiber beams using high contrast metastructures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The phase of optical beams can be modified by high contrast sub-wavelength periodic structures with gradually varying geometrical features. We present design, simulation, fabrication and characterization of planar micro-lenses shaping the beam of optical fibers.

articleTitle: Real-time broadband spectroscopic terahertz imaging with diffraction grating and high-sensitivity terahertz camera
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a broadband THz spectroscopic imaging method using intense THz pulses and a high-sensitivity THz camera. By using a diffraction grating spectrometer, real-time spectroscopic imaging, or molecular-specific imaging, is realized.

articleTitle: On-chip heralded single photon source with demultiplexing and pump filtering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an on-chip source of correlated photons with spatial demultiplexing of signal and idler photons via ring resonators and with pump suppression greater than 60 decibels.

articleTitle: Wideband-tunable optical resonators on double-layer SOI platforms using electrostatic actuation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present mechanically-tunable microdisk resonators using electrostatic actuation in double-layer-SOI material platform. The possibility of achieving resonance wavelength shifts as-high-as 5.5 nm/volt and 1.35 nm/nm over a wavelength tuning range of 35 nm is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Scalable single-photon detection on a photonic chip
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a scalable method for integrating sub-70-ps-timing-jitter superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors with photonic integrated circuits. We assembled a photonic chip with four integrated detectors and performed the first on-chip g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(τ)-measurements of an entangled-photon source.

articleTitle: Quantum repeater for spectrally entangled photons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a quantum repeater architecture for spectrally entangled photons based on sum frequency. The repeater, which does not require a conventional quantum memory, includes a novel scheme for re-using unconverted photons.

articleTitle: Pulse compression by dynamic control of slow light in dispersion-tunable photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optical pulse compression by using two slow light in Si photonic crystal waveguide. Enhanced nonlinearity by slow light and tunable dispersion by integrated heaters achieved the compression from 8.6 to 2.6 ps.

articleTitle: Fifth power scaling of quality factor in silicon photonic degenerate band edge resonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe experimentally a transition of quality factor scaling from third power to fifth power of the number of periods in periodic silicon optical waveguides designed to exhibit a degenerate band edge.

articleTitle: Nanotube mode-locked, low repetition rate pulse source for fiber-based supercontinuum generation at low average pump power
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a nanotube mode-locked fiber laser with low repetition rate (244 kHz), enabling supercontinuum generation in photonic crystal fiber spanning 600 to 2000 nm, at a low average pump power of 87 mW.

articleTitle: Red to near-infrared emission from InGaN/GaN quantum-disks-in-nanowires LED
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The InGaN/GaN quantum-disks-in-nanowire light-emitting diode (LED) with emission centered at ∼830nm, the longest emission wavelength ever reported in the InGaN/GaN system, and spectral linewidth of 290nm, has been fabricated with p-side-down on a Cu substrate.

articleTitle: Multi-step pattern-recognition: a powerful tool for substance identification based on real-world terahertz-spectra
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Combining different chemometric tools we demonstrate the reliable identification of substances out of real-world terahertz-spectra. Systematic evaluation of the spectra allows for the distinction between spectral properties arising from samples geometry versus true material absorption.

articleTitle: Wavelength conversion in low loss Si3N4 waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show wavelength conversion in a compact Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> waveguide. Combining low loss, long length, relatively large nonlinear coefficient, high-power handling and absence of two-photon absorption, this platform is promising for integrated nonlinear optics applications.

articleTitle: Nanowire superconducting single photon detectors progress and promise
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Since the first reported detection of a single photon using a superconducting nanowire in 2001, rapid progress has been made in the development and application of superconducting nanowire single photon detectors (SNSPD or SSPD). I will briefly describe use of these detectors in new applications, progress in detector developments, and describe areas of research and their potential impact.

articleTitle: Laser scribing of CIGS based thin films solar cells
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser scribing tests on CIGS based thin films solar cells have been performed. The obtained high quality incisions show that laser scribing is a valuable tool for producing low-cost photovoltaic modules.

articleTitle: A 380 fs, 40 GHz mode-locked erbium fiber laser with an MQW nonlinear PM/AM modulator using the pockels effect and the QCSE
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have successfully generated a 380 fs pulse train at 40 GHz from an actively mode-locked erbium fiber laser with an InGaAlAs/InAlAs MQW nonlinear PM/AM modulator using the Pockels effect and the quantum confined Stark effect.

articleTitle: The monolithic heterogeneous integration of GaAs PIN photodiode and Si CMOS-based transimpedance amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This article describes a GaAs PIN photodiode was directly grown on a Si substrate in which CMOS-based transimpedance amplifier (TIA) was fabricated using general Si CMOS process. This monolithic integration device was successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: James Webb Space Telescope (JWST): Optical performance of a large deployable cryogenic telescope
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The JWST is a large deployable cryogenic telescope. The fabrication of the mirrors and the precision control for flight positioning of the mirrors using image based Wave Front Sensing and Control will be presented.

articleTitle: Active Coherent Laser Spectrometer (ACLaS) for standoff detection of chemicals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An active spectrometer has been developed based on diffuse backscattering by solid targets combined with coherent detection and mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers. High selectivity and sensitivity have been shown at standoff distances of 40 m.

articleTitle: A white-light-seeded front end for ultra-intense optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultra-intense optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification (OPCPA) requires a high-performance front end at 910 nm. Progress on developing a white-light-seeded chain of noncollinear optical parametric amplifiers (NOPA's) and a cylindrical Offner stretcher is presented.

articleTitle: Observation of Floquet-Bloch states on the surface of a topological insulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we show that an intense ultrashort mid-infrared pulse with energy below the bulk band gap hybridizes with the surface Dirac fermions of a topological insulator to form Floquet-Bloch bands.

articleTitle: Quantum electromechanical processes in plasmonic nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Summary form only given. We present analysis of electromechanical effects associated with collective optical excitation of electrons in plasmonic nanoparticles, with emphasis on the enhanced transfer of angular momentum and nonlinear hydrodynamics such as vortex pairs.

articleTitle: Low-threshold InGaAs/GaAsSb ‘W’-type quantum well laser on InP substrate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The mid-infrared electrically-driven laser using InGaAs/GaAsSb `W'-type QWs is demonstrated at room temperature. The InP-based laser lasing at 2.35 μm with the lowest threshold current density of 1.42 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of powder absorption in additive manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have investigated optical absorption by a powder of metal spheres, via ray-trace calculations. The absorptivity significantly exceeds that for normal incidence, because of multiple scattering. The effect of beam size is also discussed.

articleTitle: ASE noise suppressed optical multi-carrier generation using optical FIR filter in frequency shifter loop
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A low noise multi-carrier generation scheme using optical FIR filter for ASE noise suppressing is proposed. 50 and 69 low noise carriers are generated experimentally, having much higher carrier-to-noise-ratio values of 22.5dB and 19.1dB.

articleTitle: Mie resonance based transition metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design a Mie resonance based transition metamaterial whose effective permeability gradually changed from positive to negative values. We demonstrate anomalous field enhancement near the zero permeability point under oblique incidence of the microwave radiation.

articleTitle: Detection of PbCl2 using collinear photofragmentation and atomic absorption spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: PbCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> causes corrosion in waste combusting power plants and there is no method to monitor it. We demonstrate the use of collinear photofragmentation and atomic absorption spectroscopy (CPFAAS) to successfully detect PbCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in-situ in a hot furnace.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics of fiber event horizons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically and experimentally show that fiber-optic analogues of event horizons can be explained by cascaded four-wave mixing of monochromatic continuous waves. Experiments performed with pulsed and continuous wave lasers are in excellent agreement.

articleTitle: Generation and optical parametric amplification of near-IR, few-cycle light pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present different schemes for the generation of few-cycle multi-μJ light pulses in the range of 700-1400 nm together with the amplification of these pulses to several mJ in two ps-pumped optical parametric amplification stages.

articleTitle: Switching of mid-infrared light using plasmonic fano-resonant meta-surfaces integrated with graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that graphene can strongly modulate the scattered light from Fano-resonant plasmonic metasurfaces. The Modulation depth of 1000% is achieved at around 7μm as the graphene carrier concentration changes.

articleTitle: 3 W near-diffraction-limited power from high-index-contrast photonic-crystal quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Phase locking, via resonant leaky-wave coupling, of five 8.36 μm-emitting quantum cascade lasers has provided in-phase-mode operation to 3 W with 1.5 × diffraction limit lobe-width and 2.45 W emitted in the main far-field lobe.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal enhanced photoacoustic detection
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic crystal sensor has been demonstrated to enhance photoacoustic signal from light absorbing molecules. The developed system was applied to detect an absorbing dye and gold nanoparticles and exhibited signal enhancement over 40 times.

articleTitle: 37 fs - 1.5 W Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:CALGO laser oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Kerr-lens mode-locking (KLM) in Yb:CALGO has been demonstrated by means of a high-brightness optical pumping with an Yb:fiber laser. Stable 37 fs pulses are produced with an average power of 1.5 W.

articleTitle: Coherently coupled bottom-emitting vertical cavity laser arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 2-dimentional coherently coupled bottom-emitting VCSEL arrays. In-phase operation has been obtained from 3-element triangular arrays, while out-of-phase operation has been obtained from 2×2, 3×3, and 4×4 arrays.

articleTitle: Three-photon absorption in hydrogenated amorphous silicon at 1.55µm for all-optical processing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Three-photon absorption (3PA) has been observed as the dominant mechanism for nonlinear absorption in wide-bandgap hydrogenated amorphous silicon (a-Si:H) at 1.55μm.

articleTitle: Ultrafast light-matter interaction in a metaphotonic cavity containing a single quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Progress in cavity quantum electrodynamics (cQED) trends to decreasing mode volume and increasing light-matter interaction. We demonstrate a metal-semiconductor nanopillar cQED system that exhibits bright single-photon generation, strong Purcell enhancement, and viability as a new platform for cQED.

articleTitle: Delivering nanoparticles and molecules to the same spot with a superhydrophobic bulls-eye for surface-enhanced Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a superhydrophobic silicon bulls-eye. Water droplets remain centered as they dry, enabling delivery of nanoparticles or molecules to the center. SERS spectra of molecules (R6G) at very low concentrations (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup> M) are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Strong light-matter coupling in mid-infrared monolithic metamaterial nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the design and realization of strong light-matter coupling in monolithic metamaterial nanocavities. We achieve a Rabi frequency of 2.5 THz (corresponding to a polariton splitting of 20%) in a mode volume of 1.34×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>(λ/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Selective erasure and refilling of liquid metal based terahertz metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a technique to selectively erase and refill unit cells of THz metamaterials, which are formed by injecting eutectic gallium indium, a liquid metal at room temperature, into microchannels in a polydimethylsiloxance mold.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared difference-frequency generation in suspended GaAs waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate mid-infrared difference frequency generation in suspended 181-nmthick GaAs waveguides. The extreme form-birefringence in the nanoslab waveguide enables phase-matching between the CW signal (1550 nm), pump (1025 nm), and idler (3000 nm).

articleTitle: Four-photon joint spectral probability distribution of a high spectral-purity photon source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the joint spectral amplitudes for a single and double photon pair from a spectrally factorizable type-II parametric downconversion process and show that the first Schmidt mode of double pair emission equals the square of the first single pair emission Schmidt mode.

articleTitle: Generation of second and third order optical dispersion using nonlinearly chirped silicon waveguide gratings
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The simultaneous generation of second and third order dispersion is demonstrated using nonlinearly chirped silicon waveguide gratings. Second order dispersion of -2.3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> ps/nm/km and third order dispersion of 1.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> ps/nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/km were demonstrated at 1.55μm.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh frequency surface acoustic wave modulation of optical resonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A piezoelectric aluminum nitride film on oxidized silicon wafer is used to realize high frequency surface acoustic wave devices. Optical ring resonator is integrated with the surface acoustic wave device to demonstrate a high speed acousto-optic modulation.

articleTitle: Coherent backscattering in multimode optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate experimentally two counter-propagating beams that travel through multimode fibers with strong mode coupling. The interferences between waves going through time-reversed paths can enhance, and surprisingly sometimes suppress, coherent backscattering to the input mode.

articleTitle: Auger recombination in light-emitting materials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: First-principles calculations show that phonon-assisted Auger recombination and its interplay with the polarization fields in polar nitride LEDs play an important role in the efficiency-droop and green-gap problems of these devices.

articleTitle: Ultrafast and ultra-low power all-optical tunable plasmoninduced transparency in gold/graphene trimers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed a novel meta-structure of gold/graphene trimers and realized ultrasfast and ultra-low power all-optical tunable plasmon-induced transparency around 1150 nm. The nonlinear susceptibility of graphene/ITO film was up to 2.90×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> esu.

articleTitle: 355nm generation by Fan-out PP-LBGO device
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 355 nm generation was confirmed by using a novel ferroelectric QPM device, PP-LBGO with Fan-out structure as a third harmonic of 1064 nm light. More than 100 mW was generated without any walk-off.

articleTitle: Coherent excitation-selective spectroscopy in planar metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated that the electric and magnetic resonances of metamaterials can be separately switches off and on by positioning the metamaterials along a standing wave, while both resonances are present in travelling-wave spectra.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nano-optical conveyer using C-shaped engravings
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a near-field based optical trapping and conveyor belt system based on a novel plasmonic structure: C-shaped engraving. Using polarization rotation and wavelength switching, we demonstrate controlled transport of nanoparticles along different paths.

articleTitle: Monolithic three dimensional dielectrophoretic actuator for positioning optics fabricated by femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a monolithic three dimensional dielectrophoretic micro-actuator fabricated by femtosecond laser in fused silica. Such actuators are useful for fine positioning of optical fibers and for introducing optomechanical coupling in waveguides.

articleTitle: Optical frequency transfer via 1840 km fiber link with superior stability
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated the transfer of a 194 THz optical frequency along a 1840 km fiber link. The fractional frequency instability expressed as the modified Allan deviation is 2.7 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−15</sup> at 1 s with 4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−19</sup> after 100 s. The transferred frequency shows no systematic offset within an uncertainty of 3 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−19</sup>. Analyzing the underlying noise structure reveals a τ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> response in the modified Allan deviation, which is confirmed by calculations of the frequency instability from frequency counter data as well as from phase noise data.

articleTitle: Exploring characteristics of strong-field ionization dynamics in the mid-infrared regime
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a study of features in photoelectron momentum distributions from strong-field ionization of noble gases for few-cycle pulses in the mid-infrared regime and assign characteristics to their classical and quantum mechanical origin.

articleTitle: Gallium nitride nanowire distributed feedback lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated single-mode lasing in a single gallium nitride nanowire using distributed feedback by external coupling to a dielectric grating. By adjusting the nanowire grating alignment we achieved a mode suppression ratio of 17dB.

articleTitle: Convergent polishing: Simple, low cost finishing method of glass optics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel finishing process, called Convergent Polishing, is described where the workpiece regardless of its initial shape will converge to final surface figure under a fixed, unchanging set of polishing parameters in a single iteration.

articleTitle: High power and high efficiency Tm-doped fiber laser pumped by a 1173 nm Raman fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a high power Tm-doped fiber laser pumped by a 1173 nm Raman fiber laser. The slope efficiency is 47%, the maximum output power is 46 W and can be scaled to higher power.

articleTitle: Status of high-energy OPCPA at LLE and future prospects
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The scope and status of a mid-scale optical parametric amplifier line (OPAL) that will demonstrate scalable technologies will be presented along with technical challenges and prospects for an OPAL pumped by OMEGA EP.

articleTitle: Solid-state cryo-cooling using optical refrigeration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical refrigeration provides the only solid-state technology capable of reaching cryogenic temperatures, currently below 100K. Novel, adaptable designs are implemented for technologies requiring vibration-free cryogenic operation.

articleTitle: THG microscopy imaging of blood using sub-50fs Yb fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on multimodal imaging of blood using sub-50 fs pulses centered at 1060 nm wavelength. We find that red blood cells appear dark on SHG images while on THG images of blood provide bright signal and good contrast.

articleTitle: Dark soliton attraction and optical spatial shock waves observed in m-cresol/nylon solutions
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the strongest effect of dark-soliton attraction in a new type of nonlocal thermal self-defocusing nonlinear media (m-cresol/nylon solutions). Formation of spatial shock waves is also observed with only mW power.

articleTitle: Control of grating-coupled ultrafast surface plasmon pulse and its nonlinear emission by shaping femtosecond laser pulse
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatiotemporal nanofocusing of surface plasmon polariton excited by femtosecond laser pulses on a sharp conical Au tip with a tip edge radius of few tens of nanometers is deterministically controlled.

articleTitle: Polarization switching in stretched pulse fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We studied experimentally polarization dynamics in a carbon nanotube mode locked stretched pulse fiber laser. For the first time, polarization locked, regular and irregular polarization switching have been observed at the microsecond time scale.

articleTitle: Exciton-related electroluminescence from monolayer MoS2
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We studied the microscopic origin of the electroluminescence from monolayer MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fabricated on a heavily p-type doped silicon substrate. Auger recombination of the exciton-exciton annihilation of bound exciton emission is observed.

articleTitle: A collinear 2f-to-3f self-referencing interferometer with a dual-pitch PPLN ridge waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report carrier-envelope offset beat detection (52-dB signal-to-noise ratio at 100-kHz resolution bandwidth) with a common-path 2f-to-3f self-referencing interferometer with a dual-pitch periodically poled lithium niobate ridge waveguide.

articleTitle: Timing performance improvement of scintillator detectors via inclusion of reflection metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A reflection metasurface is used to optimise the light transport within a scintillator detector dramatically reducing the time resolution. We present a structure design and potential improvements in Positron-Emission Tomography.

articleTitle: Signal regeneration techniques for advanced modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review recent results on all-optical regeneration of phase encoded signals based on phase sensitive amplification achieved by avoiding phase-to-amplitude conversion in order to facilitate the regeneration of amplitude/phase encoded (QAM) signals.

articleTitle: Growth of glass-clad Cr4+:YSO crystal fiber for white light interferometry
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Glass-clad Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YSO crystal fibers were grown using the laser-heated pedestal growth method. Quasi-3-level behavior of the Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YSO was observed, and the emission was red shifted to 1302 nm with a 3-dB bandwidth of 230 nm.

articleTitle: Observation of dispersive wave emission by temporal cavity solitons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of dispersive wave emission by temporal cavity solitons. Our results could impact on a variety of systems supporting temporal cavity solitons, such as high-Q Kerr microresonators.

articleTitle: Polarization-sensitive cat's eye structuring of silicon by ultrashort light pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sub-wavelength ridge structures are observed on silicon surface after irradiation with two femtosecond pulses. Cat's-eye-shaped structures are aligned perpendicular to polarization of the second pulse and can be used for polarization-sensitive recording.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast spinor switching in polariton condensates
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a linear to circular polarization conversion mechanism of a confined polariton condensate created by an optical potential trap. This system features a high degree of circular polarization under linear polarization pumping and is favorable for the development of spin logic operations. The physical mechanism behind this process is explained by the spin precession in the exciton reservoir that results in a condensate of a preferred spin state. Application of a non-resonant below threshold femtosecond pulse on the spinor condensate results in an ultrafast reversal of the spin state.

articleTitle: Biological source of correlated photon pairs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photon pairs sources based on nonlinear optical techniques are essential components in modern quantum optical systems. We present here a naturally occurring biological source of photon pairs—Green Fluorescent Protein (GFP)—obtained by a non-degenerate four-wave mixing (FWM).

articleTitle: Meta-weaves: Nonreciprocal sector-way surfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Generalized 2D nonreciprocity in metasurfaces is achieved by weaving nano-scale one-way threads. The association of t → -t with z → -z, commonly used in time-reversal asymmetry analysis, proves insufficient as shown by the resulting “sector-way” propagation dynamics.

articleTitle: Separating left- from right-circularly polarized light with a dielectric metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a dielectric metamaterial comprising silicon nanofins on a glass substrate. Left- and right-circularly polarized beams incident upon the device are deflected into different directions. Our approach avoids the efficiency issues of plasmonics.

articleTitle: Dissipative vectorial solitons in semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nonlinear polarization dynamics of VCSELs with a long-delay external cavity lead to vectorial dissipative solitons. The large temporal aspect-ratio enables the observation of multiple - independent and/or bound - solitons within the same roundtrip.

articleTitle: High numerical aperture imaging by using multimode fibers with micro-fabricated optics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Controlling light propagation into multimode optical fibers through spatial light modulators provides highly miniaturized endoscopes and optical micromanipulation probes. We increase the numerical aperture up to nearly 1 by micro-optics fabricated on the fiber-end.

articleTitle: Hybrid Si3N4-graphene nanophotonic circuits for electro-optic modulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present graphene-based optical modulators integrated with Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> waveguides which provide broadband flat absorption from visible to infrared wavelengths. Tunable attenuation of 0.067 dB/μm is measured in Mach-Zehnder interferometers and microring resonators.

articleTitle: Single-photon source based on NV center in nanodiamond coupled to TiN-based hyperbolic metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate both the lifetime reduction and the enhancement of single-photon emission from nitrogen-vacancies in nanodiamonds coupled to a TiN/Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</sub>Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>N superlattice. Our results pave the way towards future CMOS-compatible integrated quantum sources.

articleTitle: Coherent control of birefringence and optical activity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Control of polarization of light with light is demonstrated in thin slabs of linear material promising ultrafast all-optical data processing at arbitrarily low intensities. In proof-of-principle experiments we access any polarization azimuth and any ellipticity.

articleTitle: Active mode-locking and CW regimes operating simultaneously in an Erbium doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated an Erbium-doped fiber laser operating simultaneously in two distinct regimes, CW and active mode-locking at 1.8 GHz with pulses of 38 ps. The lasers wavelengths can be tuned in both regimes.

articleTitle: Incoherent nonparaxial accelerating beams
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Accelerating beams completely rely on interference: coherent superposition of waves. In spite of that fundamental feature, we demonstrate, experimentally and theoretically, partially-spatially-incoherent nonparaxial accelerating beams.

articleTitle: Lightwave control of plasma mirrors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show how tailored few-cycle lightwaves with near relativistic intensity (~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) can be used to control the attosecond electron dynamics of plasma mirrors and to produce beam manifolds of fully synchronized attosecond EUV light pulses.

articleTitle: A new and improved approach to supercontinuum generation in solids
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A stable octave-spanning supercontinuum with excellent beam quality is generated by high-intensity spectral broadening in bulk fused silica plates in a cascaded arrangement.

articleTitle: Development of a CMOS compatible biophotonics platform based on SiN nanophotonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the development of low-loss photonic components fabricated in low-temperature PECVD SiN for the development of a CMOS compatible biophotonics platform. We discuss modeling and experimental demonstration of strip waveguides, MMI and evanescent couplers, fractal trees for power distribution and AWGs and waveguide-integrated resonators as wavelength selective components.

articleTitle: Biodynamic 3D imaging for personalized cancer care
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Tumor heterogeneity and differential drug response in 3D tissue is a major obstacle for survival of cancer patients. Biodynamic 3D imaging provides personalized therapy assessment by testing heterogeneous response of tumor biopsies to anti-cancer drugs.

articleTitle: High-power few-cycle pulse generation by spectral broadening in bulk material
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The first 10-W, 10-fs amplification-free laser is presented. Bulk spectral broadening is utilized to reach the pulse duration of less than three optical cycles. Spectral homogeneity and good quality of the laser beam are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical resonances in topological defect structures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study numerically optical resonances in 2D topological defect structures with wavelength-scale anisotropic scattering units. Both spatially extended and localized modes exhibit vortex-like energy flow due to breaking of chiral symmetry of the underlying structure.

articleTitle: Compact, automated differential absorption lidar for tropospheric profiling of water vapor
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the engineering development of a compact differential absorption lidar, using a diode laser-seeded semiconductor optical amplifier as the transmitter, for profiling water vapor in the lower atmosphere.

articleTitle: Passively harmonically self-mode-locked vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting laser (VECSEL)
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a harmonically self-mode-locked optically pumped semiconductor disk laser up to the third harmonic with a central wavelength of 1014 nm. Pulse durations penetrating the femtosecond regime at 500 MHz repetition rate are achieved.

articleTitle: 3D visualization of dental anatomy in ancient fossil vertebrates by using third harmonic generation microscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Clear 3D visualization in fossilized dentinal tissues was first discovered with extremely strong contrast by means of third harmonic generation microscopy, providing a novel approach to study the dental evolution of ancient vertebrates (dinosaurs) noninvasively.

articleTitle: Room temperature operation of optically pumped 1.55-µm VCSEL with polarization-independent HCG mirror on SOI
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricated a VCSEL incorporating a polarization-independent HCG mirror on SOI for a novel polarization-bistable functional device. The VCSEL oscillated under an optical short pulse excitation at 300 K.

articleTitle: Athermal microring resonator based on the resonance splitting of dual-ring structure
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel athermal scheme based on resonance splitting of dual-ring structure is proposed and proved. An athermal resonator based on this scheme is demonstrated, achieving athermal transmission over a temperature range of at least 40K.

articleTitle: Optical spectroscopy of graphene/boron nitride hetrostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Electrons in graphene are described by massless Dirac Fermions with unusual electrical and optical properties. The Moire superlattice in graphene/boron nitride heterostructure strongly modifies the electronic structure, and leads to unusual changes in infrared absorption.

articleTitle: Low temperature active mirror Yb:YAG laser amplifier gain studies
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single pass gain of 77mm crystal and ceramic Yb:YAG disks are compared in the 100-200K temperature range. Experiments are performed on a laser amplifier cooled through a static low pressure helium gas cell.

articleTitle: Remote spectroscopy at kilometer-scale distances via random Raman lasing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The single-shot remote identification of chemicals at kilometer-scale distances is experimentally demonstrated utilizing random Raman lasing.

articleTitle: Spectral and temporal properties of optical signals with multiple sinusoidal phase modulations
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High-energy laser systems use optical signals with multiple sinusoidal phase modulations for on-target smoothing and stimulated Brillouin scattering suppression. The spectrum and temporal frequency-modulation-to-amplitude-modulation conversion of these signals are analytically studied.

articleTitle: Clinical translation and discovery with near-infrared fluorescence lymphatic imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Near-infrared fluorescence (NIRF) lymphatic imaging enables, for the first time, non-invasive visualization and quantification of human lymphatic architecture and contractile function in health and disease. This contribution reviews NIRF lymphatic imaging and its clinical translation. (35 word limit).

articleTitle: Beyond PT -symmetry: SUSY-mediated real spectra in complex refractive index landscapes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
