abstract: In the presence of gain and loss, supersymmetric transformations facilitate the arbitrary removal of modes from wave-guiding structures. We show how SUSY gives rise to non-PT-symmetric families of complex potentials with entirely real-valued eigenvalue spectra.

articleTitle: Instantaneous volumetric combustion diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper reports instantaneous and volumetric flame measurements based on tomographic techniques. Experimental results at kHz temporal rate, in a volume of 16×16×16 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and with a spatial resolution of 2~3 mm, are discussed.

articleTitle: Approaching single-photon detection level in communication band via frequency upconversion in GaP
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed frequency upconversion of the incoming photons within the communication band to a visible band in a gallium phosphide crystal. Such a crystal is capable of reaching the single-photon detection level.

articleTitle: Vacuum UV to IR supercontinuum generation by impulsive Raman self-scattering in hydrogen-filled PCF
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A supercontinuum extending from 125nm to 1200nm is generated in hydrogen-filled kagomé-PCF by means of impulsive Raman self-scattering of few-μJ ultrashort pulses at 805nm. The source shows no optical damage and is stable over time.

articleTitle: A mid-infrared Lab-on-a-Chip: Generating, guiding and detecting light in a monolithic device
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a fully integrated mid-infrared sensor. The laser and detector are fabricated from a bi-functional quantum cascade structure, connected through a dielectric-loaded surface plasmon waveguide, which acts as interaction zone and provides high coupling.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously integrated MIR silicon photonics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By utilizing heterogeneous integration method, integrated silicon photonics on mid-IR compatible substrate has been fabricated and on-chip cavity-enhanced mid-IR spectroscopic analysis of organic chemicals has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Soliton modelocking via cascaded quadratic nonlinearities in a SESAM-modelocked Yb:CALGO laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present soliton modelocking based on cascading of quadratic nonlinearities using an LBO crystal in a SESAM-modelocked Yb:CaGdAlO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser cavity, enabling pulse formation in the positive GDD-regime, reaching 114-fs pulses at 1.1-W average output power.

articleTitle: Scattering off PT-symmetric particles
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate scattering properties of parity-time-symmetric cylinders. We show that, the scattering pattern of such structures changes drastically by changing the angle of incidence. In addition PT-particles preferentially deflect light at a certain angle.

articleTitle: Movies of filaments and plasma
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a streak camera, and combining over 1,000 synchronized frames, 4D (2 D space, time in ps and wavelength) movies of the light and plasma emission in the wake of filaments are produced.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison of single and double partial receiver apertures for recovering signals transmitted using orbital-angular-momentum
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compared power spreading of a partially captured orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) beam by using single and double apertures. Double apertures could help reducing crosstalk from OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> to OAM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l+m</sub> by ~10 dB, where l is an integer and m is an odd number.

articleTitle: Polymethines with macroscopic optical nonlinearities suitable for all-optical signal processing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By preventing aggregation of polymethine molecules at high number density, we have developed organic materials with large third-order nonlinearities and low nonlinear absorption in the near-infrared thereby enabling demonstration of an all-optical signal processing application.

articleTitle: On-chip detection of clinical Ebola virus RNA using specific DNA binding technique
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Clinical Ebola RNAs are detected with virus concentration down to 6.25 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> pfu/ml on an optofluidic chip. Longer complementary pull-down DNA sequences provide better isolation and higher signals.

articleTitle: Deterministic writing and control of the dark exciton state using short single optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate deterministic optical writing of a quantum dot-confined dark exciton, in a pure quantum state using one optical pulse. We then control the spin state of this long-lived exciton using picosecond optical pulses.

articleTitle: Light-driven rotation of helical microstructures in a fluidic environment
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Inspired by biological microswimmer strategies, we consider the design of helical silica particles. We characterize optically induced rotation of these “microscrews”, and discuss their applications as highly controlled microswimmers in the low Reynold's number regime.

articleTitle: Self-phase modulation compensation in a regenerative amplifier using cascaded second-order nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Cascaded nonlinearities are theoretically and experimentally investigated for intracavity nonlinearity compensation in a Nd:YLF regenerative amplifier. Spectral broadening is significantly reduced, in agreement with simulations, allowing for efficient amplification in a Nd:YLF power amplifier.

articleTitle: Patterned optical trapping with high efficiency on a 2D photonic crystal platform
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a method to generate patterned optical trapping on a two-dimensional photonic crystal (2D PC) substrate. Enhanced trapping is achieved with a loosely focused laser beam. The pattern and scale of the optical traps is determined by the 2D PC structure.

articleTitle: Terahertz-field-induced second harmonic generation through Pockels effect in Gallium Phosphide crystal
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the second harmonic generation of a near-infrared pulse in a Gallium Phosphide crystal through the Pockels effect induced by an intense terahertz pulse. This demonstrates cascading second-order nonlinear phenomena in the terahertz range.

articleTitle: Investigation of multiple coupled optical parametric oscillators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated multiple coupled optical parametric oscillators, exhibiting behaviors of strong coupling. Conversion efficiency and slope efficiency stay the same as those for conventional and two coupled optical parametric oscillators whereas linewidths are significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient, digitally-driven “fat pipe” silicon photonic circuit switch in the UCSD MORDIA data-center network
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a compact (0.03 mm^2) silicon photonic thermo-optic switch with five cascaded thermo-topic phase-shifters, we demonstrate low insertion loss, low power, microsecond-scale cross-bar switching of twenty wavelength channels, each carrying 10 Gbit/second data concurrently.

articleTitle: Tunable, continuous-wave, single-frequency ultraviolet source based on BiB3O6
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a single-frequency cw UV source tunable across 333–345nm using BiB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> as the nonlinear material, generating 21.6mW of UV power at 339.7nm, with >15mW over 64% of the UV tuning range in high-beam quality.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser modification of Li(NiCoMn)O2 electrodes for lithium-ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrafast laser micromachining processes for modification and formation of three-dimensional architectures in cathode materials were developed. The electrochemical properties were investigated applying cell test with current densities in the range of (0.05-28.79) mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Modulated plasma waveguides generated by intense Bessel beams patterned with a Spatial Light Modulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Plasma guiding structures are generated with programmable axial density modulations using a Spatial Light Modulator (SLM). A coherent beam-combining scheme enables the sculpting of high power beams with modest energy passing through the SLM.

articleTitle: Temporal tweezing of light
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate temporal tweezing of picosecond optical pulses, extending the concept of optical tweezers to the time-domain. By adjusting the phase profile of the driving beam, we can trap and manipulate temporal cavity solitons.

articleTitle: Influence of pump pulse duration on doubly resonant optical parametric oscillators build-up time
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A single-frequency doubly resonant optical parametric oscillator is pumped by a master oscillator-fiber power amplifier whose pulse duration is varied for 40 ns to 10 μs, enabling to optimize the pumping parameters.

articleTitle: Angular dependance of betatron x-ray spectra in a laser-wakefield accelerator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Our experiments produced betatron x-rays up to 80 keV from a laser-wakefield accelerator. Measurements, performed with stacked image plates spectrometers, provide simultaneous information on the beam profile and spectrum at various angles of observation.

articleTitle: Quasi monoenergetic and tunable x-rays by laser Compton scattering from laser wakefield e-beam
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quasi monoenergetic and tunable X-ray beams are reported by inverse-Compton scattering from laser wakefield accelerated electrons. The high peak brightness, ultrashort duration, and small size of the source make it uniquely suitable for many applications.

articleTitle: Attosecond transient absorption in molecular hydrogen
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Isolated attosecond pulses are used to probe laser-perturbed hydrogen molecules using attosecond absorption spectroscopy. We observe dynamic features in the delay-dependent absorption on both the electronic and nuclear timescales for the first time.

articleTitle: Thresholdless optical gain using colloidal HgTe nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Thresholdless stimulated emission is observed using nanometer sized colloidal HgTe nanocrystals, in a broad spectral region covering the entire technologically relevant near-infrared spectrum.

articleTitle: Ge-on-Si integrated photonics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the latest progress in epitaxial Ge-on-Si lasers, electroabsorption modulators, and photodetectors for integrated photonics. We also discuss an emerging monolithic 3D photonic integration scheme based on high crystallinity GeSn directly grown on SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Observation of superradiant phase transition in quantum chaos
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observed the phase transition of multiple superradiant states in chaotic optical cavities with multiple open decay channels base on photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Coherent All-PM fiber frequency comb source at 2.03 µm and 100 MHz emitting broadband pulses at up to 290 mW and 128 fs pulse duration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a compact coherent all-PM fiber laser amplifier system at around 2.05 μm running at 100 MHz delivering broadband pulses at 290 mW average power and pulse duration down to 128 fs.

articleTitle: Helium-ion-induced radiation damage in LiNbO3 thin film electro-optic modulators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study He<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-induced radiation damage in 10-µm-thick LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-thin-film modulators. Results show induced-strain, scattering from interstitials, and the degree of overlap between guided modes with damaged region result in degradation of device extinction ratio and V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>L.

articleTitle: Charge carrier relaxation processes in TbAs nanoinclusions in GaAs measured by optical-pump THz-probe transient absorption spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By analyzing how carrier relaxation rates depend on pump fluence and sample temperature, we conclude that states of TbAs embedded in GaAs are saturable. This suggests the existence of a bandgap for TbAs nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Liquid-tuned plasmonic external cavity laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a single-mode, continuous-wave and electrically pumped plasmonic external cavity laser. It offers a novel label-free biosensing approach by combining the refractive index sensitivity of surface plasmon resonance with the high spectral resolution of laser emission.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional cell culture on microscaffolds with spatially resolved surface chemistry
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: To spatially control protein-binding and cell-attachment in three dimensions (3D) we employ a two-photon-triggered cycloaddition of functional (e.g. biotinylated) dienophiles on the surface of 3D microscaffolds, which have been silanized with photoactivatable diens (photoenol).

articleTitle: Resonating metasurface photon and its spin manipulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The ubiquitous spin-orbit interaction destroys the particles' spin rotational symmetry and introduces a universal transverse spin current. Here we show that an anomalous refracting metasurface induces a controllable spin-orbit interaction and a path-dependent polarization rotation.

articleTitle: Impact of optical amplification and pulse interleaving in low phase noise photonic microwave generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using carefully constructed pulse interleavers, we demonstrate ∼10 dB reduction in the quantum noise from optical amplification for short pulse detection, resulting in a phase noise floor on a 10 GHz microwave of −175 dBc/Hz.

articleTitle: Spatial filtering of light beams by axisymmetric photonic mictrostructures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and show experimentally uniform axisymmetric spatial filtering of light beams by three-dimensional axisymmetric photonic microstructures. Such gapless structures (similar to photonic crystals) were recorded in bulk of glass. Angular filtering of 25 mrad is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Four-wave mixing in slow-light graphene-silicon photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the enhanced four-wave mixing generated in silicon photonic crystal waveguides with monolayer graphene. An enhanced high conversion efficiency and wide detuning bandwidth is observed.

articleTitle: Guided resonance manipulation and degeneracy removal by elliptical nano-holes in photonic crystal slabs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a method to manipulate the modes and retain high quality factors of 2D photonic crystal slabs with relatively large nano-features over a wide aspect ratio range through structural symmetry breaking within the unit cell by elliptical nano-holes.

articleTitle: Optomechanics in gallium phosphide microdisks
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Gallium phosphide microdisk optical cavities with intrinsic quality factors Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> ~ 2.8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> at 1.5 μm are demonstrated. No two-photon absorption is observed. Saturation of internal optical loss, and optomechanical coupling to radial breathing modes with g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> ~ 30 kHz is observed.

articleTitle: Certified quantum non-demolition measurement of atomic spins
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report certified quantum non-demolition measurement of atomic spins using criteria developed for continuous variable experiments in optics. We observe quantum state preparation and information-damage trade-off beyond classical limits by seven and twelve standard deviations.

articleTitle: Investigation of purcell factor and light extraction efficiency in Ag-Coated GaN/InGaN core-shell nanowires
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We calculate the Purcell factor and light extraction efficiency in Ag-coated GaN/InGaN core-shell nanowires using a model that includes the structural features necessary for electrical injection. The nanowires exhibit maximum Purcell factors of ~60 and maximum light extraction efficiencies of ~12%.

articleTitle: Selective mode splitting in high-Q microresonator for dispersion engineering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate selective mode splitting (SMS) in microresonators. SMS can split one selected optical mode up to 1.25 nm with other modes unperturbed. This opens a new gate for phasematching in parametric oscillations in microresonators.

articleTitle: Interdigitated back-contact solar cells implemented with foundry CMOS processes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interdigitated back-contact solar cells with two-dimensional doping design are realized by foundry CMOS processes. Experimental results indicate superior diode performance and a 4.6% conversion efficiency that could be further boosted by thinning down the substrate.

articleTitle: Raman quantum memory based on an ensemble of nitrogen-vacancy centers coupled to a microcavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a scheme to realize quantum memories based on Raman coupling for storing photons in the electronic spin of NV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> ensembles. We include all optical transitions in a 9-level configuration and evaluate the efficiencies.

articleTitle: Cavity optomechanical magnetometry on a chip
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A microscale, picotesla range, silicon-chip optical magnetometer. Earth-field, fiber coupled operation, with 60 μm resolution and 40 MHz bandwidth lead to potential applications in microfluidic-MRI, spin physics in condensed matter systems and ultracold atom clouds.

articleTitle: Selective THz excitation of collective modes in underdoped YBCO
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use intense broadband THz pulses to excite underdoped YBCO exhibiting competing superconducting and charge density wave ground states. We observe pronounced coherent oscillations at 1.85 and 2.65THz, attributed to renormalized low-energy phonon modes.

articleTitle: Organic electro-optic materials and devices: Molecular engineering driving device performance and technology innovation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Electro-optic polymers have developed dramatically, with commercially available materials exhibiting EO coefficients > 250pm/V with excellent stability. This has resulted in low voltage (<; 1V), ultrahigh bandwidth EO modulators and integration with silicon photonics is emerging.

articleTitle: On-chip ultra-broad frequency conversion via simultaneous second and third-order optical nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate ultra-broad frequency conversion through simultaneous second and third-order nonlinearities. Using a high-Q resonator, we generate multiple frequency lines in both the near-IR and in the visible range using a single near-IR CW pump.

articleTitle: Observation of rapid carrier relaxation in graphene oxide probed by ultrafast terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the carrier relaxation dynamics in graphene oxide (GO) using ultrafast optical-pump terahertz-probe spectroscopy. Unlike graphene, we observe the dynamics of GO show rapid percolation behaviors related to the multi-particle Auger scattering.

articleTitle: Boundaries of parametric gain due to four-wave mixing in hybrid photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Parametric gain by four-wave mixing is considered in photonic crystal fibers for an undepleted pump. The mode distributions are wavelength dependent, thus field overlap integrals cannot be simplified, and an extended gain region is observed.

articleTitle: 3 % thermal load measured in tandem-pumped ytterbium-doped fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tandem-pumped Yb-doped fiber with a quantum defect of 2% generates 3% of heat. We believe this is a record-low thermal load and the first calorimetric measurement of the heat from a fiber core.

articleTitle: Current-controlled optical modulation in thin VO2 wires
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measured the current-voltage and infrared optical transmission characteristics of thin film VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> wires over the metal-insulator phase transition. The phase transition had electrical or thermal characteristics depending on the wire geometry and applied current.

articleTitle: Intracavity coherent beam combining of solid-state gain elements using active phase control
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Beam combining of a laser array allows power scaling with increased brightness. Here we report 27 W of coherently combined power from 9 solid-state intracavity gain elements with a combining efficiency of 87%.

articleTitle: Excitons in atomically thin transition-metal dichalcogenides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Excitons are studied experimentally and theoretically in atomically thin WS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layers. We find a binding energy of 0.32eV as well as non-hydrogenic behavior of the exciton states due to the non-uniformity of the dielectric environment.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh-resolution optical coherence tomography using supercontinuum source in 1.9 µm wavelength region
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrahigh-resolution OCT in 1.9 μm wavelength region was demonstrated using fiber laser supercontinuum. The wavelength dependence of imaging was investigated, and the decrement in attenuation coefficient in longer-wavelength was confirmed for tooth sample.

articleTitle: Highly-efficient mid-IR supercontinuum generation in ZBLAN fiber pumped by thulium-doped fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Mid-infrared supercontinuum of 8.1 W with optical-to-optical conversion efficiency of ~76% with respect to the launched pump power at 2 μm wavelength was demonstrated in a ZBLAN fiber pumped by a thulium-doped all-fiber amplifier.

articleTitle: Recent advances in ultrafast laser nanostructuring: S-waveplate and eternal data storage
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrashort light pulses create self-assembled sub-wavelength structures in the bulk of silica glass. Recent progress in applications of this phenomenon ranging from polarization and vortex converters to 5D optical data storage is reviewed.

articleTitle: Precision measurement at the quantum limit in gravitational wave detectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interferometric gravitational wave detectors are poised to launch a new era of gravitational-wave astronomy. I will describe the basic principles behind gravitational wave detection and how we achieve sub-attometer displacement sensitivity in kilometer-scale laser interferometers using precision measurement techniques that include quantum optics and optomechanics.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh suppression and reconfigurable RF photonic notch filter using a silicon nitride ring resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a technique to simultaneously optimize the peak rejection and the resolution of a radiofrequency photonic notch filter based on a silicon nitride ring resonator.

articleTitle: Surface-emitting second-harmonic generation: Effective technique for evaluating periodically-poled lithium niobate waveguide domains with nanoscale resolution
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that surface-emitting second-harmonic generation is an effective technique for evaluating domains of periodically-poled lithium niobate waveguide: domain period, linear taper, and poling depth. Such a method reaches nanoscale spatial resolution of 0.5 nm.

articleTitle: Optically driven microfluidic devices produced by two-photon microfabrication
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optically driven microfluidic devices such as micropumps, microvalves and microtweezers have been developed by two-photon microfabrication. To improve the driving efficiency of the microfluidic devices, metalized micromachines driven by light have been developed by the combination of two-photon microfabrication and electroless plating. The optically controlled micro/nano fluidic devices will be used for low-cost, functional lab-on-a-chip.

articleTitle: Sub-femtosecond envelope stability of fiber comb lasers locked to a CW reference
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measured relative envelope jitter of two fiber comb lasers, each with one comb line phase locked to a CW optical phase reference. Integrated jitter is 0.9fs RMS from 10Hz to 2MHz.

articleTitle: Saturation broadening effect in an InP photonic-crystal nanocavity switch
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Pump-probe measurements on InP photonic-crystal nanocavities show large-contrast fast switching at low pulse energy. For large pulse energies, large resonance shifts passing across the probe lead to switching contrast saturation and switching time-window broadening.

articleTitle: Combining attosecond science with coincidence momentum spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We combine an attosecond beamline with a 3D momentum imaging spectrometer to achieve coincidence pump probe experiments with unprecedented attosecond time-resolution. Besides technical details, first coincidence and pump-probe experiments are presented.

articleTitle: Optical and near infrared plasmonic filters integrated with terahertz metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have designed, simulated and fabricated multi-spectral materials operating in visible, near infrared and terahertz wavebands by combining plasmonic filters with metamaterials. Multi-spectral materials offer a path to the creation of co-axial multi-spectral imagers.

articleTitle: Complex spatial and spectral evolutions in cascaded second order nonlinear process
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally study spatio-temporal nonlinear dynamics in periodically poled lithium niobate crystal. We discuss broadband frequency conversion by modulation instability through cascading second harmonic generation under self-defocusing regime. Measurements agree well with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Angle-multiplexed spatial-spectral interferometry for simultaneous measurement of spectral phase and polarization state
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An angle-multiplexed spatial-spectral interferometry between an arbitrary polarized signal pulse and two orthogonal linearly polarized reference pulses is demonstrated to characterize the polarization state and relative spectral phase of a radially polarized laser pulse.

articleTitle: Semi-transparent and colored photovoltaic structures by using ultra-thin a-Si
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We exploit optical resonance in an ultra-thin (6 to 31 nm) undoped amorphous silicon/organic hybrid photovoltaic (PV) structures that can produce semi-transparent transmissive colors insensitive to incidence angle of up to ±70° regardless of polarization.

articleTitle: Vacuum-UV dispersive wave emission using gas-filled hollow-core PCF
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Vacuum-UV radiation between 145-155 nm is generated from 40 fs, 800 nm 6.8 μJ pump pulses in a 34 μm core-diameter kagomé-photonic crystal fibre (PCF) filled with 20-25 bar neon. Simulations confirm the mechanism as resonant dispersive-wave emission.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional supercontinuum spectral interferometry for measurement of laser-induced plasmas
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The plasma-induced phase shift of a probe is measured in 2D spatially with ~3 μm resolution and temporally with ~5 fs resolution. From this ionization rates for the noble gases are found for a 40 fs, 800 nm pulse, for intensities up to nearly full depletion of the neutral population.

articleTitle: Observing the conditional decoherence of a mixed state of light
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a method to capture the temporal evolution of a light field using continuous-variable conditional two-timeWigner functions. Reference beams with fixed phase relationship to the signal are not required.

articleTitle: Recent advances in ultrafast MIXSELs 5
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high-power MIXSEL combining 570-fs-pulses and repetition-rate scalability from 5 GHz to record high 101.2 GHz is presented. Additionally, we achieve record low timing jitters of a free-running and piezo-stabilized picosecond MIXSEL.

articleTitle: Effect of grain-boundary plasmon on the negative terahertz dynamic conductivity in graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss the origin of negative dynamic terahertz (THz) conductivity in graphene. By performing series of fluence and photon-energy dependent studies, we show that the nonequilibrium THz dynamics is strongly affected by the polycrystalline plasmons.

articleTitle: Graphene stacks as the darkest material
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the fabrication and characterization of a graphene stack that can function as the darkest material and serve as the basis for a new class of sensitive, high-speed photodetectors.

articleTitle: High precision wide-field sensing with individual nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a microscopy technique for precision sensing across a wide field of view with high spatial precision through pulsed electron spin resonance of nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond.

articleTitle: THz tube waveguides with low loss, low dispersion, and high bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose, model and experimentally characterize a novel class of terahertz hollow-core tube waveguides with high-loss cladding material, resulting in propagation with low loss, low dispersion, and high useful bandwidth.

articleTitle: Impact of surface recombination on the performance of phosphor-free InGaN/GaN nanowire white light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the performance of InGaN/GaN axial nanowire LEDs is largely limited by the poor carrier injection efficiency. We have further demonstrated high performance phosphor-free white LEDs using InGaN/GaN/AlGaN dot-in-a-wire core-shell heterostructures.

articleTitle: Flexible terabit/s Nyquist-WDM superchannels with net SE > 7bit/s/Hz using a gain-switched comb source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate two 1Tbit/s superchannel architectures using a compact, FSR-tunable gain-switched comb source. SSMF transmission of 18GBaud Nyquist-WDM shaped PDM-QPSK and PDM-16QAM modulation is reported, with a capacity up to 1.296Tbit/s and SE of 7.2bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: All semiconductor negative-index plasmonic absorbers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate all-semiconductor thin-film plasmonic absorbers, where strong absorption in these structures is linked to the excitation of highly-confined negative-index surface plasmon polaritons.We present numerical and analytical descriptions of guided modes of the system.

articleTitle: Phase-locked quantum-dot mode-locked lasers for wider frequency combs generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the technique allowing generation of wider frequency combs with low phase noise and pulses of shorter duration in quantum-dot mode-locked lasers. The devices are stabilized using coherent sidebands optical injection.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical properties of a graphene-based DNA composite
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A graphene-based biopolymer is developed which exhibits saturable absorption and optical limiting behavior in the femtosecond and nanosecond regime respectively. Further this composite film when irradiated with nanosecond pulses indicates a damage threshold >50 J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Control of saturation characteristics in a fiber optical parametric amplifier by Raman amplification
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report suppression of pump depletion and signal gain reduction in a fiber optical parametric amplifier with a backward Raman pump. The depletion and gain saturation characteristics can be controlled by tuning the Raman gain.

articleTitle: Broadband terahertz spectroscopy of electrically gated graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Broadband terahertz modulation at room temperature is realized using electrically gated graphene in the 1-10 THz range. By gate voltage modulation, the Drude conductivity of graphene varies along with the THz transmission response.

articleTitle: Radiation-hardened Erbium doped LMA fiber with AlP composition from solution doping process
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on Erbium doped large-mode-area fibers based on the phosphoaluminosilicates. The radiation induced attenuation are reduced compared to standard highly doped fibers. We measured 22% power conversion efficiency for core pumping at 1532nm.

articleTitle: Theory of time-gated phase-matching for isolated attosecond soft x-ray pulse generation using mid-infrared lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We model soft x-ray high harmonic generation and propagation driven by mid-infrared lasers. We find that multi-cycle laser pulses are ideal for generating shorter bright isolated attosecond pulses via time-gated phase-matching in high-density extended media.

articleTitle: Effects of multiphoton absorption on parametric comb generation in silicon microresonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate theoretically parametric frequency comb generation in silicon microresonators for telecom and mid-infrared (MIR) wavelengths in the presence of multiphoton absorption. Parametric oscillation is inhibited at telecom wavelengths but can occur at MIR wavelengths.

articleTitle: Femtosecond-laser inscribed, tunable, waveguide embedded Bragg gratings in lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate electro-optical tunable Bragg gratings embedded into complex two-dimensional waveguides in lithium niobate by femtosecond direct laser writing. The structures support both, ordinary and extraordinary guiding and narrowband reflections around λ = 1.55 μm.

articleTitle: Giant kerr rotation enhancement in magneto-plasmonic metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report for the first time an order of magnitude enhancement of Kerr rotation in hybrid plasmonic/ferromagnetic metamaterial resonators. Our results pave the way towards magnetically controlled metamaterials and integrated magneto-plasmonics.

articleTitle: Thermal emission control with surface waves
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Cheap and practical infra red (IR) sources are incandescent sources such as globar or hot membranes. These sources are broadband, omnidirectional, have a low efficiency and cannot be modulated faster than 100 Hz. In this paper, we show how it is possible to overcome all these limitations by taking advantage of surface waves.

articleTitle: Low phonon energy fluorozirconate-based glass ceramics for efficient rare-earth luminescence
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fluorozirconate-based, highly transparent glass ceramics doped with Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> exhibit very low multiphonon relaxation rates following an exponential energy gap dependence. The resulting high radiative quantum efficiencies show the material's potential for amplifier applications.

articleTitle: Laser cutting of flexible glass
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this invited talk, we review our cutting research on flexible glass substrates using both laser ablation and laser crack propagation methods. The methods are evaluated in terms of cut edge quality, speed and path to manufacturing.

articleTitle: Room-temperature bonding and its applications to solid-state lasers and wavelength-conversion devices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop composite solid-state lasers and nonlinear wavelength-conversion devices by room-temperature bonding. The room-temperature-bonding technique has a potential of realizing new high-power and highly efficient laser devices over a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: 31nm quasi-continuous tuning single mode laser array based on slots
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a 10-channel slotted single-mode laser array with effective-cavity-length ~300μm which exhibits quasi-continuous tuning range ~31nm over 42°C with side-mode suppression-ratio >35dB. The linewidth is about 2MHz for all channels at 150mA at 20°C.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared absorption imaging of trapped paraexcitons in cuprous oxide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Absorption imaging of trapped dark excitons in a bulk semiconductor is realized. 1s-2p transition in the mid-infrared is used to detect 1s paraexcitons. This technique is crucial to observe the Bose-Einstein condensate of excitons directly.

articleTitle: Multiwatt-level continuous-wave midwave infrared generation using difference frequency mixing in periodically poled lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: More than 2 Watts of continuous-wave external power at 3400 nm was obtained by difference frequency mixing of 1064.6 nm and 1549.8 nm fiber lasers in a periodically poled lithium niobate crystal at 50 °C.

articleTitle: Electroluminescence from a GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructure at high electric fields: Evidence for real- & k-space transfer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study impact-ionization-induced electroluminescence (EL) from a GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructure under high bias. In addition to k-space transfer (the Gunn effect), EL spectra indicate real-space (GaAs-to-AlGaAs) transfer. Microscopy shows strong EL near the anode.

articleTitle: Demonstration of net gain in an erbium chloride silicate single nanowire waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Absorption coefficient of erbium chloride silicate nanowire is studied by monitoring the decay of upconversion emission from a single nanowire waveguide. 30 dB/cm low bound for the net gain is demonstrated for erbium chloride silicate.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope phase stabilization via acoustic frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel scheme for improved feed-forward CEP stabilization of laser amplifiers. Synthesized acoustic few-cycle transients are used to stabilize the CEP of an optical pulse train at the amplifier repetition rate.

articleTitle: Development of terahertz laser frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate broadband terahertz laser frequency combs, compact semiconductor devices that combine the high power of lasers with the broad spectra of pulsed sources.

articleTitle: On-chip supercontinuum generation in a dispersion-controlled silicon-wire waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the broadest on-chip supercontinuum generation, spanning more than 2/3-octave (1300-2200 nm) bandwidth, with an 80-fs laser pulse in the 1.5-μm band by controlling dispersion in a 0.9-cm-long Si-wire waveguide.

articleTitle: SBS mitigation via phase modulation and demodulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present SBS suppression in a single frequency amplifier using frequency sidebands added by an EOM and complete recovery of the single frequency signal after amplification using a custom high power high modulation index EOM.

articleTitle: Cryogenic laser performance of Yb:YAG diode-pumped at 940 nm and 969 nm for high power lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the laser performance of Yb:YAG for different cryogenic tempertures pumped by fibre coupled diode laser emitting at 940 nm and 969 nm. Laser diode bandwidth, absorption bandwidth of laser material plays a crucial role.

articleTitle: Photon transport and localization in optical superlattices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here we examine the photon transport and collimation in optical superlattices, involving transverse guided resonances and disorder-induced localization. With increasing structural disorder, we observe the crossover from cascaded guided resonances into transverse localization modes.

articleTitle: Anisotropic optical polarization of AlGaN based 275 nm light-emitting diodes due to quantum-size effects
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum-size effects strongly influence the valance band and optical polarization of 275nm emitting Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.44</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.56</sub>N layers. It's shown experimentally and theoretically that thinner quantum wells and lower carrier densities result in polarization preferential for light extraction.

articleTitle: Terahertz time-domain magnetospectroscopy using a table-top repetitive pulsed magnet
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed coherent cyclotron resonance oscillations from a two-dimensional electron gas by combining a rapid scanning terahertz time-domain spectrometer with a table-top mini-coil pulsed magnet.

articleTitle: Single-photon-compatible spectral broadening and shaping via nonlinear mixing and phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate spectral broadening and shaping of weak mono-exponentially decaying pulses via nonlinear mixing and phase modulation. This method is compatible with single photons wavepackets generated by quantum emitters.

articleTitle: Producing bright X-rays for imaging applications using a laser wakefield accelerator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the generation of bright multi-keV betatron X-ray radiation using a GeV laser wakefield accelerator and investigate the use of these X-rays for various imaging applications.

articleTitle: Nanopore fluidic SERS
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a technology combining nanopore fluidic with surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) for real-time, single molecule detection. After optimization of both optical and device design, we can control the nanopore like a valve for molecule motions and detect a single nucleotide even at 10 ms.

articleTitle: Dynamic monitoring instrument for fluidic water quality
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optic sensing instrument is developed and demonstrated successfully for the dynamic measurements of fluidic water quality.

articleTitle: Multimode correlations in chip-based frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate correlations between non-twin beams of a frequency comb generated from a silicon nitride ring resonator optical parametric oscillator. The normalized correlation coefficient between these two modes is 0.997, corresponding to near-perfect correlations between the two beams.

articleTitle: Mechanically flexible photonic-crystal cavities on strained-germanium nanomembranes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photonic-crystal cavities compatible with the highly subwavelength thicknesses and flexibility requirements of mechanically-stressed Ge nanomembranes are developed and used to demonstrate a strong (20×) strain-induced light-emission efficiency enhancement.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics in zero index materials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Phase-matching is critical for coherent nonlinear optical processes, allowing nonlinear sources to combine constructively, resulting in more efficient emission. We experimentally demonstrate phase mismatch-free nonlinear propagation in a bulk zero index metamaterial.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral stimulated Raman microscopy with fiber-based, rapidly wavelength swept cw-lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hyperspectral stimulated Raman microscopy system using rapidly wavelength swept lasers is presented. Imaging of biological samples with shot noise limited detection is demonstrated with the fiber based setup.

articleTitle: Bulk optical measurement of topological numbers in photonic lattices with a non-Hermitian system
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Topological insulators have been recently extended to photonics; however, the measurement of their topological invariant has been limited to probing edge states, an indirect measure. Here we optically measure a topological invariant using only bulk information.

articleTitle: Precise time recovery at arbitrary point in fiber-optic loop link with RF phase locking assistance
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Precise time recovery on arbitrary point of fiber-optic link with λ-dispersion-induced RF phase locking assistance is proposed. Experiments have demonstrated the time deviation of 8.34ps@1s averaging and 0.592ps@10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>s averaging within a 30-km fiber loop.

articleTitle: Progress towards the development of rare-earth doped waveguides for quantum communications applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photon echo measurements were conducted on the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> → <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup>D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> transition of Pr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, on a slab waveguide of TeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> deposited on a substrate of 0.005%Pr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> : Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>. Optical coherence times of 62µs were observed, which is consistent with the bulk sample value of 111µs, given the level of instantaneous spectral diffusion. The results indicate that planar waveguide technology could be utilized for quantum communication purposes.

articleTitle: Artificial selection for structural color on butterfly wings and comparison to natural evolution
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We evolved violet structural color from brown-colored butterflies over six generations of artificial selection. The mechanism of color generation was identified and found to mimic the natural evolution of violet/blue color in closely related species.

articleTitle: CEP control of dynamical Bloch oscillations in a bulk semiconductor via ultra-intense multi-THz fields
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dynamical Bloch oscillations and coherent interband polarization in bulk GaSe are controlled by CEP-stable, ultra-intense multi-THz waveforms and result in the emission of phase-stable high-order harmonics covering 12.7 optical octaves from THz to VIS regimes.

articleTitle: Solar cells based on atomically thin crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report photovoltaic energy conversion in atomically thin crystals. We present two device concepts: (i) a lateral p-n junction diode, based on a WSe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> atomic monolayer, where the junction is formed by electrostatic doping using a pair of oppositely biased gate electrodes. (ii) a MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/WSe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> van der Waals heterostructure, that utilizes different electron affinities of both materials for the separation of the photoexcited carriers.

articleTitle: Unidirectional scattering and emission of light mediated by a single-element nanoantenna
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A V-shaped single-element metallic nanoantenna is found to enable unidirectional scattering of light. We experimentally and by means of FDTD simulations show unidirectional scattering of a plane wave and unidirectional emission from photo luminescent molecules coupled to the antenna. An eigenmode analysis reveals the physical origin of this effect and elegantly explains how the direction of the scattered light is reversed depending the excitation type.

articleTitle: Molecular single photons for atomic experiments
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single organic molecules allow for the generation of high-flux single photons. At cryogenic conditions, these photons can be as narrow as a few MHz. It is possible to find suitable molecules matching to a variety of atomic transitions, allowing for quantum hybrid systems of atoms and molecules.

articleTitle: Tunable single-cycle pulse compression at the group-velocity horizon
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An adjustable adiabatic soliton compression scheme is presented, enabling pulse generation in the single-cycle regime. The compression comes without external dispersion compensation and is naturally stimulated by two-pulse collisions in an optical event horizon.

articleTitle: Visibility and contrast enhancement with polarization difference ghost imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that polarization difference ghost imaging can provide the visibility and contrast enhancement, especially when the target is under predominately reflecting objects, complex background or turbid media. It facilitates the practical applications of ghost imaging.

articleTitle: Enhanced self-frequency shift of cavity soliton in mode-locked octave-spanning frequency comb generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show a significant self-frequency shift of ultrafast cavity solitons associated with Kerr frequency combs in a dispersion-flattened nonlinear cavity. Dispersion induces a frequency shift up to 20% of the pump frequency.

articleTitle: Optimized microwave near-field control in a planar ion trap
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a microfabricated planar ion trap with integrated microwave conductors. Using numerical simulations, it has been optimized for multi-qubit operations driven by microwave near-fields and represents a considerable experimental simplification.

articleTitle: Plasmonics: Quantum on the angstrom scale, as observed by surface-enhanced Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate plasmonic dimers consisting of two metallic nanostructures spaced by a few angstroms using lithographic methods, and show that quantum mechanical tunneling across the gaps limits the enhancement in surface-enhanced Raman scattering.

articleTitle: A silicon photonic chip-scale AWGR switch for high performance computing systems
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper demonstrates a silicon-photonic AWGR-based optical switch for HPC systems. Simulations show high throughput and low latency even at high input load. A fabricated silicon-photonic AWGR switch with 32 Tx/Rx pairs showed error-free performance.

articleTitle: Ultra-high energy density relativistic plasmas and x-ray generation by ultrafast laser irradiation of nanowire arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that trapping of femtosecond laser pulses of relativistic intensity deep within nanowire arrays volumetrically heats matter into a new ultra-hot plasma regime with electron densities nearly 100 times critical and multi-keV temperatures.

articleTitle: In-plane surface plasmonics integrated with THz quantum cascade lasers for high collimation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report planar integration of tapered Terahertz (THz) quantum cascade lasers (QCLs) with spoof surface plasmon (SSP) structures. The SSP structure consists of one plasmonic coupler and periodically arranged scatters. The resulting surface-emitting THz beam is highly collimated with a beam divergence as narrow as 3.6°×9.7°. As the beam divergence is inverse proportional to the light emission area, this low divergence indicates a good waveguiding property of the SSP structure, while the low optical background of the beam implies a high coupling efficiency of the THz wave from the laser cavity to the SSPs. Since all the structures are in-plane, this scheme provides a promising platform where the well-established SP techniques can be employed to engineer the THz QCL beam with high flexibilities.

articleTitle: High power, narrow linewidth, micro-integrated semiconductor laser modules designed for quantum sensors in space
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a very robust diode laser module platform for the deployment of cold atom based quantum sensors in space. The micro optical benches not larger than 80 × 25mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> host MOPA and ECDL modules.

articleTitle: Efficient femtosecond mid-infrared pulse generation by dispersivewave radiation in bulk lithium niobate crystal
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate efficient mid-infrared pulse generation by dispersive wave radiation in bulk lithium niobate crystal. Femtosecond mid-IR pulses centering from 2.8-2.92 μm are generated using the single pump wavelengths from 1.25-1.45 μm.

articleTitle: 3D plasmonic nanostructures as building blocks for ultrasensitive Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The fabrication of complex 3D plasmonic nanostructures opens new scenarios towards the realization of high electric field confinement and enhancement. We exploit the unique properties of these nanostructures for performing Raman spectroscopy in the single/few molecules detection limit.

articleTitle: Plasmonic antennas nanocoupler for telecom range: Simulation, fabrication and near-field characterization
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report simulation, fabrication and, for the first time, full amplitude-phase near-field optical characterization in telecom range of the compact and efficient plasmonic nanoantenna based couplers. Near-field data allowed characterizing the subwavelength slot waveguide's propagation losses and effective mode index that correspond well to the simulated ones.

articleTitle: 50×100GHz wavelength tuning in rectangular ring-FP semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report our latest experimental results of the half-wave coupled rectangular ring-FP laser. Wavelength tuning of 50 channels covering L band at 100GHz spacing is achieved, with SMSR up to 41dB. Direct modulation at 2.5Gbps is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Adaptive beam cleanup of a 1.3kW pulsed slab amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present closed-loop adaptive phase compensation of a 1.3 kW solid-state slab laser system. Experimental results demonstrated the beam quality is greatly improved with the proposed adaptive optics system.

articleTitle: Femtosecond 905nm-940nm band Nd:fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a passively all-normal dispersion mode-locked Nd-doped fiber laser at 905–940 nm with high optical to optical efficiency. The central wavelengths can be tunable through tuning birefringent filter.

articleTitle: Mid-IR parametric frequency generation in hybrid As2Se3 microwires using normal dispersion modulation instability
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the observation of modulation instability in the mid-infrared by pumping chalcogenide-polymer optical microwires in the normal dispersion regime. Modulation instability is allowed via negative fourth-order dispersion and leads to far-detuned parametric frequency conversion.

articleTitle: Silicon-based sources and detectors for terahertz applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Todays terahertz instrumentation lacks cost-effective sources and detectors compatible with standard microelectronics to drive down the system cost. This paper presents recent developments based on silicon process technologies and discusses the challenges in implementing source and detectors. It presents a 530 GHz source array with up to 1 mW radiated power, a 1024-pixel CMOS camera, and a heterodyne 830 GHz imaging chip-sets.

articleTitle: Opto-mechanically tunable polymeric microlasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Opto-mechanically controlled liquid crystalline elastomer (LCE) integrated tunable polymeric microgoblet lasers are fabricated on a silicon chip. Symmetrical deformation of uniaxially aligned LCE microcylinders enables expansion of the microgoblet resonators for tuning the lasing modes.

articleTitle: Observation of band gaps in amorphous photonic structures with different temperatures in the near infrared
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We examine numerically and experimentally photonic band-gaps in liquid-like two dimensional photonic materials. Subwavelength dielectric rods and holes are randomly placed with Monte Carlo simulations, fabricated on silicon-on-insulator chips, and measured in near infrared wavelengths.

articleTitle: Distance measurement using serrodyne modulation and two-photon absorption process in Si-APD
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A laser distance measurement using two-photon absorption (TPA) process in a Si-APD is reported. A newly developed configuration introducing serrodyne modulation suppresses the coherent interference noise, enhances TPA detection sensitivity, and reduces the system components.

articleTitle: Chiral polymeric relief structures fabricated by using optical vortices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a chiral single-arm relief on a micro-meter scale formed in an azo-polymer film by the irradiation of a green optical vortex. A 2-dimensional chiral relief array was also fabricated in the azo-polymer film.

articleTitle: Progress in laser-driven ion acceleration towards applications in radiotherapy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We will outline recent progress, in the UK ASAIL laser-ion acceleration programme, which aims to advance laser-driven ion beams to the point at which they will become a serious alternative to conventional accelerators for radiotherapy.

articleTitle: Enhanced second-harmonic generation in gap nanopillars arrays by modal engineering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Second harmonic generation from GaP nanopillars with optimized mode field overlap is analyzed and experimentally demonstrated. We present dispersion engineering in arrays of nanopillars to satisfy modal phase matching.

articleTitle: Structural characterization and luminescence properties of ErxSc2−xSi2O7 prepared by RF sputtering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Polycrystalline Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-x</sub>Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> compounds were fabricated using RF-sputtering by alternating Er<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, Sc<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> layers separated by SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> layer. This new compounds presents excitation cross section at 980nm around 1.39×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-21</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with lifetime of 38 μs.

articleTitle: Meta-coaxial nanoantenna
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Novel meta-coaxial nanoantennas are studied numerically, fabricated and experimentally characterized. These antennas provide local field enhancements of 200-800, super-localized fields with spatial FWHM of ~1nm, and wide spectral ranges with FWHM bandwidths greater than 900nm.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of Vpi reduction in EO modulators using modulation instability
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An electrooptic modulator's half-wave voltage is experimentally lowered by 10-fold for intensity modulated waveforms using modulation instability. Results are reported up to 50 GHz.

articleTitle: χ(2)-lens mode-locking of a high average power Nd:YVO4 laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report over 20 W, 6 ps, 170 MHz, passive mode-locking of a Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser using χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>-lens formation in a LBO frequency doubling crystal. The laser is pumped at 808 nm with optical efficiency of 38%.

articleTitle: Modulated spontaneous emission via the coupling between Fabry-Pérot cavity and surface plasmon polariton modes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The fluorescence is experimentally controlled with bandgap engineering of structured metal surface. Grating duty ratio is optimized as 3/4 and narrow emission spectra are obtained by coupling between Fabry-Pérot cavity and surface plasmon polariton modes.

articleTitle: A quasi-optical tool for the demultiplexing of orbital angular momentum carried at millimeter-wave frequencies
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a quasi-optical component for the simultaneous de-multiplexing of multiple channels by the transformation of OAM into transverse momentum. A communications link comprising 4 independent channels is demonstrated achieving a data rate of 8 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Local fluorescent dye excitation with guided second-harmonic in lithium niobate nanowires
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have generated second-harmonic (SH) signal in lithium niobate (LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) nanowires (NWs) to locally excite fluorescent dye in typical cell staining concentration. We show the second-order behavior of the SH signal in a NW with cross-section of 400×600 nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. A guided SH power of 63±6 pW is needed to detect dye excitation in a 1 μg/ml DAPI dye solution. We also perform simulations to define that the LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> NWs with cross-sections down to 40×60nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are potentially able to produce the threshold amount of the SH power.

articleTitle: Miniature droplet-based FRET lasers stabilized by superhydrophobic surfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optofluidic microlasers based on liquid microdroplets stabilized by a superhydrophobic surface. Lasing is achieved using highly efficient non-radiative Förster resonance energy transfer between donor and acceptor molecules placed within the droplets.

articleTitle: Surface and volume photoemission of hot electrons from plasmonic nanoantennas
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically compare surface- and volume-based photoelectron emission from spherical nanoparticles, obtaining analytical expressions for the emission rate in both mechanisms. We show that the surface mechanism prevails, being unaffected by detrimental hot electron collisions.

articleTitle: A fully integrated chip-scale optomechanical oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a chip-scale slot-type photonic crystal optomechanical oscillator fully integrated with an on-chip waveguide Ge photoreceiver, which exhibits high-harmonic tunable RF oscillations and high-quality optical resonances with controlled detuned continuous-wave laser drive.

articleTitle: Hybrid photon-plasmon nanowire lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
