publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using phase-conjugate beam generated by second-order nonlinear process, blurred images caused by atmospheric turbulence were fully recovered. Due to instantaneous response, it is perhaps the only scheme for efficiently recovering image distorted by atmospheric turbulence.

articleTitle: Serial optical coherence scanner for brain imaging and mapping
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The serial optical coherence scanner reconstructs macroscopic tissues at microscopic resolution using intrinsic optical contrasts. The anatomy, nerve fiber architectures and fiber orientations are shown in ex-vivo rat brains.

articleTitle: Displacement of entanglement back and forth between the micro and macro domains
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an experimental observation of heralded entanglement involving two components that can be distinguished with detectors resolving only large photon number differences. We demonstrate entanglement in states containing over 500 photons.

articleTitle: Single-mode polariton laser in a designable microcavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate strong coupling and a coherent polariton laser in a microcavity consisting of a sub-wavelength grating in the top mirror. The designable grating mirror allows 3D confinement, polarization selectivity, and dispersion engineering by design.

articleTitle: Highly stable continuous wave terahertz generation with widely tunable dual-mode laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Presented here is a highly stable CW THz generation utilizing a dual-mode laser capable of producing a wide range of differential frequencies. This laser employs an AOTF in a single external cavity for dual-mode selection.

articleTitle: Quantum correlations beyond Tsirelson's bound
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We optically demonstrate violation of the CHSH-Bell inequality and Tsirelson's bound via loss and postselection. This enables us to more easily distinguish between entangled and unentangled states, and violates information causality with the postselected data.

articleTitle: CEP dependent high-order harmonic generation at 200 kHz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the carrier-envelope phase dependent high-order harmonic generation in argon at 200 kHz repetition rate using ultra-short laser pulses from an optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier.

articleTitle: Optofluidic manipulation and sorting for small size particle and bio-molecule
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: It is significant research approach in the field of manipulation and sorting of a small size of particle and molecule with dimensions of tens to hundreds of nanometers in a microfluidic chip. It is a breakthrough research that provides new solutions and opportunities for a wide range of traditional micro-/nano-particle and molecule sorting, manipulation and detection by using optofluidic force. Also, this new innovation allows scientists and researchers to tackle many classical problems with novel tools and new research ideas.

articleTitle: Dealing with Loss in plasmonics and metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Loss in the metal is the main factor restricting practicality of plasmonic and metamaterial devices. In this tutorial the inevitability of the loss, its physical origins and the means to mitigate it will be considered

articleTitle: The optimized probe light frequency detuning for Faraday-rotation cesium atomic magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that the sensitivity of all-optical Faraday-rotation magnetometer can be improved by tuning probe light frequency to the edge of wings of Doppler profile with cesium atoms, which coincides with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Ultrathin nanostructured metals for highly transmissive plasmonic subtractive color filters
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a systematic investigation of the counter-intuitive phenomenon of Extraordinary Low Transmission through ultrathin nanostructured metals, and present results on novel plasmonic subtractive color filters, exhibiting both record-high transmission efficiency and spatial resolution.

articleTitle: GeV electrons and high brightness betatron x-rays from petawatt-laser-driven plasma accelerators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We identify three regimes of correlated GeV-electron/keV-betatron-X-ray generation by a laser-plasma accelerator driven by the Texas Petawatt laser, and relate them to variations in strength of blowout, injection geometry and beam loading.

articleTitle: High-throughput optical biosensing arrays detection using white light fourier transform method
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High-throughput detection of a large-area chip-based gold nanoslit biosensing array was detected using an imaging system based on white light Fourier transform spectrometry, with the detection sensitivity 0.02 in index change and 60nM of anti-BSA.

articleTitle: A 160 mW output, 5 kHz linewidth frequency-stabilized erbium silica fiber laser with a short cavity configuration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 160 mW output, <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> frequency-stabilized erbium silica fiber laser. The frequency stability reached 8.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> for τ=100 s. Furthermore, a linewidth of 5 kHz and a RIN of -130 dB/Hz were simultaneously achieved.

articleTitle: Titanium nitride nanoparticles for therapeutic applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Titanium nitride nanoparticles exhibit plasmonic resonances in the biological transparency window where high absorption efficiencies can be obtained with small dimensions. Both lithographic and colloidal samples are examined from the perspective of nanoparticle thermal therapy.

articleTitle: Synchronization of multiple optomechanical oscillators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design and fabricate a 2 × 2 optomechanical oscillator array. We show the onset of synchronized mechanical oscillations when the array is excited by a single continuous wave laser.

articleTitle: Novel physics in photonic crystal nanolasers : Dynamics and coherence
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Lasers of diffraction-limited volumes involve the interaction of small numbers of particles (photons and dipoles). We demonstrate that these small populations of discrete particles induce large intensity noise in the output of the laser.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics and quantum networks based on single atoms coupled to a photonic crystal cavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an experimental demonstration of an optical switch operating in the quantum regime, consisting of a single trapped atom near a nanoscale photonic crystal cavity.

articleTitle: GZO/ZnO multilayered nanodisk metasurface to engineer the plasma frequency
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A metal/dielectric multilayered metasurface can be used to engineer the plasma frequency by controlling the ratio between the metal and dielectric layers. In this work, we demonstrate that a multilayered nanodisk metasurface based on semiconductor materials offers the design flexibility for tuning the plasmonic resonance.

articleTitle: Low cost all-dielectric thin-film solar cell using diffuse medium reflectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Diffuse reflectors can be beneficial for solar cells, due to no plasmonic loss, higher reflectance, decent light scattering, and low cost. Experimental and theoretical works are presented here to demonstrate its feasibility for photovoltaics.

articleTitle: A frequency comb that maintains optical coherence under significant vibrations
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss the design and performance of an all polarization-maintaining self-referenced frequency comb that can maintain optical coherence with an optical reference laser under strong vibrations from a shaker table and a moving vehicle.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable pressure-sensitive terahertz metamaterials using liquid metals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a liquid metal-based reconfigurable terahertz metamaterial device that is not only pressure driven, but also exhibits pressure memory. The discrete response is obtained by injecting eutectic gallium indium into a microfluidic structure.

articleTitle: Network of femtosecond degenerate OPOs for solving NP-Hard Ising problems
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report implementation of a configurable network of four degenerate optical parametric oscillators as an Ising spin system using time-multiplexed femtosecond pulses. This coherent Ising machine solves an instance of NP-hard MAXCUT problem without error.

articleTitle: Single-shot coherent Raman multiplex planar imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a coherent Raman technique for simultaneous planar imaging and multiplex spectroscopy provided in a single-laser-shot. Spatially correlated spectra from multiple species in a two-dimensional field are presented and possible gas-phase applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Adjustment of optical path-length difference of nested Mach-Zehnder structure utilizing optical phase shift in waveguide junction
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical-path length difference of Mach-Zehnder structures embedded on an optical switch can be adjusted within less than 1.6 % of FSR of the structure, without detecting radiation mode of the structure.

articleTitle: Pulsed Sagnac polarization-entangled photon source with a PPKTP crystal at telecom wavelength
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate pulsed polarization-entangled photons generated from a periodically poled KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> (PPKTP) crystal in a Sagnac interferometer configuration at telecom wavelength. We achieved fidelities of 0.981 ± 0.0002 for |ψ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>〉 and 0.980 ± 0.001 for |ψ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>〉 respectively.

articleTitle: Quantum limited parameter estimation with pulse shaped frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Combining a multi-color homodyne detection scheme with techniques from quantum optics, we show the feasibility of shot-noise limited measurements of a medium's parameters, while also being able to compensate for their fluctuations.

articleTitle: Extended infrared absorption to 2.2 µm with Ge1−xSnx photodetectors grown on silicon
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Thin film Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> photodetectors fabricated on Si using a CMOS compatible process had responsivities at 1.55 μm of 6.59, 1.49, 2.63, and 0.84 mA/W for 0.9, 2.57, 3.2, and 7.0 % Sn. Spectral response for a Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.93</sub>Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.07</sub> photodetector had extended infrared response out to 2.2 μm.

articleTitle: Fast convergence single-stage adaptive frequency domain equalizer in few mode fiber transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a fast convergence single-stage adaptive frequency domain algorithm for simultaneously compensating CD&DMGD in few-mode fiber system. The proposed algorithm can increase the convergence speed by 51% with 8% complexity increase.

articleTitle: Broadband terahertz generation approaching optical communication frequency using tilted DAST crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: To realize ultrabroadband terahertz time-domain spectroscopy reaching near-infrared spectral regions, we investigated the type-I phase matching conditions of the difference frequency generation in DAST crystals. Crystal tilting is found to be efficient for near-infrared generation.

articleTitle: Impact of absorber bias voltage on the optical feedback sensitivity of a passively mode-locked quantum dot laser operating at elevated temperature
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A feedback-sensitivity study of a two-section, passively mode-locked quantum dot laser operating at elevated temperature suggests that the absorber bias voltage is critical in determining the feedback-response of the device, even under the resonant configuration.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared passively mode-locked fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Stable and self-starting passively mode-locked pulses of 6 ps, 465 W peak power, are produced from a holmium-praseodymium co-doped ring fiber laser at 2.9 μm, with a repetition rate of 24.8 MHz.

articleTitle: 45W CW TEM00 mode diode-side-pumped Nd:YAG rod laser with linearly polarized beam
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a commercial, diode-side pumped Nd:YAG rod laser module, we obtain more than 53% extraction efficiency in fundamental mode with respect to multimode operation in a fully polarized beam.

articleTitle: Silicon on sapphire chip based mid-infrared optical spectroscopy for detection of chemical warfare simulant Triethyl phosphate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Triethyl phosphate (TEP), a chemical warfare simulant, has absorption peaks in the mid-infrared. Using a single mode slot wave guide we were able to detect TEP, with a detection limit down to 75 ppm. This provides enhanced sensitivity while simultaneously achieving device miniaturization.

articleTitle: Dual-resonant-band enhanced optical transmission through star shape bull's eye
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two resonant bands in enhanced optical transmission were predicted in a star shape bull's eye plasmonic structure. Fundamental and its second harmonic resonance were analyzed parametrically to find optimal conditions for linear and nonlinear responses.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive refractive index sensor utilizing plasmonic resonance splitting
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally an ultra-sensitive RI sensor based on plasmonic slot nano-antenna arrays utilizing a novel resonance splitting phenomenon observed at small incidence angles. Sensitivities exceeding 1000nm/RIU and high FOM exceeding 50 are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ultra low-loss hypocycloid-core kagome hollow-core photonic crystal fiber for the green spectral-range applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the development of hypocycloidal-core kagome HC-PCF operating efficiently in the 450nm-650nm visible spectral range. Transmission loss as low as 70dB/km is achieved. Strong Raman comb generation and laser beam delivery are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fluorescent scanning near-field probe maps the radiative and non-radiative local density of optical states at the nanometer scale
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel approach for mapping the radiative and non-radiative local density of states in the near-field of a nanostructure by using a fluorescent near-field probe. Experiments are in quantitative agreement with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Holographic design of light in the volume of photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop holographic methods to generate arbitrarily-shaped light intensity distributions inside photonic crystals slabs, through shaping the electromagnetic field launched at the facets of the crystal. The technique can be generalized to any photonic structure.

articleTitle: Phonon-mediated spin-photon interface with a diamond nanomechanical oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose the use of diamond nanomechanical oscillator to mediate coupling between electron spins and arbitrary optical modes in a whispering-gallery optical resonator. Fabrication and characterization of the diamond nanomechanical oscillator will also be presented.

articleTitle: Infrared Digital Holography as new 3D imaging tool for first responders and firefighters: Recent achievements and perspectives
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work we demonstrate a novel concept for imaging live humans through smoke and flames. We make use of lens-less Digital Holography at far Infrared Radiation (IRDH) to discard the flame emission, thus overcoming the limits of current IR sensors. Hence, new imaging devices can be developed and employed by firefighters on the field in case of fire accidents.

articleTitle: Continuous-variable measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution with imperfect detectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the performance of continuous-variable measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution will decline dramatically when considering detector's imperfections. However, it can be improved by using phase sensitive optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Spectrally coherent efficient femtosecond Stokes pulse generation from a photonic crystal fiber with two zero dispersion wavelengths (TZDW)
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental characterization of spectral coherence of Stokes-side continuum from fiber with two zero dispersion wavelength. We achieve 3-nJ, coherent Stokes pulses localized ~1.28 μm from 300-fs Yb:fiber laser with 32% efficiency.

articleTitle: Spatially resolved characterization of gas - metallic nanoparticle interaction by energy loss spectroscopy in an environmental transmission electron microscope
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use an environmental transmission electron microscope to identify gas adsorption sites for various concentrations of hydrogen and carbon monoxide on Au nanoparticles by collecting electron energy-loss spectra. Experimental results are consistent with simulation.

articleTitle: Subharmonics generation based on synchronization of self-pulsation and optomechanical oscillation in a monolithic silicon cavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We studied the coexistence of optomechanical oscillation and self-pulsation in a monolithic silicon cavity. By mapping laser-cavity detuning and power, the optomechanical-to-self-pulsation transitions are observed with rich nonlinear dynamics, e.g. chaotic, mixing and synchronized regimes.

articleTitle: Mueller polarimetric endoscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Mueller polarimetric imaging is a promising technique which is able to provide additional polarisation contrast for surgical imaging. In this work, an improved 3×3 Mueller matrix and a 4×4 Mueller matrix endoscopic system were constructed and images of rat abdomen were obtained and decomposed to quantify depolarisation, diattenuation and linear retardance.

articleTitle: Gain dynamics in Er:Yb co-doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Gain dynamics of Er:Yb fiber amplifiers were studied analytically and corresponding transfer functions were measured, showing good agreement with the theoretical treatment. In addition, numerical investigations have been carried out to get deeper insight.

articleTitle: 1.8 watt RF power and 60% power conversion efficiency based on photodiode flip-chip-bonded on diamond
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 1.8 W RF output power at 10 GHz and 60 % power conversion efficiency (PCE) at 6 GHz have been achieved using a modified uni-traveling-carrier photodiode flip-chip bonded on diamond.

articleTitle: Simultaneous fingerprint and high-wavenumber confocal raman spectroscopy enables real-time in vivo diagnosis of colonic cancer at endoscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the implementation of a novel simultaneous fingerprint and high wavenumber confocal Raman technique developed for enhancing real-time in vivo diagnosis of colonic cancer during colonoscopic examination.

articleTitle: Chalcogenide microfiber photonic synapses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical axons and photonic synapses implemented using chalcogenide microfibers allow the generation and propagation of photonic action potentials which give rise to the demonstration of various neuromorphic concepts.

articleTitle: Coherent excitation of multiple nano-opto-mechanical modes in silicon with ultrafast time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first time-domain measurement of a guided-wave nano-opto-mechanical system, resulting in the coherent excitation of multiple mechanical modes. We deconvolved the electronic and mechanical responses to observe the evolution of the coherent superposition.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of quantum emitter with on-chip beam-splitter for quantum information processing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the monolithic integration of an on-demand quantum emitter in the form of a single self-assembled InGaAs quantum dot with an air clad, free standing directional coupler acting as a beam-splitter for anti-bunched light.

articleTitle: Tunable liquid crystal-loaded metasurfaces for IR and THz applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a family of compact and efficient IR and THz electro-optical modulators based on active planar metamaterials (metasurfaces) hybridised with liquid crystals.

articleTitle: Tunable monoenergetic electron beams from staged ionization assisted laser wakefield accelerator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By employing a pair of partially overlapped supersonic gas jets, we made a separation of injection and acceleration stages of laser wakefield acceleration and produced stable, quasi-monoenergetic (10-30% FWHM) and tunable (50-300 MeV) electron beams.

articleTitle: Sparse imaging with metamaterials at terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Metamaterials are composite structures which permit unprecedented control over light matter interactions. Here we show use of metamaterials as spatial light modulators permitting single pixel compressive imaging at terahertz frequencies.

articleTitle: Spin-polarized light emission from quantum dots coupled to multipolar nanoantennas
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate spin-polarized light emission from quantum dots coupled to a single-element nanoantenna with resonant multipolar moments. We observe spin-momentum locking resulting in photons of opposite spin emitted in opposite directions.

articleTitle: High power Er-doped Yb-free double-clad fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present simple and efficient laser schemes based on newly developed Er-doped fibers cladding pumped at 976 nm. 103 W CW-power amplifier with 37 % conversion efficiency and 1.5 mJ-pulse energy nanosecond laser were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Bidimensional nano-optomechanics and topological backaction in a non-conservative radiation force field
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We explore the vectorial optomechanical interaction between a nanowire and a focused beam of light. The nanowire is sensitive to the topological variations of the focused laser force field which dramatically modify the phenomenology of the dynamical backaction.

articleTitle: The role played on the Yb:LuAG laser performance by high doping levels and high ion excitation density
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the laser performance achieved by 15 at.% Yb:LuAG crystal. Experimental evidences of a non-linear loss mechanism which occurs at high ion excitation density is observed and characterized.

articleTitle: CMOS compatible ultra-compact modulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A planar layout for an ultra-compact plasmonic modulator is proposed and numerically investigated. Our device utilizes potentially CMOS compatible materials and can achieve 3-dB modulation in just 65nm and insertion loss <1dB at telecommunication wavelengths.

articleTitle: Spectrally interleaved, comb-mode-resolved, dual-terahertz-comb spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated combination of spectrally interleaved terahertz (THz) frequency comb with dual-comb spectroscopy, enabling us to achieve the spectral sampling equal to linewidth of the comb tooth in the low-pressure gas spectroscopy in THz region.

articleTitle: Solid state mobile lidar for ozone atmospheric profiling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tunable Ce:LiCAF laser is pumped by a CLBO crystal pumped by a doubled Nd:YLF laser running at 1 kHz. The UV tunable Ce:LiCAF laser produces two UV pulses between 280 to 295nm. These pulses are transmitted into the atmosphere to profile the concentration of ozone as a function of altitude.

articleTitle: Extreme terahertz nonlinearities in undoped GaAs driven by ultrahigh near-fields in metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Local terahertz fields of multiple 10 MV/cm tailored in gold metamaterials drive electronic interband transitions in intrinsic GaAs. The bandgap exceeds the THz photon energy 400-fold. Photoluminescence microscopy maps the THz near-field distribution.

articleTitle: Nonlocal polarization interferometer for entanglement detection
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an interferometer consisting of two spatially separated balanced Mach-Zehnder interferometers sharing a polarization entangled source. Nonlocal correlation statistics enable entanglement detection, Bell state identification, and fidelity bounding.

articleTitle: Efficient single photon sources based on nanodiamonds on a plasmonic platform
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an efficient room-temperature source of single photons based on single nitrogen-vacancy centers in nanodiamonds (NDs) placing on a large-area plasmonic platform formed by crystalline gold flakes covered with a thin dielectric layer. Due to the strongly confined plasmonic fields in the thin dielectric layer, the NDs show a large enhancement in the fluorescence intensity without significant degradation in single photon purity. According to the deduced fluorescence lifetime from g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> measurements, the Purcell factor is estimated to be ~1.4. The plasmonic platform is very ideal for large-area fluorescence enhancement without the needs of sophisticated nanopositioning schemes for locating NDs at local hot spots in conventional plasmonic nanostructures.

articleTitle: Jitter reduction in digitally synchronized lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We synchronize a modelocked Ti:sapphire laser to a 2.8GHz RF reference with 25fs jitter using an all-digital phase-locked loop, and a new technique for measuring the closed-loop transfer function and optimizing complex gain.

articleTitle: Quantum non-Gaussian and Gaussian states at multiple side-band frequencies
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We simultaneously generate photon-subtracted squeezed vacuum and squeezed vacuum at three frequencies from an optical parametric oscillator by utilizing its frequency nondegenerate side-bands. Quantum non-Gaussianity is demonstrated by applying a novel character witness.

articleTitle: High-power, continuous-wave Cr:colquiriite lasers pumped by multi-mode diodes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report multi-mode diode pumped, continuous-wave Cr:Colquiriite lasers with up to 2.54-W of near infrared (800–850 nm) and 0.9-W of blue (400 nm) output power, with optical-to-optical conversion efficiencies as high as 33%.

articleTitle: Compact multisection cavity switches in metal-dielectric-metal plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a compact absorption switch consisting of a plasmonic metal-dielectric-metal waveguide coupled to a multisection cavity. The optimized multisection cavity switch leads to greatly enhanced modulation depth compared to an optimized Fabry-Perot cavity switch.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband near-infrared dual-comb spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We extend the spectral bandwidth of dual-comb spectroscopy over a hundred THz using two optical frequency combs with relative linewidth of sub-Hz level. We record the spectra of the entire vibration band of acetylene.

articleTitle: Phosphor-saving, excellent color-rendering index candlelight LEDs containing composite photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this study, a technique that saved phosphor use was applied to warm white light-emitting diodes containing 3D photonic crystals to develop the candlelight that exhibits a high luminous flux and an excellent color-rendering index.

articleTitle: Terahertz conversion efficiency scaling by optical rectification in the 800 nm pump-wavelength range
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a record 800 nm-to-terahertz energy conversion efficiency of 0.13% at room temperature in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> by tilting the pulse intensity front and experimentally studying optimal pumping conditions.

articleTitle: Low-loss plasmonic titanium nitride strip waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work we report low-loss insulator-metal-insulator plasmonic interconnects using the CMOS-compatible material titanium nitride. The mode profile shows the characteristic exponential decay of the plasmonic regime, with propagation losses as low as 0.79 dB/mm.

articleTitle: RLS filter-based interrogation of fiber-optic extrinsic Fabry-Perot interferometry sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A technique for interrogation of fiber-optic extrinsic Fabry-Perot interferometry sensors, based on adaptive filtering, is reported. This approach achieves 9.6 pm accuracy on Fabry-Perot cavity length (equivalent to 0.045 mmHg pressure) and improved noise resilience.

articleTitle: Demonstration of high-dimensional frequency-bin entanglement
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We exhibit high-dimensional frequency-bin entanglement from a mode-locked two-photon source via frequency-correlation measurement and Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. Generalized Bell-inequality is tested by Franson interference, showing revival interference fringes, with maximum visibility of 98.6%.

articleTitle: Subwavelength multilayer dielectrics: Ultrasensitive transmission and breakdown of effective-medium
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that a structure of alternating dielectric layers with deep subwavelength thicknesses exhibits novel transmission effects that depend on the order of the layers and on nanometer scale variations of the layer widths.

articleTitle: Optical characteristics of 1.3-µm Dual-Mode Laser Diode With Integrated Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 1.3-μm dual-mode laser diode with an integrated semiconductor optical amplifier has been developed as an optical beat source for a continuous-wave terahertz system via the photomixing method. It exhibits a high output power of over 80 mW and a wide optical beat frequency tuning range 250-1480 GHz.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband coherent infrared spectroscopy using air-plasma based generation and detection
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generated ultrabroadband coherent infrared pulses by focusing hollow-fiber compressed intense 10-fs pulses in air. We also coherently detected the electric-field profiles in the whole infrared range through the field-induced second harmonic generation in air.

articleTitle: Concentration of broadband terahertz radiation using a periodic array of conically tapered apertures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the optical concentration properties of periodic arrays of conically tapered metallic apertures. We also discuss possible future transmission enhancement that utilize cascaded structures by tilting the apertures towards the array center.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional spectral-encoding for high speed arbitrary patterned illumination
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new tool for scaling the speed of arbitrary patterned illumination by two-dimensional spectral-encoding. A multi-objective optimization based on genetic algorithm is presented for its utility in different imaging modalities.

articleTitle: Nanoplasmonic phased array superlens with extended depth of focus
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce the numerical design, analysis and fabrication of a novel nanoplasmonic phased array architecture for superlensing with geometrically controllable depth of focus.

articleTitle: Hand-held RCM/OCT probe for assessing skin burns
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hand-held probe combining high-resolution reflectance confocal microscopy (RCM) and optical coherence tomography (OCT) within the same optical path was developed and preliminarily tested for assessing skin burns. The preliminary results show that these two optical technologies have complementary capabilities that can help the clinician to more rapidly identify the dermal-epidermal junction, determine the integrity of the epidermal layer, and determine tissue perfusion status.

articleTitle: Pump-linewidth-tolerant wavelength conversion with coherent pumps
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a pump-linewidth-tolerant wavelength conversion scheme with coherent two-tone pump, and demonstrate high quality wavelength conversion of 64QAM signals with <0.3-dB penalty at BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> even using 3.5MHz-linewidth DFB pump source.

articleTitle: Mechanisms of THz trapping devices based on plasmonic grating
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The mechanisms of plasmonic THz wave trapping devices is attributed to the transformation from surface modes to cavity modes which have a saturated state. An ultraslow THz waveguide is realized by controlling the modes transformation.

articleTitle: Multi-photon photoluminescence spectral behavior of single gold nanorods
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The spectral shape and nonlinear order of optical emission from single gold nanorods is investigated. The results highlight the complex absorption cascade in the out-of-equilibrium electronic distribution after few-cycle excitation by near-infrared pulses.

articleTitle: Near-field measurements of soliton fission in nanophotonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate soliton fission induced by free-carriers for the first time. Using time-resolved near-field measurements, we directly observe the nonlinear pulse evolution along the 1.5 millimeter nanophotonic waveguide in-situ, a record short fission length.

articleTitle: Coherent control of Snell's law
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate coherent control of the generalized Snell's law in ultrathin gradient metasurfaces constructed by an array of V-shaped slot nanoantennas.

articleTitle: Simple all optical modulation format conversion from 4×12.5 Gbps NRZ-OOK to 50 Gbps PDM RZ-QPSK using cross-phase modulation in a bidirectional scheme
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed and experimentally demonstrated a low-complexity and cost-effectiveness format converter using XPM in a single HNLF. Four individual 12.5 Gbps NRZ-OOK to one 50 Gbps PDM RZ-QPSK format conversion is successfully achieved.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Fourier-transform spectroscopy using ultrabroadband pulses for measurement of photobleaching spectra of fluorescent proteins
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the measurement of photobleaching spectra of fluorescent proteins with nonlinear Fourier-transform spectroscopy using ultrabroadband femtosecond pulses. Photobleaching of two-photon excited fluorescent molecules occurs through one-photon excited-state absorption.

articleTitle: Gold nanorod reshaping using a continuous wave laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Gold nanorods for photothermal therapy are shown, using spectroscopy and electron microscopy, to reshape after irradiation with a 6W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> continuous wave laser, affecting their absorption coefficient and thus their clinical efficacy.

articleTitle: Plasmonic quasi-dark mode excitation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Progress in the excitation of ‘dark-modes’ in plasmonic structures is reported. The interaction of vector beams possessing a spatially inhomogeneous polarization profile with plasmonic nanostructures provides an avenue to probe these resonances.

articleTitle: Observation of Brillouin scattering induced transparency in a silica microsphere resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate induced transparency in silica microsphere resonator using forward Brillouin scattering.

articleTitle: High-resolution, stimulated-emission-based measurement of the joint spectral correlations of photon pairs produced in optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the measurement of photon-pair joint spectral correlations in optical fiber through stimulated four-wave mixing. This method enables us to study correlations more easily, precisely and quickly than with traditional coincidence counting measurements.

articleTitle: Coupling of quantum dots with a photon cage
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the investigation of the coupling between the high-Q mode of a tri-dimensional hollow silicon-based micro-resonator and PbS quantum dots in the near-infrared range, using near-field scanning optical microscopy and far-field spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Efficient heralding of passively spatial-multiplexed O-band photons for noise-tolerant quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an O-band passively spatial-multiplexed heralded photon source with 74.5% heralding efficiency for noise-tolerant quantum key distribution. Relation between QBER and noise-degraded g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(0) of heralded photons transmitted over a 10-km-long fiber is observed.

articleTitle: On chip wide angle beam steering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an on-chip optical phased array fabricated in a CMOS compatible process with continuous, fast (100 kHz), wide-angle (51°) beam-steering that is suitable for applications such as low-cost lidar systems.

articleTitle: Compact and ultra-high-resolution spectrograph with multi-GHz optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 4-GHz optical frequency comb with a laser-diode pumped Yb:Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ceramic oscillator is demonstrated. Each comb tooth was resolved by a home-made, sub-gigahertz frequency resolution grating spectrograph, which would be useful for many small observatories.

articleTitle: Symmetric and asymmetric T-shaped plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate, experimentally characterize and numerically validate the origin of modes on periodically spaced T-shaped structure for Terahertz input. Effect of parameters such as height, periodicity, asymmetry and symmetry of `T' structure is explained.

articleTitle: An integrated programmable quantum photonic processor for linear optics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a reconfigurable silicon quantum photonic network for implementing general linear optics transformations in the spatial mode basis. This network enables implementation of a range of quantum algorithms; we discuss the phase estimation algorithm.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength interferencing with thermal light
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We reported sub-wavelength spatial interferencing with unity visibility with thermal light, measuring fringe width of 15 nm for a used 780 nm laser beam.

articleTitle: Tunable sources from the visible to vacuum-UV based on gas-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High-energy, single-mode, coherent, ultrafast pulses of light - tunable from the vacuum-UV to the visible spectral region - can be generated in gas-filled hollow-core photonic-crystal fibers through a simple experimental scheme.

articleTitle: Theory of scattering loss during spontaneous parametric downconversion in waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We consider simultaneous SPDC and scattering loss in waveguides by coupling waveguide modes to a reservoir. We calculate that a reduction in pair generation efficiency can be accompanied by an increase in heralded photon purity.

articleTitle: Silicon chip based near-infrared and mid-infrared optical spectroscopy for volatile organic compound sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compared different on-chip silicon based absorption sensors for the detection of xylene in water in both near-infrared and mid-infrared with detection limit down to 1ppb. Strip waveguide, slot waveguide and PC-based chip integrated optical absorption spectroscopy devices are compared in near-infrared and mid-infrared. The results provide a route for enhanced sensitivity while retaining device miniaturization.

articleTitle: High-sensitivity spectral phase retrieval of 7.2 fs pulse by shaper-assisted modified interferometric field autocorrelation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on spectral phase retrieval of 16 pJ, 7.2 fs pulse and tailored waveforms at 800 nm by shaper-assisted modified interferometric field autocorrelation. Experiment results confirm the high accuracy and reproducibility of this method.

articleTitle: Impact of photon statistics on Two-Photon Excited Fluorescence
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on utilizing the photon bunching effect in thermal light to enhance the efficiency of Two-Photon Excited Fluorescence (TPEF) under continuous wave illumination. This has potential applications in microscopy.

articleTitle: Tunable frequency comb generation from a microring with a thermal heater
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel comb tuning method for microresonator-based Kerr comb generators. Continuously tunable, low-noise, and coherent comb generation is achieved in a CMOS-compatible silicon nitride microring resonator.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimization of magnesiothermically-formed porous silicon in silicon-on-insulator microresonator sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a model for silicon-on-insulator microresonators with magnesiothermically-formed porous silicon cladding possessing three-dimensional interconnected pores. Investigation of waveguide design and geometrical parameters indicates an optimized areal mass sensitivity of ∼ 0.2 pm/(pg/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>).

articleTitle: Optogenetic approaches for deciphering the neural circuits of the cortex
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent developments in optogenetics have generated new opportunities for deciphering the synaptic organization of the cortex, a massively interconnected neuronal network essential for generating a rich repertoire of behavior, including perception and voluntary movement.

articleTitle: Optimized vector-quantization-based signal constellation design (OVQ-SCD) for multidimensional optical transport
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optimized-vector-quantization-based signal-constellation-design (OVQ-SCD) suitable for multidimensional-optical-transport is proposed, in which signal-constellation-radii-transformation- function is optimized and near-uniform-distribution of points is achieved. The OVQ-SCDs significantly outperform corresponding counterparts and can be used to enable beyond 1Pb/s serial-optical-transport.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband non-collinear quasi-phase-matching in a hybrid mid-infrared OPCPA system
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a proof-of-principle of broadband, non-collinear quasi-phase-matching in a hybrid OPCPA system. It employs a combination of quasi-phase-matching and group-velocity-matching in a MgO:PPLN delivering 3.4-μm, 17.2-μJ, 43.1-fs pulses at 50 kHz repetition-rate.

articleTitle: Ultrafine control of partially loaded single plasmonic nanoantennas fabricated using e-beam lithography and helium ion beam milling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Plasmonic resonance shift between capacitive and conductive coupling of a partially loaded dimer antenna has been achieved by the ultrafine control of milling partial antenna gaps with nanometer precision using a helium ion beam microscope.

articleTitle: Comparison of VO2 thin films deposited by pulsed laser, electron-beam and sputter deposition
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The optical performance and morphology of VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> thins films deposited by electron beam evaporation, rf magnetron sputtering and pulsed laser deposition are compared. Laser-deposited films are strongly affected by substrate dewetting and epitaxial mismatch.

articleTitle: High harmonic generation in graphene at terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We employ a density-matrix formalism in the length gauge to simulate the nonlinear terahertz response of graphene. The generation of high harmonics is dominated by the strong interplay between intraband and interband dynamics.

articleTitle: All chalcogenide Raman-parametric laser, wavelength converter and broadband source in a single microwire
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a chalcogenide microwire device that acts as a compact (~11 cm length, ~1 μm diameter) and power efficient (sub-Watt threshold peak power, >2% slope efficiency) Raman-parametric laser, wavelength converter and ultra-broadband supercontinuum generator/amplifier.

articleTitle: Tunable pulse-shaping with gated graphene nanoribbons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a pulse-shaper made of gated graphene nanoribbons. Simulations demonstrate tunable control over the shapes of transmitted and reflected pulses using the gating bias. Initial fabrication and characterization of graphene elements is also discussed.

articleTitle: Theory and experimental verification of Kramers-Kronig self-phasing in coherently combined fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The recently observed self-phasing of coherently coupled fibers due to Kramers-Kronig effects is theoretically described using a simple model. Direct measurements of the Kramers-Kronig effect and Henry's alpha parameter are reported.

articleTitle: Detection of single nanoparticles using photonic crystal enhanced microscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a label-free biosensor imaging approach that utilizes a photonic-crystal surface to detect attachment of individual nanoparticles down to ~65×30×30nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Matching nanoparticle plasmon resonant-frequency to the photonic-crystal resonance substantially increases sensitivity of the approach.

articleTitle: Efficient regenerative self-pulsating sources
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an improved design of regenerative self-pulsating sources including large filter bandwidths. Pico- and sub-picosecond pulses of energies 20× higher than previously reported are observed in a setup increasing the source efficiency.

articleTitle: Gain from helium-xenon discharges in hollow optical fibres at 3 to 3.5 µm
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Gain is observed for the first time in gas discharges in flexible hollow-core optical fibres. Helium-xenon DC discharges in 1m long fibres show gain on three laser transitions at 3.11, 3.37 and 3.51μm.

articleTitle: Tunable hyperbolic metamaterials using metal-insulator transition in VO2
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a tunable hyperbolic metamaterial by exploiting the metal-insulator phase transition in vanadium oxide and demonstrate the transition of its in-plane dielectric constant from positive to negative value by temperature control.

articleTitle: Generation of 300 ps laser pulse with 1.2 J energy at 532 nm by stimulated Brillouin scattering in water
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate SBS pulse compression in water from 10 ns, 2.3 J to 300 ps, 1.2 J. To our best knowledge, this is the highest compressible energy that has been achieved at 532 nm.

articleTitle: Direct interferometric measurements of the acoustic waves from femtosecond filaments
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interferometric measurements of submicrosecond gas density dynamics following passage of an intense ultrashort pulse are presented for single- and multi-lobed beams at 10 Hz and 1 kHz. Results are in excellent agreement with hydrodynamic simulations.

articleTitle: HgGa2S4-based RISTRA OPO pumped at 1064 nm
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Idler beam quality at 6.3 μm from HgGa<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> optical parametric oscillator (OPO) is compared for linear, planar ring and singly resonant twisted rectangle (RISTRA) cavities. The last one produces smooth, circular profile and much higher focal fluence.

articleTitle: Progress on cellular resolution retinal imaging: Setting the stage for translation between clinical and basic science
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: I will review our progress on developing clinical and animal (mice) cellular resolution in vivo retinal imaging modalities. Example applications of these technologies to in vivo studies of microscopic retinal morphology will be presented.

articleTitle: Intense terahertz pulses: Probing and controlling fundamental motions of electrons, spins and ions
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Terahertz radiation permits resonant and sensitive probing of electron transport, spin precession and ion vibration in solids. Recently developed sources of strong-field terahertz pulses even allow one to gain control over these fundamental modes.

articleTitle: A novel polarization and dichroic dual-functional splitter with ultra-high splitting ratios
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel polarization and dichroic dual-functional splitter is proposed, with ultra-high polarization splitting ratios >33dB and >36dB for TE- and TM-polarized modes, respectively; and with high wavelength splitting ratios >26dB and >33dB for 650nm and 850nm, respectively.

articleTitle: THz streaking of attosecond pulse trains
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first streaking of an attosecond pulse train using an intense THz field. Streaking with THz enables temporal characterization of the full pulse train in a single shot measurement.

articleTitle: High-Q ring resonators in directly-written chalcogenide glass waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Planar waveguide ring resonators are directly written in thin films of As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> glass, using two-photon laser beam lithography at 810 nm. Q values of 80,000 are observed.

articleTitle: Directional-emission III–V-on-silicon microspiral and double-notch microdisk lasers for optical interconnects
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate directional-emission III-V-on-silicon microspiral and double-notch microdisk lasers with gaplessly coupled waveguides using wafer-bonding. We observe room-temperature pulsed-injection lasing with a threshold of 33 mA and a side-mode-suppression-ratio of 20 dB at 50 mA.

articleTitle: THz spectroscopy of self-assembled ErSb nanowires
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on self-assembled ErSb nanowires in a GaSb matrix that show a strong polarization-sensitive THz response. The nanowires behave like a polarizer. Their orientation and shape can be engineered by the growth conditions.

articleTitle: Disorder-induced resonance shifts and mode edge broadening in photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present theory and measurements for systematically disordered slow-light photonic crystal waveguides and find a pronounced disorder-induced blueshift and broadening of the photon density of states.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal characterization of ultrashort laser pulses using time-domain spatially resolved interferometry
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a technique for characterizing ultrashort pulses in the spatiotemporal domain with high spatial resolution, based on a spatially-resolved Fourier-transform spectrometer. Spatiotemporal characterization of a pulse with pulse-front tilt is presented.

articleTitle: Wave propagation in magnetized epsilon-near-zero metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work we theoretically study light propagation in magnetized epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) metamaterials. We reveal novel regimes of propagation, including optical isolation of circularly polarized waves and back-scattering immune surface wave propagation.

articleTitle: Time-resolved photoelectron imaging with 90-nm pump pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-resolved photoelectron imaging were performed with 90-nm pump pulses. Quantum beat by coherent excitation of multiple Rydberg states in Kr, and photodissociation of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> within a few ps from initially excited Rydberg state(s) were observed.

articleTitle: SESAM and gain chip optimization leading to a record performance of an ultrafast electrically pumped VECSEL
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: With an improved gain chip and SESAM we set new benchmarks for modelocked electrically pumped VECSELs, i.e. shortest pulses (2.47 ps), highest average power (53.2 mW), peak power (4.7 W) and repetition rate (18.2 GHz).

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics in graphene studied by ultra-broadband THz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Carrier dynamics in a single-layered graphene has been studied by ultrabroadband terahertz time domain ellipsometric spectroscopy and time resolved optical pump THz probe technique. We successfully observed the frequency-dependent sheet conductivity of the optically-pumped graphene with and without the photo excitation. Above the optical fluence of 200 μJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the negative conductivity indicating the possibility of THz wave amplification are realized.

articleTitle: Probing electron-phonon interactions at the saddle point in graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High frequency differential transmission spectroscopy of graphene, probing near the M-point, is performed and analyzed theoretically. Electron-phonon coupling is identified as the chief mechanism for renormalization with an effective acoustic deformation potential of approximately 5eV.

articleTitle: Targeted creation and Purcell enhancement of NV centers within photonic crystal cavities in single-crystal diamond
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate Purcell enhancement of single NV centers in L3 photonic crystal cavities made from high-purity single-crystal diamond. Furthermore, NV centers were created using an implantation mask in the cavity high field region.

articleTitle: Tunable Terahertz wave plates fabricated with a 3D printer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate wave plates for terahertz waves using a 3D printer. The wave plates base on the physical mechanism of form birefringence. Applying mechanical pressure to the plates allows for continuously tuning of the optical retardance.

articleTitle: Nanotexturing of glass surface by ultrafast laser assisted wet etching
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Surface texturing with 30 nm resolution is demonstrated by KOH wet etching and ultrafast laser nanostructuring of silica. An increase of three times in retardance is achieved leading to the fabrication of dichroic glass-metal patterns.

articleTitle: Sub-50 fs compressed pulses from a graphene-mode locked fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a graphene mode-locked fiber laser system generating 42 fs pulses with 53mW output power, ideal for high temporal resolution applications.

articleTitle: Enhancement of radiative emission using a hyperbolic metamaterial nano-antenna
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hyperbolic metamaterial resonator is utilized as a nano-antenna for enhancing the radiative emission from a quantum emitter at 660 nm wavelength. Simulated power radiation enhancement up to 100 folds is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Investigation of fiber-based endoscopes for quantitative 3D flow and flame imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This work describes instantaneous three-dimensional (3D) measurements using fiber-based endoscopes. Experimental and numerical results demonstrate their potential for kHz 3D measurements, and also for overcoming practical issues like optical access and equipment cost.

articleTitle: Terahertz dynamics of topological insulator Bi2Se3: Ultrafast photoexcitation suppresses hot-Dirac electron surface scattering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present ultrafast terahertz scattering dynamics in topological insulator Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thin films. Upon photoexcitation, the surface-scattering rate is increased, resulting in decrease of conductance. At high temperature, however, the photo-generated electrons suppress the surface-scattering.

articleTitle: Sources and diagnostics for attosecond science
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel scheme to generate trains of angularly separated single attosecond pulses by driving high-order harmonic generation with two identical, but temporally delayed, laser pulses, which are noncollinearly overlapped in the generation medium.

articleTitle: Tunable plasmonic platform for giant fluorescence enhancement
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a colloidally synthesized plasmonic platform for giant fluorescence enhancement and increased spontaneous emission rate of embedded fluorophores. A transition between fluorescence enhancement and quenching is revealed depending on the plasmonic resonance.

articleTitle: Direct observation of non-uniform electric field in the active regions of an interband cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The non-uniform electric field in the active regions of an interband cascade laser is directly imaged and characterized for the first time by employing a nanoscopic voltage profiling technique.

articleTitle: Agile tunable Q-switched thulium-doped silica fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a Q-switched thulium-doped fiber laser up to 20 kHz with fast tunability over 100 nm without any movable part. Emitted pulses have energies above 10 µJ and peak powers up to 400 W.

articleTitle: High efficiency laser-diode-pumped continuous-wave Yb:YAG laser at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high-efficiency continuous-wave laser-diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser has been realized at room temperature by high intensity pumping. The slope efficiency and optical-to-optical conversion efficiency were 77 % and 72 % for the absorbed pump power, respectively.

articleTitle: Single nanoparticle detection and sizing by using a nanoscale optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the detection and sizing of single nanoparticles in aqueous environment by real-time monitoring the step changes in the nanofiber transmission.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously integrated long-wavelength VCSEL using high-contrast grating on silicon
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an electrically pumped AlGaInAs-silicon VCSEL using a high-contrast grating reflector on silicon. CW output power >1.5 mW, thermal resistance of 1.46 K/mW, and 5 Gb/s direct modulation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhanced spontaneous emission by embedding light emitters inside hyperbolic metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The inclusion of an emitter inside a Ag/Si multilayer yields a 3-fold enhancement of the Purcell factor over its outer value. The radiation is outcoupled to the far-field via a triangular and a rectangular grating.

articleTitle: Shaping emission spectra of quantum dots by all-dielectric metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Silicon nanodisks support both electric and magnetic resonances, which can be tuned independently via their geometry. We utilize these engineered resonances and demonstrate dielectric metasurfaces for efficient shaping of the emission spectra of quantum dots.

articleTitle: Coherent monochromatic terahertz-wave pulse detection using nonlinear parametric conversion at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a coherent detection of monochromatic terahertz-wave pulses by using a frequency up-conversion in a nonlinear MgO:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> crystal at room temperature. The generation of the detection signal is based on optical parametric mixing between a generated terahertz-wave radiation and a seeded idler beam, and an intense near-IR pumping beam. We measured the intensity and the phase of the input terahertz-wave.

articleTitle: Fabrication of large-aperture PPMgLN device using X-axis Czochralski-grown crystal
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: New PPMgLN arrangement fabricated from X-axis Czochralski-grown crystal was proposed to improve a laser-beam distortion problem after passing the PPMgLN device. Availability of periodic poling in the new arrangement could be confirmed in 5-mm-thick MgLN.

articleTitle: Coherent control of total transmission of light through disordered media
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We used wavefront shaping to enhance/suppress the transmission of coherent light through open highly scattering media. The total transmission was varied by one order of magnitude as a result of mesoscopic correlations of coherent transport.

articleTitle: Observation and manipulation of dipole-forbidden exciton transitions in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss recent experimental and theoretical results that report on the observation of dipole-forbidden intra-exciton transitions in semiconductors via terahertz excitation. Additional manipulation capabilities are gained through the application of a magnetic field.

articleTitle: Complex-transfer-function analysis of optical-frequency converters
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure the complex transfer function (CTF) of aperiodically poled lithium niobate waveguide devices and investigate the sources of CTF distortions, which are related to variations in the spatial distribution of the nonlinear coefficient and phase-mismatch profile.

articleTitle: Broadband epsilon-near-zero metamaterials with step-like metal-dielectric multilayer structures with gain media
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The broadband epsilon-near-zero metamaterials consisting of step-like metal-dielectric multilayer structures with gain media is proposed. Low-loss functional optical devices including prisms for broadband directional emission and S-shaped lenses for phase front shaping are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Scaling of micropillar array terahertz lasers into the subwavelength regime
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate terahertz quantum cascade lasers based on arrays of subwavelength micropillar structures, corresponding to scaled-down photonic crystals. Stimulated emission is measured at 4 THz for devices operating in the effective medium regime of the photonic bands.

articleTitle: Narrowband guided Fano resonators for mid-infrared spectroscopy and imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the demonstration of an array of high-performance one-layer narrowband mid-IR guided Fano resonators (GFRs) in the C-H stretching region (2700-3200 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) for high-quality microspectroscopic mid-IR imaging.

articleTitle: Yb-doped rod-type fiber amplifier with 2 kW average power
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The effect of mode instabilities has become a strong limitation for the average power scaling of fiber lasers and amplifiers with nearly diffraction-limited beam quality. In this contribution it is shown that the output average power of rod-type fiber amplifiers can be efficiently increased well beyond the threshold of mode-instabilities.
