This way a new average output power record of 2 kW, with an M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of 3, emitted from a 1 meter long rod-type fiber amplifier has been achieved.

articleTitle: Selectable dual-wavelength actively Q-switched laser by monolithic electro-optic periodically poled lithium niobate Bragg modulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel dual-wavelength actively Q-switched laser was demonstrated. When applying 20 W diode power, the output wavelength can be selected between 1063 and 1342 nm with the peak power of 27.6 and 1.6 kW, respectively.

articleTitle: Active control of the emission of a 2D optofluidic random laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an optofluidic 2D random laser where multiple scattering replaces the optical cavity. Spatial emission, which is isotropic for uniform transverse optical pumping, is forced in any given direction by iteratively shaping the optical pump profile.

articleTitle: Enhanced light extraction efficiency of deep-ultraviolet light-emitting diodes by Al-coated selective-area-grown GaN stripes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new type of AlGaN-based deep ultraviolet light-emitting diodes with Al-coated selective-area-grown n-type GaN stripes to extract strong side emission perpendicular to the [0001] c-axis and to improve the electrical property.

articleTitle: Is there a metamaterial route to high temperature superconductivity?
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We argue that the metamaterial approach to dielectric response engineering may considerably increase the critical superconducting temperature of a composite superconductor-dielectric metamaterial.

articleTitle: Thermal management in high-power continuous-wave second harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a systematic study of thermal effects in high-power single-pass SHG in the presence of absorption, and propose an optimum heating configuration for the crystal to minimize thermal lensing at various fundamental power levels.

articleTitle: Two dimensional coherent spectroscopy of CdSe/ZnS colloidal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 2D coherent spectroscopy of CdSe/ZnS nanocrystals and measure the exciton homogeneous linewidth. The 2D spectra also reveal an off-diagonal peak that oscillates as a function of the waiting time T.

articleTitle: An accurate interferometric referencing method for resonance tracking in lab-on-chip applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Repeatability of resonance detection for on-chip microring resonators is systematically studied. An efficient interferometric method is presented to improve the accuracy by more than one order of magnitude in an 8 nm bandwidth, without any temperature control.

articleTitle: Optical atomic clocks for a future new definition of the second
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical atomic clocks outperform the best caesium atomic clocks which define the second wrt accuracy and stability. As secondary representations of the second they pave the way to a new definition of the time unit.

articleTitle: All-optical helicity dependent switching in amorphous Tb30Fe70 with a MHz laser oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: All-optical magnetic switching is demonstrated in a Tb-Fe thin film with a conventional laser oscillator instead of a complex and expensive amplifier system. Overheating is prevented by a SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si substrate as an efficient heat sink.

articleTitle: Generation of wideband radio frequency signals carrying orbital angular momentum based on microwave photonics phase shifter
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel way to generate the wideband radio frequency (RF) signals carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) by phase shifting using optical spectrum processor is proposed. Stable RF-OAM signals with topological charge l = ±1 have been generated.

articleTitle: Optical refrigeration cools below 100K
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a milestone in optical refrigeration, cooling a 10% Yb:YLF crystal to 93K (ΔT~180K); obtaining the coldest solid-state temperature to date. Identification of transition metal impurities via mass spectrometry allows further cooling through purification.

articleTitle: Selective self-assembly of symmetry-breaking nanoplasmonic structures
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Self-assembly approaches to construct plasmonic materials often result in high-symmetry structures within a thermodynamic limit. Here we demonstrate a novel selective self-assembly route for synthesis of a new class of nanoplasmonic structures with symmetry-breaking.

articleTitle: Timing jitter minimization in soliton mode-locked fiber lasers by dispersion engineering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We searched for the minimal timing jitter condition in an all-fiber, soliton, CNT-mode-locked Er-laser by dispersion engineering. The measured lowest timing jitter is 490-attosecond [10-kHz to 39.4-MHz] at -0.02 ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> intra-cavity dispersion.

articleTitle: Effects of Raman scattering in quantum state-preserving frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyse frequency conversion by Bragg scattering numerically including Raman scattering. The frequency configuration that performs the best under influence of Raman noise results in 95% conversion over a 3.25 THz bandwidth with a 2.5-dB noise figure.

articleTitle: 7.5% optical-to-terahertz conversion efficiency through use of three-dimensional plasmonic electrodes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a high-efficiency photoconductive terahertz source based on high-aspect ratio plasmonic contact electrodes. Terahertz radiation powers up to 105 μW are obtained at an optical pump power of 1.4 mW, exhibiting a record-high optical-to-terahertz conversion efficiency of 7.5%.

articleTitle: Effect of dispersion fluctuations on longitudinal gain evolution in phase-sensitive parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Brillouin probing method is proposed to extract the distribution of signal power along phase-sensitive parametric amplifiers. Operation near the zero-dispersion-wavelength shows enhanced sensitivity to dispersion fluctuations, allowing effective extraction of the dispersion map.

articleTitle: Unusual phenomena with self-organized nanogratings written in silica glass with a femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Femtosecond laser written nanogratings show a random transition from self-organized to disordered structure and vice versa. A reason for the transition is proposed. Overlapping laser scans create nanogratings with apparent self-aligned fringes.

articleTitle: Enhanced forward and backward anti-Stokes Raman signals in lithium niobate waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed enhancements of forward and backward anti-Stokes Raman signals generated in lithium niobate waveguides by one order of magnitude. Forward and backward exhibit different spectral features, unique for two configurations.

articleTitle: Nanostructured Transparent Conducting Oxide films for polarization control with plasmonic metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transparent Conducting Oxides (TCOs) enable the realization of practical plasmonic and metamaterial devices at the telecommunication frequency due to their low optical loss and CMOS compatibility. By employing a conventional dry-etching process, we have fabricated GZO plasmonic waveplates, which convert linearly polarized light into circularly polarized light.

articleTitle: Highly birefringent multicore optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterization of two polarization maintaining multicore fibres, one with three and the other with ninety eight cores. The beat length and polarization orientation are characterized.

articleTitle: Terahertz harmonics in multi-layer graphene in the nonperturbative regime
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first observation of terahertz higher harmonics in graphene by mapping the nonlinear response with broadband electrooptic sampling. The nonlinear response in the non-perturbative regime is determined by intra- and interband electron motions.

articleTitle: Wideband electromagnetic wave sensing using electro-optic polymer infiltrated silicon slot photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an integrated photonic electromagnetic field sensor based on an electrooptic polymer refilled slot photonic crystal waveguide modulator driven by a bowtie-antenna. The minimum detectable electric field is measured to be 2.5V/m at 8.4GHz.

articleTitle: Polariton lattices for quantum simulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coupled micropillars etched in semiconductor microcavities are an excellent platform to engineer the properties of exciton-polaritons. Thanks to the direct optical access characteristic of polaritons, these etched structures can be used to simulate various solid-state hamiltonians. Here we will show a hexagonal structure in which we engineer a spin-orbit coupling for polaritons. The coupling is evidenced via the spontaneous formation of polarization vortices when polaritons condense. When extended to a honeycomb lattice we report the direct observation of Dirac cones and a non-dispersive band, i.e., a flatband. Our structure is thus very promising for the study of anomalous transport and disorder in massless particles, and the strongly correlated phases expected in flatbands.

articleTitle: Accelerating beam propagation in refractive index potentials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the dynamics of accelerating beams impinging on different classes of index potentials. The analytic expressions for the reflected and transmitted waves show that the Airy-wave parabolic trajectory is modified with some particular exceptions.

articleTitle: Model for pump absorption in rare-earth doped double clad fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce and provide experimental verification for a new model and representation of pump absorption in rare-earth-doped double-clad fibers based on underlying physics. The model allows for simple evaluation of wavelength resolved, length dependent absorption.

articleTitle: Optical encryption based on cancellation of analog noise
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose an optical encryption technique where the data is encrypted with wideband analog noise. Matching both the phase and amplitude of the noise is required, providing a large key space for the encryption process.

articleTitle: Quasi-Pℐ symmetry in waveguide optical directional couplers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A comparison between light dynamics in Pℐ -symmetric and passive optical coupler is presented. We show that, apart from an overall damping factor, the dymanics in the passive coupler fully reproduce thePℐ -symmetric ones.

articleTitle: High-efficiency continuous-wave index-antiguided planar waveguide laser with large mode area
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate robust continuous-wave lasing in a planar index-antiguided waveguide with a 220-µm Nd:YAG active layer. A pump-limited output of 1.5 W with a slope efficiency of 30% with respect to absorbed pump power is achieved.

articleTitle: Multi-periodic photonic hyper-crystals: Volume plasmon polaritons and the purcell effect
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically demonstrate superior degree of control over volume plasmon polariton propagation and the Purcell effect in multi-period (4-layer unit cell) plasmonic multilayers, which can be viewed as multiscale hyperbolic metamaterials or multi-periodic photonic hyper-crystals.

articleTitle: Nanoscale precision subcellular chemical identification using quantitative IR nanoimage analysis based on multiple-IR laser illumination
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Advances in infrared (IR) nanoimaging as a non-invasive and robust method for the chemical discrimination of subcellular features and intracellular exogenous agents without the use of labels and at nanoscale resolutions are discussed. We outline a number of improvements in both quantitative IR nanoimage analysis and systemic improvements including multi-laserline illumination that, when combined, enables nanoscale chemical precision and subcellular chemical localization. Additionally, we demonstrate how a combination of IR absorption nanoimaging and topographic data can resolve sub-40nm resolution membrane boundaries and how by exploiting subcellular chemical density and complexity maps, illustrate the label free localization of nuclei for both healthy and cancerous cell lines. As many cell processes related to disease are governed by the position and dynamics of subcellular features, we interrogate the biochemical inhomogeneity of cancer cells as a means to explore the subcellular biomechanics underlying carcinogenesis.

articleTitle: Polarization attractors in harmonic mode-locked fiber laser with carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study polarization dynamics of a harmonic mode-locked erbium-doped fiber laser with carbon nanotubes absorber. New types of vector solitons are shown for multi-pulse and harmonic mode-locked operation with locked, switching and precessing polarization states.

articleTitle: In vivo voltage-sensitive dye optical functional imaging of the subcortical brain
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We combined voltage-sensitive dye imaging (VSDi) with gradient-index (GRIN) rod lens to study neural functions in mice vibrissae system. Neural activities evoked in the thalamic barreloids by single whisker stimulation were visualized in vivo.

articleTitle: Titanium nitride as a refractory plasmonic material for high temperature applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of titanium nitride as a plasmonic material for high temperature applications such as solar/thermophotovoltaics is studied numerically and experimentally. Performance of titanium nitride is compared with widely used materials in each field.

articleTitle: Enhanced modulation performance by cascaded uncoupled dual-ring
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced modulation speed by using serial uncoupled microring modulators. By reducing photon lifetime of two rings, the extinction ratio of eye diagram increases from 5.9 dB to 7.1 dB at 20 Gbps.

articleTitle: Circular polarization converters based on coupled pairs of oppositely-handed gold helices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a helix-based metamaterial, a circular polarization converter, composed of pairs of oppositely-handed helices on a square array. We compare our theoretical findings to measurements on samples made by laser lithography and electroplating.

articleTitle: Observation of free electron density oscillation in filamentation as a function of carrier-envelope phase
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The free electron density in a 40 mm long filamentation generated by carrier-envelope stabilized few-cycle laser pulses is detected in a circular loop. The oscillation of electron density is observed as a function of CEP.

articleTitle: Mid infrared sources based on widely tunable DFG in monolithic semiconductor waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Difference frequency generation in monolithic semiconductor waveguides using χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> nonlinearities produced mid IR radiation between 7700 – 8300 nm in a single waveguide element via 20 nm tuning of a 1550 nm fiber laser pump.

articleTitle: Crystal equivalent temperature concept for laser calorimetry and nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Concept of equivalent temperature is proposed for precise temperature measurement of crystals and glasses in laser calorimetry and nonlinear optics experiments. Determination of equivalent temperature of laser irradiated crystal or glass is based on frequency shift measurement of temperature calibrated acoustic resonance, excited in the sample.

articleTitle: Automated classification of basal cell carcinoma in mouse skin by polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An automated, support-vector-machine classifier was developed to discriminate basal cell carcinoma from healthy mouse skin images obtained with polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography. The results demonstrate that polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography has the potential to achieve accurate diagnosis of skin cancer noninvasively.

articleTitle: Effects of depolarization fields on transient terahertz spectra of nanostructured materials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Analysis of the relationship between the microscopic conductivity, morphology represented by percolation degree and terahertz transmission spectra allowed us to retrieve microscopic properties of several nanostructured materials from measurements by terahertz spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Compact 0.1-W source of octave-spanning mid-infrared femtosecond pulses centered at 10 µm
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate octave-spanning pulses centered at 10 μm with 100-mW-scale average powers and 100-MHz repetition rate via intrapulse difference-frequency mixing driven in LiGaS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> by a nonlinearly compressed Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:YAG thin-disk oscillator.

articleTitle: A novel polarization converter and filter based on MMI couplers in silicon-on-insulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel polarization converter and filter based on silicon multimode interference couplers (MMI) has been demonstrated. The measured transmission spectra of the proposed device for the light with arbitrary polarization exhibit a good performance.

articleTitle: Metamaterial broadband angular selectivity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a method that achieves light selection based purely on the angle of propagation, by tailoring the overlap of the bandgaps of multiple one-dimensional photonic crystals, each contains metamaterial and with a different periodicity.

articleTitle: Tutorial: Recent developments in measurements of atmospheric trace gases
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Lasers are used to measure extremely low concentrations of reactive species and minute variations greenhouse gases in the atmosphere. Instrument challenges differ sharply, illustrated in case studies for atmospheric glyoxal, methane and others.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of template-stripped plasmonic substrates for high-resolution chemical imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Template-stripped plasmonic nanoholes are used as high-resolution chemical imaging substrates via surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy. Chemical patterns created with microcontact printing show these surfaces to provide large and uniform enhancements suitable for imaging.

articleTitle: Advances in short-pulse fiber lasers for nonlinear microscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent advances in the development of fiber lasers for applications in nonlinear bioimaging will be presented.

articleTitle: Electrically driven photonic-crystal lasers on silicon substrates using direct wafer bonding
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the first continuous wave operation of electrically driven photonic-crystal lasers on Si at room temperature. Plasma assisted bonding integrated III–V semiconductor devices on Si. The device exhibited a 33 µA threshold current.

articleTitle: Brillouin scattering in silicon slot waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here we numerically investigate Brillouin scattering (BS) in a silicon slot waveguide. We show that BS is strongly influenced by the boundary effects, instead of the usual photo-elastic effect leading to the interaction with distinct mechanical modes.

articleTitle: Transmission channels for light in absorbing random media
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study numerically the effects of optical absorption on highly transmitting channels in strongly scattering media. We observe that they are robust against weak absorption. Surprisingly, in case of strong absorption diffusive transport becomes ballistic-like.

articleTitle: Widely tunable distributed Bragg quantum cascade laser for gas sensing applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report continuous mode-hop free tuning of a sample-grating distributed Bragg reflector (SG-DBR) quantum cascade laser (QCL) operating at 4.55μm wavelength observing N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O features in this range by controlling all three sections of laser namely: front DBR, back DBR and the phase.

articleTitle: Improved InGaAs/InAlAs photoconductive THz receivers: 5.8 THz bandwidth and 80 dB dynamic range
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate optimal Be-doping conditions of low-temperature-grown InGaAs/InAlAs photoconductive antennas with respect to their carrier lifetimes and carrier mobility. Employed as THz-TDS receiver bandwidths of 5.8 THz with a dynamic range of up to 80 dB is achieved.

articleTitle: Frequency translation via four-wave mixing Bragg scattering in Rb filled photonic band-gap fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate frequency translation of a weak signal beam with 21% efficiency in Rb vapor confined to a hollow core photonic band-gap fiber via Bragg scattering by four-wave mixing using microwatt level pump beams.

articleTitle: Fast switching of optical vortex beam mode orders generated using a fully integrated SOI device
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fast tuning of the Optical Angular Momentum (OAM) order of a vortex beam is demonstrated with 20µs switching times using a compact silicon photonic device.

articleTitle: Entanglement discloses Time as an emergent phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Page and Wootters' mechanism of “static” time is experimentally implemented by a toy universe consisting of a polarization entangled photon pair, one of which serves as a clock to gauge the evolution of the second.

articleTitle: Optically-induced mode coupling and interference in a terahertz parallel plate waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical control of terahertz wave mode coupling in a silicon-filled parallel-plate waveguide. The resulting frequency modulation is widely tunable by moving the control beam illumination in the propagation direction.

articleTitle: Dynamic strain measurement at arbitrary multiple points along a fiber with 500Hz high-speed random accessibility of Brillouin Optical Correlation Domain Analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate dynamic strain measurement at arbitrary points by a basic BOCDA system with 500 points/s random access speed. This is the highest speed of the random accessibility reported so far.

articleTitle: Pulse dynamics in a mode-locked fiber laser and its quantum limited comb linewidth
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fully characterized the pulse dynamics in a mode-locked Er fiber laser experimentally by measuring its response to gain modulation. The measurement allows us to evaluate quantum-limited comb linewidth and phase noise spectrum.

articleTitle: 100-Gb/s all-optical wavelength-preserved 2R regeneration using semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: All-optical wavelength-preserved 2R regeneration with simultaneous wavelength conversion of 100-Gb/s OOK signal is experimentally demonstrated based on cross-gain compression in SOAs. Receiving sensitivity is improved by more than 1.7 dB in the regenerated signal.

articleTitle: THz spectroscopy of bovine serum albumin solution using the long-range guided mode supported by thin liquid films
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate THz spectroscopy of mM BSA solutions using the long-range guided mode as an alternative approach to traditional transmission and reflection concepts. The cm propagation lengths pave the way for integrating field-enhancing resonating structures.

articleTitle: Fast and accurate calculation of Q factor of 2D photonic crystal cavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a method for calculating the Q-factor of a 2D photonic crystal nanocavity directly from the in-plane wavevector distribution of the cavity mode. A high-Q of >10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> was obtained with high accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: High flux table-top ultrafast soft X-ray source generated by high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Intense, few-cycle infrared laser pulses centered at 1.8 μm wavelength, coupled to a new gas cell design, are employed to drive high harmonic generation with high flux down to the soft X-ray regime.

articleTitle: Coherent laser source for optical time-stretched microscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a coherent picosecond pulsed fiber laser for the high frame-rate optical time-stretched microscopy at 1.0 µm. Real-time flow imaging with a frame rate of 26.25 MHz is achieved based on this source.

articleTitle: Inverted-wedge silica resonators for controlled and stable coupling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Inverted-wedge silica resonators with Q ≥ 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> were fabricated using conventional semiconductor processing. Robust wide-range control of coupling was demonstrated by horizontally moving a fiber taper on the top surface of the resonator.

articleTitle: High excitation efficiency of channel plasmon polaritons in tailored, UV-lithography-defined V-grooves
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate >50% conversion of light to V-groove channel plasmon-polaritons (CPPs) via compact waveguide-termination mirrors. Devices are fabricated using UV-lithography and crystallographic silicon etching. The V-shape is tailored by thermal oxidation to support confined CPPs.

articleTitle: A new picture of inhomogeneities in nanowire superconducting single photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduced, characterized and modeled a simple nanodetector to investigate the efficiency and yield limitations of NbN superconducting single photon detectors. These crucial issues are related to the detectors strongly inhomogeneous nature at the nanoscale.

articleTitle: Memory-based quantum repeaters with NV centers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a simple design of a quantum repeater design build from single NV- centers embedded in an optical cavity. We compare different quantum networks from a simple linear chain to a fully fault-tolerant quantum internet.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable thermo-optic polymer switch based true-time-delay network utilizing imprinting and inkjet printing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Reconfigurable true-time-delay lines, comprising of 2×2 thermo-optic polymer switches and rib waveguides are fabricated utilizing a combination of roll-to-roll (R2R) compatible UV imprinting and ink-jet printing, which promises high throughput and low cost photonic devices.

articleTitle: Imaging the structure of van der Waals Complexes with laser-driven Coulomb explosion
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Geometric structures of some van der Waals Complexes were determined by precisely measuring three-dimensional momentum vectors of correlated atomic ions produced in the laser-driven Coulomb explosion of these van der Waals complexes.

articleTitle: A 15-MHz wavelength-stepped laser based on intracavity pulse stretching and compression for optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a wavelength-stepped laser that uses dispersive fibers in combination with a lithium-niobate modulator and a fixed Fabry-Perot etalon to achieve wavelength selection for optical-domain subsampled OCT. A 15 MHz A-scan rate is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Wide-band on-chip four-wave mixing via coupled cavity dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a dual-cavity resonant structure that employs frequency splitting at one of three resonances to structurally compensate dispersion. We show seeded four-wave mixing across the largest free spectral range to our knowledge of 26nm.

articleTitle: Tailoring of saturation in fiber optical parametric amplifier by SBS-induced nonlinear phase
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use gain-transparent SBS to defer/expedite the saturation of a fiber optical parametric amplifier by dynamically control the phase mismatch. The input signal power at saturation can be raised or reduced by ~6 dB.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband DFG in CdSiP2 at 6.5 µm with 2.3 cycle transform limit from an Er:Tm:Ho fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate ultra-broadband 6.5 μm pulses with 2.3 cycle transform limit and 85 pJ energy at 100 MHz from a phase-coherent, two-color, two-arm Er:Tm:Ho all-fiber MOPA system in CdSiP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Quantum coherence in bulk GaAs studied by interference between electron-phonon coupled states
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Both electronic and phonon coherence in bulk GaAs is studied using an interference experiment of electron-phonon coupled states induced by two phase-locked femtosecond pulses. Full coherence remains within ~ 45 fs at room temperature.

articleTitle: A detailed experimental study of frequency noise in mid-infrared distributed feedback quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Flicker noise was studied in a set of 20 QCLs at 7–8 µm, showing significant differences among the devices and the probable existence of various noise sources. Ridgewaveguide lasers showed lower noise than buried-heterostructures.

articleTitle: Low-power four-channel wavelength multicasting in embedded microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate four-channel all-optical wavelength multicasting using only 1 mW of pump power and channel spacing of 40-60 GHz. Our device is based on a compact embedded microring design fabricated on a scalable SOI platform.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of laser-induced damage thresholds in dielectric crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser-induced damage thresholds (LIDT) in dielectric crystals were evaluated at different temperature. The temperature dependence of the LIDTs could be explained with some physical models.

articleTitle: Photoionization time delay measurement close to a Fano resonance using tunable attosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the influence of a Fano resonance on the delays for electron emission in two-photon, near-resonant ionization of argon. The delays were measured using an interferometric method that employed an attosecond pulse train.

articleTitle: Subpicosecond adiabatic rapid passage in a single InGaAs quantum dot: Role of phonons in dephasing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Robust excitation of an exciton state via adiabatic rapid passage is demonstrated in a single InGaAs quantum dot using subpicosecond optical pulses. A chirp sign dependence of the transfer efficiency indicates dephasing tied to phonons.

articleTitle: Generation of three-octave-spanning transient Raman frequency comb in hydrogen-filled hollow-core PCF
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A noise-seeded transient Raman frequency comb spanning three octaves from 180 to 2400 nm is generated by pumping a hydrogen-filled hollow-core photonic crystal with 300 fs pulses of energy 26 μJ and wavelength 800 nm.

articleTitle: Implantation of proximal NV clusters in diamond by lithographically defined silicon masks with 5 nm resolution
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the fabrication of nitrogen-vacancy (NV) spin chains by implantation through a silicon mask on diamond. A minimum implantation aperture width of 5 nm is produced. Super-resolution measurements reveal NV lines 26 nm wide and minimal NV-pitch of 8 nm.

articleTitle: Visible supercontinuum generation by dual-wavelength pumping in multimode rectangular optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study supercontinuum generation in a multimode microstructured optical fiber by dual-wavelength pumping. We demonstrate significant blue extension of the spectrum in relatively short fiber length by exploiting cross-phase modulation between high order modes.

articleTitle: All-optical single-side-band GHz to THz microwave sources via SOA gain engineering
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate low noise broadly tunable single side-band microwaves using cascaded semiconductor optical amplifiers using no RF bias. Microwaves between 40GHz and 875GHz with a linewidth ∼22 KHz are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Towards single molecule infrared vibrational spectroscopy and dynamics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast infrared vibrational free-induction decay probing in scattering-scanning near-field microscopy. We observe long-lived few picosecond vibrational coherences, far in excess of the far-field ensemble response.

articleTitle: Optofluidics 10 years later
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We assess the evolution of the optofluidics during the last decade. We will contrast the progress actually made with the expectations from 10 years ago and highlight some of the unexpected developments that have occurred.

articleTitle: Robustness of scalable all-optical logic gates
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We designed scalable all-optical logic gates that operate at the same input and output wavelength based on microrings. We investigated the influence of input power fluctuations and fabrication errors.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced spontaneous emission and saturable absorption of colloidal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate spontaneous emission enhancement (by an average factor of 4.6) and saturable absorption of cadmium selenide colloidal quantum dots coupled to a nanobeam photonic crystal cavity, at room temperature.

articleTitle: Controlling light with light in a plasmonic nanooptomechanical metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate metamaterial with a cubic optical nonlinearity that is ten orders of magnitude greater than the reference nonlinearity of CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The nonlinearity has optomechanical nature and is underpinned by light-induced electromagnetic near-field interactions.

articleTitle: Realisation of a photonic link between a trapped ion and a semiconductor quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the first photonic link between a quantum dot and a single ion and show that the ion absorption probability per quantum dot photon can reach 1.2%.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable plasmofluidic lenses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Utilizing laser-induced surface bubbles on a metal film, we demonstrate a reconfigurable plasmonic lens in a microfluidic environment to achieve divergence, collimation, and focusing of surface plasmons.

articleTitle: Coupled-resonator-optical-waveguide (CROW)-based on-chip sensors with multi-pixel detection using all-silicon sub-bandgap photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a coupled-resonator-optical-waveguide-based sensor with multi-pixel detection using all-silicon sub-bandgap photodetectors at 1550 nm. Our proof-of-concept experiments of a PIN-diode-integrated three-microring CROW demonstrate sensing a minimum effective refractive index change of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>.

articleTitle: Semiconductor single-photon emitters with tunable polarization output
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Semiconductor quantum dot based single photon emitters are a critical component for quantum cryptography. In this work, we show a scalable single-photon emitter structure using site-controlled elliptical quantum dots with a controllable and tunable output polarization.

articleTitle: Optical momentum transfer to graphene in resonators: Generalizing Coulomb-Lorentz force on a conductive single atomic layer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that judicious selection of mirrors/substrates, operational frequency, and graphene location inside a cavity yields unprecedented optical forces on graphene, while tolerably modifies the cavity Q.

articleTitle: Accessing the optical properties of single nanoobjects at the nanometer scale through fast electron based spectroscopies
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fast electron based spectroscopies are often loosely compared to light scattering. By performing Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy and Cathodoluminescence on single metallic nanoobjects, we show that these techniques are nanometric probes of extinction and scattering.

articleTitle: Femtosecond magneto-optics of FePt nanocrystals for Heat Assisted Magnetic Recording
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report about the magnetization dynamics in L1<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> FePt discs, designed for Heat Assisted Magnetic Recording. We also determine the different nonlinear behaviors of the coercive field and saturation magnetization with increasing laser pulse energy.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive mid-infrared photoexpansion nanospectroscopy with background suppression
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The ultimate sensitivity of mid-infrared photoexpansion nanospectroscopy is limited by the background signal from photoexpansion of the sample substrate and the probe tip. Here we demonstrate suppression of this signal using a second mid-infrared laser.

articleTitle: Progress and prospects for high efficiency and gigacount per second detectors for quantum repeaters using superconducting nanowire detectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe our work on superconducting nanowire detector arrays and how they may be adapted to meet the requirements for implementing a quantum repeater.

articleTitle: Silicon photonics transmitters and receivers for 4×25 Gb/s interconnects
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Advanced data centers require high throughput I/O processing for servers and storage devices connectivity. Silicon photonics technology offering low-cost, low-power, and high-performance is a promising solution for interconnection applications. In this talk, we will review the latest progress of the highly integrated Silicon photonics devices for 4×25 Gb/s active optical cables and transceivers. This includes hybrid lasers, WDM multiplexers, electro-absorption modulators, and germanium detectors.

articleTitle: Real-time demonstration of 3 × 10 Gb/s uncooled MIMO DWDM system with adaptive laser bias control
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 3×10Gb/s uncooled MIMO DWDM system using uncooled DFB lasers with real-time crosstalk cancellation, allowing separate lasers to operate at different temperatures. Adaptive laser bias control is applied to ensure adequate channel separation.

articleTitle: Divided-pulse lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate coherent combining of pulses within a laser cavity and discuss applications to energy scaling and pulse-burst operation. 16-times enhancement of the pulse energy from a fiber laser is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Terahertz scanning investigations of human dermal cells
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Investigation of cultured skin cells have have been conducted by a terahertz scanning reflectometer. In particular, the dermal fibroblasts alone and the same treated with titanium nanoparticles have been examined for their thickness profile.

articleTitle: Studying correlated electron systems with a new tunable (<25 eV) tabletop XUV source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize a new table-top, tunable XUV source spanning 8 to 25 eV based on a femtosecond enhancement cavity. This source is designed to investigate correlated electron systems with angle and time resolved photoemission spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Phase locked system for dual comb molecular spectroscopy at 2–6 µm based on tm-fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate phase-coherent, frequency-stabilized dual-comb system at 2μm, extendable to mid-IR via phase-coherent frequency conversion in a doubly-resonant GaAs OPO. Results of dual-comb molecular spectroscopy with ~1M spectral points taken in ~1ms will be presented.

articleTitle: Optoelectronics of 2D-semicondcutors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Newly discovered 2D semiconductors offer a platform to investigate valley excitons at the two dimensional limit. Here, we present optoelectronic control of valley exciton polarization and coherence, and their device applications in monolayer limit.

articleTitle: 3-D imaging of malaria-infected human red blood cells using optical diffraction tomography
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure 3-D refractive index distributions of malaria-infected red blood cells (RBCs) using optical diffraction tomography. Optical diffraction tomography reveals high resolution details of morphological changes in RBCs during the intraerythrocytic cycles of malaria parasites.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of on-chip silicon two/three mode (de)multiplexer using OFDM 64/128/256-QAM signals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design and fabricate on-chip two/three mode (de)multiplexer using a tapered asymmetrical directional coupler. System experiments of OFDM 64/128/256-QAM data transmission have been carried out for on-chip two/three mode (de)multiplexing applications.

articleTitle: Enhancement on photovoltaic properties of boron-doped super-high density Si quantum dot thin film
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Boron-doped super-high density nano-crystalline Si quantum dot thin film is demonstrated by utilizing a gradient Si-rich oxide multilayer structure. The boron doping effect and its significant influence on photovoltaic properties are observed and discussed.

articleTitle: Mapping (slow) light at the nanoscale - don't forget the magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present local investigations of the spectral evolution of ultrashort slow pulses as they propagate. We also show that nanoscale electrical and magnetic fields can be detected simultaneously.

articleTitle: Coherent asynchronous sampling distance measurement using a single polarization-multiplexed ultrafast laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser ranging based on asynchronous sampling of ultrashort optical pulses is proposed and experimentally demonstrated using just one polarization-multiplexed mode-locked fiber laser, which produces two orthogonal polarized, coherent pulse trains with slightly different repetition rates.

articleTitle: Frequency comb calibrated diode laser interferometry for absolute distance measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Real-time frequency-sweeping interferometer for arbitrary distance determination is demonstrated, which is consisted by a homodyne interferometer and a diode calibrated by an optical frequency comb. For arbitrary distance of ∼73 mm, the deviation is 0.91 µm.

articleTitle: Energetic and high average power femtosecond fiber laser using chirped- and divided-pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We implement, in the same femtosecond fiber amplifier setup, both chirped pulse amplification and divided pulse amplification. With the generation of temporally delayed replicas this scheme allows an equivalent stretched pulse duration of more than 1ns in a compact tabletop system. The generation of 45 W of compressed average power at 100 kHz, together with 320 fs and 450 μJ pulses, is demonstrated using a rod-type ytterbium-doped fiber.

articleTitle: Observation of change of moisture retention of single human hairs using THz waves
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Moisture retention of single human hairs were evaluated using localized generated THz waves. It is found that the cuticles have an important roles for the moisture retention inside the hair.

articleTitle: Fabrication of subwavelngth optics using glass imprint process
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Glass imprint process was developed for the fabrication of micro- and nano-structures on the surface of glasses. A spherical glass lens with two dimensional subwavelength structure exhibited the surface reflectance less than 0.2% at 530 nm in wavelength. Application of DC voltage to the mold, on the other hand, was effective to suppress the imprint temperature and pressure, which was resulted from the selective decrease in alkali concentration only in the glass surface areas contacting to the mold.

articleTitle: SolitonWake instability in a SESAM modelocked fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the nonlinear evolution profile of the soliton wake instability in a single-polarization SESAM modelocked fiber laser system. We show that it leads to quasi-periodicity.

articleTitle: 2.5 D photonic crystal quantum cascade detector
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum cascade detectors are intersubband photodetectors that offer a vast design freedom. By combining it with a novel photonic crystal cavitiy, a significant improvement of the detectors performance could be achieved.

articleTitle: Following attosecond photoemission from solids using interferometry
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Implementing RABBITT on solids for the first time, we record energy-resolved absolute photoemission delays from noble metal surfaces. The structure of the observed delays in Ag(111) and Au(111) is inconsistent with previously promoted models.

articleTitle: Power enhancement, noise reduction, and linewidth narrowing of THz output by mixing beams from coupled oscillators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: THz radiation was generated by mixing idler-idler waves from coupled optical parametric oscillators based on stacked KTP plates. Power enhancement, noise reduction, and linewidth narrowing have been attributed to noise reduction between idler waves.

articleTitle: Engineering dispersion relation of photons in vertical cavity using high-contrast gratings
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show the dispersion relation of high-contrast grating based vertical cavity can be altered by orders of magnitude by engineering the angular phase response. The results may benefit Purcell enhancement and strong coupling using the cavity.

articleTitle: Measuring the photonic frequency qubit generated by an 171Yb+ ion in a surface trap
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel qubit state measurement method for photonic frequency qubits using a Mach-Zehnder interferometer with unequal path lengths. A practical implementation for photons generated by <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">171</sup>Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ions in a surface trap is described.

articleTitle: Single-photon frequency conversion using cross-phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The frequency conversion of single photon wave packets was demonstrated using cross-phase modulation in a dispersion-managed photonic crystal fiber. The frequencies of single photons were successfully modulated without a significant photon loss.

articleTitle: Non-instantaneous polarization decay in dielectric media
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimental evidence for non-instantaneous polarization decay in dielectrics. The few-femtosecond relaxation times agree favorable with solutions of the time-dependent Schrödinger equation and relate to resonances of the quantum mechanical dipole.

articleTitle: Effect of solar thermal energy on photoreactions' rate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The Shockley-Queisser limit predicts that at least 70% of solar energy is available to be converted into heat. In this paper, we show that this heating component can play a significant role in photocatalytic reactions.

articleTitle: Spectrally resolved shot-to-shot nonlinear dynamics of a passive PCF ring cavity
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The global experimental bifurcation diagram of a passively pumped PCF ring cavity is analyzed. We observe unequal shot-to-shot evolution of different spectral regions of the cavity pulse, and confirm this using two independent measurement techniques.

articleTitle: Measurement of the autocorrelation function of a cathodoluminescence signal: Characteristics and applications in nanosecond time resolved and nanometer spatially resolved experiment
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this presentation we show that the autocorrelation function of the cathodoluminescence signal (CL-g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(τ)) can be different from the photoluminescence PL-g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(τ) showing a huge nanosecond bunching effect g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(0) >> 1, allowing to retrieve emitters lifetime at nanometer scale.

articleTitle: Strong Purcell enhancement of Er atoms embedded in a gold nano-trench
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate large enhancement of spontaneous emission (Fp>70) from Er atoms embedded in gold nano-trench structures. This is confirmed by clear correlation between increased decay rate and enhanced photoluminescence as a function of resonant wavelength.

articleTitle: Increasing laser contrast by relativistic self-guiding and its application to laser-based proton acceleration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser-produced energetic protons via target normal sheath acceleration are deteriorated by amplified spontaneous emission (ASE). Here we test a new method of reducing ASE and increasing proton energy by relativistic self-guiding in the plasma.

articleTitle: Comparison of dynamical properties of ground- and excited-state emission in quantum-dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compare dynamical properties of ground and excited state emission from 1.31 µm quantum-dot lasers. Dichroic facet mirrors ensure oscillations at either ground or excited state. Maximum bandwidths observed are 10.51 and 16.25 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Excitation of higher-order modes of an optical nanofiber by laser-cooled 87Rb atoms
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate excitation of higher order modes in an optical nanofiber by resonantly-excited <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atoms. Absorption by laser-cooled atoms is enhanced when probe light propagates in higher order modes compared to the fundamental mode.

articleTitle: Adaptive photonic meta-surfaces exploiting interfacial phase change in elemental gallium
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Surface-driven metallization in a nanoscale layer of elemental gallium forming the backplane of a photonic metamaterial absorber provides a mechanism for reversible all-optical and thermo-optical tuning of resonant response.

articleTitle: Observing bulk diamond spin coherence in high-purity nanodiamonds
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy centers in nanodiamond allow nano-resolution magnetometry. However, their use has been limited by poor quantum state coherence times. Using high purity nanodiamonds we achieve spin coherence comparable to that in bulk diamond.

articleTitle: Terahertz absorption saturation in intrinsic silicon dielectric ridge waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure the transmission of terahertz pulses through an intrinsic silicon waveguide, and observe a decrease in absorption at higher terahertz fields. The effect is enhanced when photocarriers are introduced by top-illuminating the waveguide.

articleTitle: Generation of Nyquist pulses using a dual parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the generation of Nyquist pulses using a dual parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator. 10 GHz to 40 GHz Nyquist pulses with timing-jitter below 258 fs and signal-to-noise ratio more than 30 dB are experimentally generated.

articleTitle: 300 GHz bound pulse generation in a filter-assisted harmonic mode-locked Er-doped fiber laser with 20 GHz phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By inserting a section of PM fiber for birefringence interference filtering with 100 GHz spacing, stable 300 GHz bound pulses have been successfully generated in a harmonic mode-locked Er-doped fiber laser with 20 GHz phase modulation frequency.

articleTitle: A fast numerical method to predict spectra of high power CW Yb-doped fiber lasers with bidirectional pumping
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A fast method is introduced to model high power, continuous wave Yb-doped fiber lasers. Excellent agreement with measurements is obtained for up to 708W output power within 5 minutes of computation on a desktop computer.

articleTitle: Generation of bright isolated attosecond soft X-ray pulses driven by multi-cycle mid-infrared lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By driving the high harmonic generation process with multi-cycle mid-infrared laser pulses, we demonstrate bright isolated, attosecond soft X-ray pulses for the first time.

articleTitle: Demonstration of difference frequency generation in a silicon slot waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the generation of microwave frequencies of up to 50 GHz by second-order nonlinear mixing of two optical carriers at 1540 nm in a silicon-organic hybrid slot waveguide.

articleTitle: Mid-IR flat lens based on parallelogram antennas
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By engineering parallelogram antenna on ZnSe substrate, we can control the wavefront of laser beam and design a flat lens at 10μm. The fabricated flat lens has demonstrated focusing effect matching well with simulation.

articleTitle: Optically readable resistive random access memory in silicon plasmonics platform
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate resistive random access memory device integrated with a silicon plasmonic waveguide, and relying on the formation of nanoscale metallic needles. The measured electrical and optical response show distinct bistability with well-defined hysteresis.

articleTitle: Stimulated emission of SPPs on top of hyperbolic metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the stimulated emission of surface plasmon polaritons on top of lamellar metal/dielectric metamaterial has much lower threshold than on top of silver.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning Mid-IR supercontinuum generation with ultrafast cascaded nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An octave-spanning mid-IR supercontinuum is observed experimentally using ultrafast cascaded nonlinearities in an LiInS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> quadratic nonlinear crystal pumped with 70 fs energetic mid-IR pulses and cut for strongly phase-mismatched second-harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Micro-fluid channel based on ultralow-loss silicon crossing waveguide for various sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a new type of micro-fluid channel design with crossing optical waveguides that not only block any gaps in the microfluidic channels in one fabrication step but also enable nearly lossless optical propagation in the primary waveguides on a chip. Such designs are critical for all sensing applications where the analyte must be flowed over the sensor.

articleTitle: Optical nonlinearity in silicon at mid-infrared wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the wavelength dependency of third-order nonlinearity and multi-photon absorption of silicon in the spectral range from 1.6 μm to 6 μm, including the nonlinear figure of merit.

articleTitle: Defect mode lasing in metal-coated GaN grating structure at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The lasing action from a metal-coated GaN with defect grating structure was observed and the wavelength is approximately 365 nm with the quality factor of 480 at room temperature.

articleTitle: Quantum electron-hole droplets in GaAs quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present evidence from transient-absorption spectra for quantum electron-hole droplets in GaAs quantum wells. Quantum droplets have a two-particle correlation function characteristic of a liquid, but, unlikemacroscopic droplets, have quantized binding energy.

articleTitle: Difference-frequency generation of fs and ps mid-IR pulses in LiInSe2 based on Yb-fiber laser pump sources
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Difference-frequency generation between signal and idler of Yb-fiber laser synchronously-pumped femtosecond / picosecond optical parametric oscillators (OPO)s at 53/80 MHz provides maximum single pulse energies exceeding 1 nJ and continuous tuning from 5 μm to 12 μm.

articleTitle: Superradiant decay of coherent cyclotron resonance in ultrahigh-mobility two-dimensional electron gases
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the coherent dynamics of cyclotron resonance in ultrahigh-mobility two-dimensional electron gases via time-domain terahertz magneto-spectroscopy. We show that superradiant damping is the dominant decoherence mechanism at low temperatures.

articleTitle: Spontaneous emission control of InGaN/GaN pyramidal structure by localized surface plasmonic modes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: To improve poor emissions from quantum wires and dots in GaN pyramidal structure, we introduced silver film on pyramid structure. Due to the pyramidal geometry, we could successfully control the spontaneous emission of these structures.

articleTitle: Spectral diffusion of excitons in disordered GaAs quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have studied spectral diffusion of excitons in GaAs quantum wells using two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy. Localized and delocalized excitons exhibit distinct spectral diffusion characteristics. These results cannot be explained in the strong redistribution approximation.

articleTitle: Genetically optimized multi-wavelengths QCL
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a genetically optimized multi-wavelengths laser based on an aperiodic sampled grating. We show that the grating phases and amplitudes can be optimized to flatten the spectral signature allowing multi-wavelengths operation.

articleTitle: Laser sources for deep tissue multiphoton imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Deep tissue multiphoton microscopy (MPM) using solitons generated from optical fibers are reviewed. The main characteristics of the excitation source for deep tissue MPM, such as wavelength, pulse energy, and repetition rate, are discussed.

articleTitle: Below bandgap second harmonic generation in GaAs photonic crystal cavites in (111) and (001) crystal orientations
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate second harmonic generation in photonic crystal cavities in (001)- and (111)-oriented GaAs, with fundamental resonance at 1800nm, leading to second harmonic below the GaAs bandgap. Below bandgap operation minimizes linear and nonlinear absorption.

articleTitle: Effect of interface roughness scattering on performance of indirectly-pumped terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The effect of interface roughness scattering on performance of indirectly-pumped terahertz quantum cascade lasers is studied and a dual-barrier structure is proposed to improve its performance in terms of threshold current density and operating temperature.

articleTitle: Generation of tunable optical frequency combs with a high side mode suppression ratio
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new scheme of generating optical frequency combs (OFC) utilizing a single dual parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator. Gaussian-shaped OFC and flat OFC with a tunable spacing, flexible line-number and high side mode suppression ratio are generated.

articleTitle: All-optical ultrafast control of SOI waveguide elements employing localized absorption
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An on-chip technique for all-optical ultrafast control of silicon photonic elements was demonstrated by controlling transmission of SOI multimode interference-devices. Localized absorption by free carriers generated by ultraviolet pump pulses was used for achieving control.

articleTitle: Application of lattice plasmon waves in a bilayer plasmonic nanoantenna array for surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel bilayer plasmonic nanoantenna array, utilizing lattice plasmon waves to increase the sensitivity in SERS process. Using this nanostructure, we performed SERS measurements of proteins in a very low concentration.

articleTitle: Self-accelerating plasmonic beams having arbitrary caustic trajectories
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate, numerically and experimentally, the generation of self-accelerating surface plasmon beams along arbitrary caustic curvatures by two-dimensional binary plasmonic phase masks. We examine both paraxial and non-paraxial curvatures accelerating along polynomial and exponential trajectories.

articleTitle: Generating ultra-long bound soliton sequences from a mode-locked fiber laser through intracavity spectral shaping
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Extremely long states of bound solitons consisting of up to eleven solitons have been generated from a carbon nanotube passively mode-locked fiber laser with an intracavity pulse shaper.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nanobubble theranostics: Detection and destruction of drug-resistant tumors in a single rapid procedure
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: On-demand plasmonic nanobubbles combine highly sensitive detection and guided destruction of drug-resistant tumors, minimize non-specific toxicity in a rapid theranostic procedure that converts current “macro” treatments into a cancer cell level “micro” modality.

articleTitle: Intense Photoluminescence from Er doped chalcogenide thin films fabricated by cothermal evaporation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Erbium doped chalcogenide films were fabricated by cothermal evaporation and demonstrated propagation losses and lifetimes suitable for waveguide amplifiers. The 1490nm pumped Photoluminescence yield is up to ~10x higher than the prior best film material, Er:TeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Terahertz induced transparency in single-layer graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate THz-induced transparency in two types of single-layer CVD graphene samples utilizing high-field THz pulses. The nonlinear THz transmission depends on the local conductivity of the samples and dynamically varies in the time domain.

articleTitle: Time-of-flight depth imaging at 1550 nm wavelength at kilometer-range distances using an inGaAs/InP single-photon avalanche diode detector
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a photon-counting depth imager with sub-centimeter resolution of low-signature targets at kilometer range. The system exploited a Peltier-cooled InGaAs/InP single-photon detector module and a 1550 nm wavelength pulsed laser with sub-milliwatt average powers.

articleTitle: Quantized surface-plasmon-polariton excitation and propagation on graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A quantum-mechanical description of the excitation of surface-plasmon polaritons (SPPs) on graphene is presented, as well as photon to quantized SPP state transfer and decoherence. The tunability of graphene allows for the control of quantized SPPs.

articleTitle: Decontamination of medical device surface using ultrashort pulsed laser irradiation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel approach for non-contact, rapid and chemical-free decontamination of medical device surfaces using near-infrared ultrashort (nano- to femtosecond) pulse lasers. A proof-of-principal experimental platform is validated through multivariable comparison studies.

articleTitle: Third harmonic generation in polycrystalline anatase titanium dioxide nanowaveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate third-harmonic generation in polycrystalline anatase titanium dioxide nano-waveguides, using ultrashort optical pulses centered around 1550 nm. Phase matching is achieved using higher order optical modes at the third harmonic wavelength.

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics of a bismuth thin film accelerated via intense terahertz field
