abstract: We show that two independent mechanical oscillators, placed ~3.2km apart, and separated in frequency by ~80kHz, can be locked in a master-slave configuration, using light. This scheme can be generalised for an arbitrary network configuration.

articleTitle: Quantum information processing with photons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this talk I shall present a brief overview on some recent exciting experimental progress towards scalable quantum information processing (QIP), e.g., quantum communication, quantum computation and quantum simulation, via manipulation of photonic qubits. Building on our long experience in research on multi-photon entanglement, we are working on a number of experiments in the field of QIP with particular emphasis on linear optical quantum computation and free space quantum communication. It is foreseen that with ongoing development, quantum communication over 1000 km scale and coherent quantum manipulation of up to a few tens photonic qubits shall be feasible in the next five years.

articleTitle: Scalable spatial super-resolution using entangled photons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate spatial super-resolution, performing an optical centroid measurement on 4-photon N00N states with a scalable 11-detector measurement. Our results show spatial super-resolution with exponentially better detection efficiency than any previous N00N-state experiment.

articleTitle: CW hollow core optically pumped fiber gas laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: CW lasing in the 1280–1340 nm region is demonstrated from molecular iodine gas contained in a hollow-core kagome structured photonic crystal fiber when optically pumped at 532 nm.

articleTitle: Integrated source of multiplexed photon pairs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an integrated, CMOS-compatible source of multiple and independent photon pairs at different wavelengths compatible with standard fiber communication channels and quantum memories. It operates in a self-locked mode with no external pump laser.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared supercontinuum generation in concatenated fluoride and chalcogenide glass fibers covering more than three octaves
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Supercontinuum is generated in concatenated ZBLAN and As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> fibers. Initially, a 0.9–4.1mm supercontinuum is obtained by pumping the ZBLAN fiber with a Tm laser, which then continues to broaden to 0.9–9um in As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> fiber.

articleTitle: Quantum control of molecular gas hydrodynamics
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the deposition of energy in nitrogen by a train of ultrafast pulses can be greatly enhanced or diminished using multiple pulses spaced near the molecular rotational revival or half revival period.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser nanostructuring for polarization sensitive imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate maskless, single-step fabrication of micro-waveplate array by femtosecond direct writing in the bulk of silica glass. The waveplate array enables instant measurement of the distribution of the Stokes vectors in the visible spectrum.

articleTitle: Dynamics and design trade-offs in CW-pumped singly-resonant optical parametric oscillator based combs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyze frequency comb generation in CW-pumped singly-resonant optical parametric oscillators using cascaded second-order nonlinearities. We explain experimental results, trade-offs and current limits on performance, and examine scaling towards broader bandwidths in the future.

articleTitle: Spatially multiplexed fiber-optic microscopy for simultaneous imaging of multiple brain regions
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatially multiplexed fiber-optic imager is experimentally demonstrated. Our system utilizes a trifurcated fiber bundles for real-time brain imaging in 3 different areas.

articleTitle: Optimal signal constellation design for ultra-high-speed optical transport in the presence of phase noise
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optimal signal constellation design algorithm suitable for the phase noise channels is proposed, in which the cumulative log-likelihood-function is used as the optimization criterion. The signal constellations obtained by this algorithm significantly outperform conventional QAM.

articleTitle: Low-temperature Raman G-mode of plasmonic-graphene hybrid platform
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The unusual properties of Raman G-mode of plasmonic-graphene hybrid platform has been studied at varying temperatures, which provides important evidences to understand the optoelectronic characteristics of the hybrid platform.

articleTitle: Template fabricated plasmonic nanoholes on analyte-sensitive substrates for vapor sensing
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Template-stripping is used to produce plasmonic nanoholes on chemically-patterned substrates for real-time, multiplex vapor sensing. The open-hole geometry allows simultaneous response from both sides of the chip during exposure to <;10 ppm ethanol in nitrogen.

articleTitle: Guidelines for efficient direct ablation of dielectrics with single femtosecond pulses down to 7 fs
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated that the measurement of the laser-induced ablation threshold and the fluence for maximum ablation efficiency, are only required to qualify the outcomes of laser ablation in an extended range of applied fluence.

articleTitle: A time-bin qubit entangler based on photon switching
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: I present a simple scheme for entangling two independent time-bin qubits using quantum interference at a high-speed 2×2 optical switch. Non-classical two photon interference fringes were observed experimentally by using the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Quarter-laser-cycle oscillations in attosecond transient absorption for robust delay zero calibration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated quarter-laser-cycle oscillations in the transient absorption signal of attosecond pulse trains and infrared pulses interacting in helium. We discuss their physical origin and show their usefulness for experimental delay-zero calibration in attosecond science.

articleTitle: Flat-top pulse generation with pulse width continuously tunable using bandpass filter in mode locking fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 10 GHz Flat-top pulse with pulse width continuously and periodically tunable using bandpass filt is generated in active-mode-locking combined nonlinear-polarization-rotation fiber laser. The SMSR is 65 dB and the timing jitter is 92 fs.

articleTitle: Terahertz reflectometry of multi-layered paint thicknesses and estimation of particle sizes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A terahertz reflectometer was designed and utilized for measuring paint panels comprised of layers of paint, primer and overcoat. Particle size of the paint additives were estimated by contour plot derived from 3D surface map.

articleTitle: Single-shot, high dynamic and long temporal range measurement of 4-fs pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-shot Self-Referenced Spectral Interferometry method, with 40-dB dynamic range, was implemented for complete temporal characterization of 4-fs, 1.9-mJ pulses. The experimental results are in excellent agreement with pulse reconstruction from streaking with isolated attosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Direct counterfactual communication with single photons
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a single photon source, we experimentally demonstrate counterfactual communication and successfully transfer a monochrome bitmap from one location to another by employing a nested version of the quantum Zeno effect.

articleTitle: Visible short pulse generation in waterproof fluoro-aluminate glass fibers using graphene thin film
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have successfully generated a Q-switched short pulse in a Pr-doped waterproof fluoro-aluminate glass fiber using a single layer graphene as a saturable absorber. The laser pulse duration was observed to be 17.6 ns.

articleTitle: Quantum teleportation from a telecom-wavelength photon to a solid-state quantum memory
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum teleportation [1] is a cornerstone of quantum information science due to its essential role in several important tasks such as the long-distance transmission of quantum information using quantum repeaters [2–4]. In this context, a challenge of paramount importance is the distribution of entanglement between remote nodes, and to use this entanglement as a resource for long-distance light-to-matter quantum teleportation. We report on the demonstration of quantum teleportation of the polarization state of a telecom-wavelength photon onto the state of a solid-state quantum memory. Entanglement is established between a rare-earth-ion doped crystal storing a single photon that is polarization-entangled with a flying telecom-wavelength photon [5, 6]. The latter is jointly measured, using highly efficient superconducting WSi nanowire single-photon detectors [7], with another flying qubit carrying the polarization state to be teleported, which heralds the teleportation. The fidelity of the polarization state of the photon retrieved from the memory is shown to be greater than the maximum fidelity achievable without entanglement, even when the combined distances travelled by the two flying qubits is 25 km of standard optical fibre. This light-to-matter teleportation channel paves the way towards long-distance implementations of quantum networks with solid-state quantum memories.

articleTitle: Relative intensity noise of Raman solitons: which one is more noisy?
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally study the relative intensity noise of Raman solitons and find that earlier ejected Raman soliton exhibits lower noise. We also observe the bound soliton pair existing in a large range of excitation power.

articleTitle: Ultra high sensitivity and precise solute positioning by tailoring surface wettability
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Hydrophobic and oleophobic surfaces have been used to deliver molecules and nanoparticles in given 2D arrays with spatial control. Effectiveness in sensing and assembly processes is shown, reaching ultra low sensitivity (aM) and precise positioning of colloidal nanocrystals.

articleTitle: 4-fold increase of the mode instability threshold in an Ybdoped multi-core fiber amplifier emitting 536 W
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The scaling of the average output power of a single fiber laser emitting diffraction-limited beam-quality is limited by the onset of mode instabilities. The combination of several emitters working below their mode instability threshold is an efficient way around this challenge. In this contribution a robust and compact setup is presented, which employs a multicore fiber with four signal cores. An average output power of 536 W has been extracted, which constitutes a fourfold higher power than possible from a single-core emission of the same fiber, hence, the mode instability threshold of the system scales linearly with the number of cores.

articleTitle: Photoacoustic microscopy: Current situation and new ultrasonic detectors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the need for new ultrasonic detectors in photoacoustic microscopy and report on the development of a cover-slip type, optically transparent, all-optical ultrasonic detector based on a polymeric micro-ring resonator for various photoacoustic applications.

articleTitle: Mid-IR photothermal spectroscopy with an integrated fiber probe laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first compact, all-fiber probe laser system for mid-IR photothermal spectroscopy. Images of the vibrational CH bands of a liquid crystal sample with high contrast are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Waveguiding in polycrystalline GaP grown on SiO2 by molecular beam deposition
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Loss measurements at a wavelength of 632 nm are presented for optical waveguides fabricated in polycrystalline GaP grown directly on SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Devices fabricated in poly-GaP on diamond are also shown.

articleTitle: Approximating the concentration of lipids on the surface of virus-like particles through plasmon coupling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The superior optical properties of gold nanoparticles were used to estimate the concentration of two crucial lipids on virus surface. This is a novel high-throughput and rapid surface characterization approach for viruses in low-concentration samples.

articleTitle: Spatially separated non-linear pulse compression
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the coherent combination of two solid-core fibers, which are used for nonlinear spectral broadening followed by temporal recompression. 320 fs input pulses coming from a fiber CPA system are split up and independently broadened in the two spatially separated fibers, hence, limitations of individual fibers are lifted. After recombination and compression, sub-30fs pulses were achieved at a combination efficiency of 78%. This scheme has the potential to advance high energy pulse compression.

articleTitle: SiC photoconductive antenna for intense THz generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate terahertz (THz) radiation from 6H- and 4H-SiC photoconductive (PC) antennas excited at 400 and 800 nm wavelengths. We demonstrate that 6H-SiC large aperture PC antennas have the potential to generate sub-MV/cm THz fields.

articleTitle: 464 MHz repetition rate erbium doped soliton fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an Er:fiber ring laser operated at the fundamental repetition rate of 464MHz. The output power is 115mW under the pump power of 1.65W. The pulse width is 123fs.

articleTitle: A quasi-directional emission of MeV neutrals from a dense cluster nano plasma
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nanoclusters are strongly ionised at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup> Wcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> to generate even MeV ions. In a dense cluster ensemble a near 100% charge reduction of the ions to form fast neutrals is demonstrated. Neutrals atom emission is quasi-directional and neutralisation is more effective along the laser polarization.

articleTitle: Terahertz near-field phase contrast imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a method, permitting the observation of dielectric loading of hydrocarbons into a porous coordination polymer nanocrystal (PCP), by spatially resolving the phase difference between the near-field responses of two terahertz resonators.

articleTitle: Effect of seed linewidth on few-moded fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Suppression of detrimental modal interference effects within a cladding-pumped multimode thulium fiber amplifier is achieved using variable bandwidth seed source. The amplifier produced pulse energies of 1.1mJ and peak powers over 20kW at 1956nm.

articleTitle: Multilayer platform for low-power/passive configurable photonic device
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the possibility of forming ultra-compact, field-configurable, and low-power resonance-based passive integrated photonic structures based on charge accumulation in a high-quality multilayer material platform comprising Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Si layers prepared through direct bonding of SOI wafers.

articleTitle: Photonic hyper-crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new “universality class” of artificial optical media - photonic hypercrystals. These hyperbolic metamaterials with periodic spatial variation of dielectric permittivity on subwavelength scale, combine the features of optical metamaterials and photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Analysis of 50 Gbaud homodyne coherent receivers relying on line-coding and injection locking in lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a numerical analysis of 50 Gbaud coherent detection enabled by injection locked lasers and line coding. The impact of the slave laser properties and line coding techniques on the receiver performance is highlighted.

articleTitle: Single-photon imagers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photon counting has become a key technology in imaging science for biomedicine, physics, and engineering. This tutorial will review the first 10 years of CMOS single-photon image sensor history and give a perspective for the future.

articleTitle: Fluorescence lifetime imaging for biomedicine
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: I will review our development and application of fluorescence lifetime imaging implemented in microscopy, tomography and endoscopy to provide molecular readouts across the scales from super-resolved microscopy through imaging of disease models to clinical applications.

articleTitle: Over 50 W 589 nm single frequency laser by frequency doubling of single Raman fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 300 W CW linearly-polarized 1120 nm laser is achieved with an integrated Yb-Raman fiber amplifier. 86 W 1178 nm single frequency Raman fiber amplifier is generated and frequency doubled to 589 nm with power up to 52.7 W.

articleTitle: Colorless self-seeded fiber cavity laser transmitter for WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Colorless, self-seeded km-long fiber cavity RSOA lasers embedded in an access network are investigated for the optimum operation conditions. Theoretical predictions on the proper configuration and the impact of dispersion are supported by experiments.

articleTitle: OAM stability in fiber due to angular momentum conservation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that degenerate, higher order (|L|>1) OAM modes resist polcon-like perturbations, with coupling efficiencies at least 10dB less than that of SMF. We attribute this stability to the large angular momenta of these modes.

articleTitle: Tunable and near-fourier-limited few-cycle mid-IR pulses via an adiabatically chirped difference frequency grating
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A μJ-level source of few-cycle, mid-IR pulses tunable over 2–4 microns is demonstrated based on adiabatic difference frequency generation. This opens up the possibility for single-cycle mid-IR pulses controllable by a near-IR phase shaper.

articleTitle: Avalanche photodiode (APD)-based PAM-16 4 Gb/s LEDPOF link
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of an APD-based receiver in a PAM-16 4 Gb/s LED-POF link is shown to provide 10 dB greater link power budget over a PIN photodiode link. Error-free transmission is achieved over 25m SI-POF.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable mid-infrared metamaterials based on strong light-matter coupling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an actively tunable mid-infrared metamaterial operating in the strong light-matter coupling regime. We can tune the upper polariton branch continuously over 8% of the center frequency by applying 5 V.

articleTitle: Propagation of intense femtosecond laser pulse in water and acoustic waves generation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Propagation of femtosecond pulses at 800 and 400 nm is studied in water. Acoustic signals generated with MW to TW laser power are characterized, showing a directed and broadband emission in the band 0-20 MHz.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal microring resonator based sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Experimental studies on the chemical detection sensitivity of high surface area photonic crystal microring resonators are presented. We report a detection sensitivity of ∼170nm/RIU for slow-light resonance modes close to the band edge.

articleTitle: Direct observation of electromagnetic near field in silicon nanophotonics devices using scanning thermal microscopy (SThM) technique
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe directly for the first time optical near field in silicon nanophotonics devices with nanoscale resolution using near field scanning thermal microscopy and demonstrated its advantage over the NSOM technique.

articleTitle: Stability characterization of an optical injection phase locked loop for optical frequency transfer applications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose an optical injection phase locked loop (OIPLL) as a high-gain amplifier for precise frequency transfer via optical fibers. The suitability of this approach for international optical clock comparison is evaluated.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave two-pump fiber optical parametric amplifier with 60 dB Gain
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have obtained record gain of 60 dB with a continuous-wave two-pump fiber optical parametric amplifier, over a 5.5-nm bandwidth. We used a 500-m long fiber, and 1.5 W of pump power.

articleTitle: Dispersion measurement and compensation using optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A dispersion spectrum in a 3.2 Tbit/s waveform generation was controlled / compensated by a 200 GHz optical frequency comb synthesizer and optical frequency comb analyzer simultaneously.

articleTitle: Ultra-short wavelength operation of a two-micron thulium fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The short wavelength limit of a thulium fiber laser is investigated. Wavelength tuning from 1720 nm to 1660 nm was demonstrated and fixed wavelength operation up to 12.6 W at 1726 nm with slope efficiency of 67% was achieved.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of orbital-angular-momentum demultiplexing using an optical FFT in the spatial domain
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate orbital angular momentum modes separation using a geometrical transform-based mode sorter combined with a spatial Fast Fourier Transform. The observed crosstalk between the adjacent modes is <−11.8 dB. A lower crosstalk of <−18.6 dB is anticipated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Terahertz Field Induced Second Harmonic coherent detection scheme based on a biased nonlinear micro-slit
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated coherent Terahertz characterization based on Terahertz Field Induced Second Harmonic effect in few microns thick Silica (SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) samples that can be easily operated with 10–100 V sources. Our sample is an infinitely long 30 µm slit written in gold. The underlying idea of our work is that of exploiting the large breakdown voltage and the high nonlinearity of glass to achieve a large signal to noise ratio detection with a very weak optical probe at moderate bias fields, thus drastically reducing the electrodes gap. Our results pave the way to a novel approach towards broadband THz detection.

articleTitle: High temperature athermal colorless laser for low-cost backhaul networks
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe the performance of an optimized high-temperature DS-DBR laser used as an uncooled WDM source. Constant wavelength output with less than 6GHz error without mode-hopping is shown for C-band channels from 70-90 °C.

articleTitle: Circuit theory of optical antenna shedding light on fundamental limit of rate enhancement
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A circuit model of a single-element linear optical antenna is presented. It agrees well with FDTD simulations and predicts spreading resistance will ultimately limit the maximum rate enhancement an efficient antenna can achieve to ∼10,000.

articleTitle: High-speed ultrawideband compressed sensing of sparse radio frequency signals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using chirp processing of ultrafast laser pulses to perform pseudorandom measurements for compressed sensing, we successfully reconstruct multi-tone sparse-frequency microwave signals with an effective sampling rate well beyond the electronic limit.

articleTitle: Experimentally controlling the quantum spectrum generated by a silicon nanophotonic chip
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: To demonstrate control over the quantum spectrum of light, we tune the joint spectral intensity of photon pairs generated at telecommunications wavelengths using a low-power diode-pumped compact CMOS-compatible silicon chip at room temperature.

articleTitle: Thulium assisted parametric conversion from near to short wave infrared
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an all-fiber continuous wave source, tunable between 1935–1980nm, based on parametric conversion combined with thulium amplification. More than 150mW of power and 30dB optical signal-to-noise ratio is obtained over the entire range.

articleTitle: Recirculating frequency shifting based photonic-assisted broadband instantaneous radio-frequency measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By trapping the RF signal within the RFS loop and measuring the frequency components slice by slice, the proposed method provides a promising candidate for broadband instantaneous radio-frequency measurement with simple structure and commercial devices.

articleTitle: Power-scaling a Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:YAG thin-disk oscillator via enlarging the cavity mode in the Kerr-medium
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a purely hard-aperture Kerr-lens mode-locked Yb:YAG thin-disk oscillator delivering 230-W, 11.5-µJ, 330-fs (30 MW) in air. To our knowledge this is the highest average power achieved from KLM oscillators so far.

articleTitle: On-chip quasi-THz bandwidth microwave photonic phase shifter based on a waveguide Bragg grating on silicon
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a continuously-tunable quasi-THz RF-photonic phase shifter based on a dual-phase-shifted waveguide Bragg grating on silicon. Phase shifts up to ~90°are demonstrated over the 16-20 GHz band, constrained only by instrumentation limitations.

articleTitle: Passive digital algorithmic stabilization of optical phase
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The coherent signal processing of nonlinear wave mixing often creates interferometers that require feedback stabilization. A digital electronic optical phase stabilizer is described that avoids injecting pilot control signals and supports long-duration BER measurements.

articleTitle: Adaptive controller of two tuning phases in a microring based binary phase shift keying (BPSK) modulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The state-of-the art for control of microring based devices is tuningjust resonant phase. We introduce an extremum-seeking discrete-multitone adaptive controller, concurrently tuning both resonant phase and second coupling phase parameter optimizing microring critical coupling. OCIS codes: (230.5750) Resonators; (230.4110) Modulators; (130.3120) Integrated optics devices; Extremum-seek control

articleTitle: Method for increasing the operating distance of MEMS LIDAR beyond Brownian noise limitation
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A LIDAR based on a MEMS tunable VCSEL uses resonance tuning to increase the maximum range ten-fold. A novel demodulator reduces the peak electrical beat frequency from 52GHz to 235MHz for compatibility with standard CMOS.

articleTitle: Characterization of ultra-high repetition rate mode-locked lasers with an integrated all-optical RF spectrum analyzer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an on-chip all-optical CMOS-compatible radio frequency spectrum analyzer with a bandwidth exceeding 2.5 THz, and use it to measure the intensity power spectra of mode-locked lasers with repetition rates up to 400 GHz.

articleTitle: A 1 Gbps 105.4 GHz link with a directly modulated photonic integrated dual laser source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 1 Gbps 105.4 GHz wireless link is demonstrated by directly modulating a photonic integrated dual-laser source. A 50 m link is predicted to be able to achieve error free operation using FEC following optimisation.

articleTitle: Pulse-to-pulse spectra of a picosecond optical parametric oscillator based on chirped quasi-phase matching
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The pulse-to-pulse evolution of the spectrum emitted by a synchronously-pumped optical parametric oscillator based on chirped quasi-phase matching is measured, enabling to study the spectro-temporal dynamics upon the buildup of the oscillation.

articleTitle: Compact athermal electro-optic modulator design based on SOI off-axis microring resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work, we propose efficient electro-optic modulation using compact SOI off-axis microring resonator. We show that adding an extra off-axis inner-ring in conventional microring structure provides control to compensate thermal effects on electro-optic modulator.

articleTitle: Improved four-wave mixing with free-carrier removal in silicon coupled microring waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We improve CW wavelength conversion efficiency by 10 dB in an optical waveguide consisting of 51 directly-coupled silicon microrings, based on electronic free-carrier sweepout using two reverse-biased p-n junction diodes on each microring resonator.

articleTitle: Broadband and ultra-flat optical comb generation using an EO comb source and a programmable pulse shaper
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical frequency comb generation using an advanced electro-optic comb source, a programmable pulse shaper, and a highly nonlinear fiber is demonstrated. The generated 18 GHz comb has 2 dB power variation within a 24 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Improvement of photodiode responsivity using the InAs quantum dot family for monolithic integration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a photodiode (PD) hybrid sub-system using a 1.5°m quantum dot (QD) semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) and a QD-PD for a high-speed and high-sensitivity photoreceiver, and we characterize its responsivity.

articleTitle: Selective-area growth of III-nitride core-shell nanowalls for light-emitting and laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate selective-area growth of patterned III-nitride core-shell nanowalls with nonpolar InGaN quantum well shells over large areas. Transmission electron microscopy and photoluminescence are utilized to examine the growth morphology and emission characteristics.

articleTitle: Passive waveform amplification by self-imaging
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show experimentally undistorted, intensity amplification of optical pulse waveforms with gain from 2 to ∼20 without using active gain by recycling energy already stored in the input repetitive signal.

articleTitle: Measurements of broadband THz pulse propagation through dense fog
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, using a long-path THz-TDS system, non-distorted and non-attenuated broadband THz pulse propagation through a 137 m long path in dense fog with an optical visibility of only 5 m.

articleTitle: Silicon photonic optical coherence tomography system
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A swept-source optical coherence tomography system is realized as a silicon photonic integrated circuit comprising passive components and germanium photo detector. Experiments show uniform sensitivity over 5 mm scanning range, enabling simple imaging demonstrations.

articleTitle: CW pumped, generation of narrow linewidth non-resonant mid-IR radiations in liquid filled single capillary assisted chalcogenide optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the generation of the non-resonant radiations (<;100 GHz FWHM) ranging from near-IR to mid-IR in capillary-assisted chalcogenide optical fibers with three zero dispersion wavelengths owing to the temperature dependent phase-matching topologies.

articleTitle: CMOS integrated Silicon Photonics - does it make sense?
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: CMOS integrated Silicon Photonics offers a compact solution for a fully functional optical engine. The interdependence of optical and electrical components is discussed and arguments for a co-optimization of these components are given.

articleTitle: 3C-SiC nanobeam optomechanical crystals
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first demonstration of high-quality (Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> ~ 2.8-3.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>)3C silicon carbide photonic crystal nanobeams. With the strong optomechanical coupling (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OM</sub>/2π ~ 100 GHz/nm), we observed clear optical transduction of the thermal mechanical motion of the coupled nanobeams.

articleTitle: Generation of ultra-broadband pulses with axially-symmetric polarization based on coherent beam combining of optical vortices
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the generation of ultra-broadband optical pulses with axially-symmetric polarization, on the basis of a coherent beam combining technique. The high polarization purity (~95 %) ranging from 750 to 880 nm was obtained.

articleTitle: An on-chip partial drop wavelength selective broadcast network
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A wavelength selective 1-by-8-port optical broadcasting system is proposed and demonstrated utilizing partial drop adiabatic microring tunable filters, achieving a 92.7GHz filter bandwidth, 36.2nm Free-Spectral-Range, low power-variation (0.11dB), and aggregate excess loss of only 1.1dB.

articleTitle: Characterization techniques for aligning spatio-temporal focused ultrafast pulses
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: To optimize intensity-localization in spatio-temporally focused ultrafast beams we demonstrate spectral interferometric and spectrally-resolved knife edge scan methods to characterize lateral and angular spatial chirp. A novel dispersion scan yields the focused-pulse spectral phase.

articleTitle: A terahertz leaky-wave antenna using a parallel-plate waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A terahertz leaky-wave antenna was implemented using the TE1 mode of a parallel-plate waveguide with a plate separation of 4 mm. Peak frequencies of leaky wave radiation are shown to be consistent with predicted values.

articleTitle: Rapid melt grown germanium p-i-n photodiode wrapped around a silicon waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a compact germanium photodiode design where single crystal germanium wraps around a single mode silicon waveguide. A 32 µm long, 626 aF, p-i-n device has 0.8 A/W responsivity at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Synchronously coupled fiber lasers and sum frequency generation using graphene composites
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Graphene mode-locked and self-sychronized fiber lasers are used for sum-frequency mixing in a graphene-polymer composite.

articleTitle: Microfabricated optically-pumped magnetometers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The miniaturization of atomic devices with methods lent from microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) has enabled small, low-power high-performance sensors. Pioneered by the development of the chip-scale atomic clock, the technology has advanced to gyroscopes and optically-pumped magnetometers. At the heart of each device is a MEMS alkali vapor cell. It is integrated with micro-optical components, heaters, photodiodes, and lasers in a miniature package of less than 1cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. MEMS fabrication can open the door for low-cost fabrication in large quantities and make atomic sensors manufacturable with lithographically-defined precision.

articleTitle: High power, sub-GHz, monolithic fiber amplifier based on phase modulated laser gain competition
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: SBS suppression in monolithic, Yb-doped fiber amplifiers via phase modulated two-tone laser gain competition (LGC) is reported. The LGC between broad and narrow-linewidth (1036nm/1064nm) signals yielded pump-limited output powers of 600W at a 500MHz modulation-frequency.

articleTitle: Packet-based all optical wavelength conversion using saw-tooth pulse generated by optical pulse synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Packet-based wavelength conversion is demonstrated in cross phase modulation scheme using a saw-tooth pulse generated by an optical pulse synthesizer. Two different patterns of packets with 800 ps guard time were separated in small cross-talk.

articleTitle: A linear phase-conjugation imaging system
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An imaging system based on phase conjugation is demonstrated for application in long-working-distance imaging. A liquid crystal device is adaptively controlled using a near-field feedback to achieve the conjugation of the incident phase.

articleTitle: Efficient integration of high-purity diamond nanostructures into silicon nitride photonic circuits
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high purity diamond nanowire with implanted nitrogen-vacancy centers (NVs) is integrated into a low-loss silicon nitride photonic circuit. NV fluorescence is coupled into and collected from the waveguide system, paving the way for on-chip read out and manipulation of qubits.

articleTitle: Graphene saturable absorber power scaling laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A solution-processed graphene-film coated on a fiber-based connector is used for stable, mode-locked femtosecond-duration pulses with 16mW average output power.

articleTitle: Metasurface-on-fiber enabled orbital angular momentum modes in conventional optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate generation and propagation of an optical vortex using a metasurface fabricated directly on the cross-section of a few-mode optical fiber at visible wavelengths. The experimental results are in good agreement with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Optical thermophoresis for the manipulation and detection of biomolecules
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use thermophoresis to accumulate and quantify biomolecules under a laser-induced temperature gradient. As biomolecules accumulate at the heated region, the concentration of the molecules can be determined based on the level of accumulation.

articleTitle: Phase stabilized downlink transmission and optical down-conversion for wideband radio frequency
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel wideband radio frequency phase stabilized downlink transmission and optical domain down-conversion scheme is proposed. The achieved stability of the intermediate frequency is ∼1.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup>τ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1/2</sup> after transferring through 30km optical fiber.

articleTitle: Oxygen sensing using hollow-core fiber based phase-shift cavity ring-down spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We combine the benefits of phase-shift cavity ring-down spectroscopy and a photonic crystal fiber that acts as a sample cell. Absolute spectroscopic measurements are performed on gaseous samples (here: oxygen) of nanoliter volumes.

articleTitle: Multi-channel amplification in a 20-dB gain hybrid optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate amplification of multiple 40 Gb/s channels in a hybrid fiber optical parametric amplifier. Experimental results show that the proposed amplifier has negligible power penalties compared with traditional parametric amplifier, and reduced inter-channel crosstalk.

articleTitle: Optical activity enhanced by orbital angular momentum resonances in helically twisted PCF
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that twisted solid-core PCF develops strongly enhanced optical activity and circular dichroism in the vicinity of orbital angular momentum resonances in the cladding. It may be used as a circular polarizer.

articleTitle: Low-voltage 25 Gbps modulators based on si photonic crystal slow light waveguides
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 25 Gbps operation was obtained with extinction ratios of 2 - 4 dB for V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pp</sub> = 1.00 - 1.75 V in MZI modulator consisting of 200-μm photonic crystal slow light waveguide phase shifters.

articleTitle: Isotopic ratiometry of nitric oxide using a dual-modulation Faraday rotation spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A dual-modulation Faraday rotation spectrometer is employed for isotopic ratiometry of nitric oxide (NO) converted from nitrate/nitrite. Excellent linearity of measured NO to dissolved nitrate is demonstrated. Ratiometry of IAEA-NO-3 standards indicates ~3 % accuracy.

articleTitle: Cryogenic composite disk laser for peak and average power scaling
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate high gain producing 60 mJ, 200 ps pulses at 200 Hz from a single 4-mm ASE limited gain-cell. A scaling paradigm utilizing a monolithic array of gain cells is proposed.

articleTitle: CW backward second harmonic generation with 720 nm-period domains in a QPM adhered-ridge waveguide
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrafine domain structure (720 nm period) achieved first CW backward SHG in Mg:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-based adhered-ridge waveguide.

articleTitle: Near diffraction-Limited, 811W, single-frequency photonic crystal fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An acoustic and gain tailored Yb-doped polarization-maintaining photonic crystal fiber is used to demonstrate 811W single-frequency output power with near diffraction-limited beam quality; the highest power ever reported from a near diffraction-limited single-frequency fiber laser.

articleTitle: Gold nanoparticle coated silicon nitride chips for intracellular surface-enhanced raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy on gold-nanoparticle-decorated silicon nitride chips, we monitor the release of dextran-rhodamin molecules from capsules inside living cells. This demonstrates the feasibility of using photonic chips for intracellular sensing at visible wavelengths.

articleTitle: Power-efficient noise-insensitive optical modulation for high-sensitivity laser communications
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate power-efficient noise-insensitive optical waveform generation from directly modulated lasers combined with periodic time-frequency windowing. Real-time experiments with direct FPGA-driven lasers achieve near-theoretical communication performance at Gbit/s rates using flexible and scalable transceiver designs.

articleTitle: Picosecond thin-disk lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Short-pulse-pumped optical parametric chirped pulse amplification (OPCPA) demands powerful picosecond lasers with high average powers and high pulse energies. We report on the current picosecond thin-disk amplifiers development and their applications in research.

articleTitle: System design for Joule-class femtosecond fiber amplifiers for particle acceleration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a system architecture for high-repetition-rate Joule-class fiber lasers ideally suited for particle acceleration. The necessary power levels are achieved by using temporally and spatially separated amplification and subsequent coherent combination.

articleTitle: Double-confinement in plasmonic resonators
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new model to investigate the behavior of metallic gratings. Resonators sustaining coupled plasmonic modes are introduced as the building blocks of gratings. We show with this refined model of the unit resonator the emergence of a new and unexplored outlook of grating architectures.

articleTitle: High power continuous-wave alexandrite laser with green pump
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High power operation of a continuous-wave Alexandrite laser is reported. Output power of 2.6 W at 755 nm and tunability of 85 nm were achieved using 11 W of pump at 532 nm.

articleTitle: Lieb photonic topological insulator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that a Lieb photonic lattice of helical waveguides (without any external field) has one-way edge states that are topologically protected against backscattering as they pass through defects or around corners.

articleTitle: Nanometer-scale structuring of gold thin-films and graphene by femtosecond laser Bessel beams
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report nanometer-size patterning of various thin films by femtosecond pulsed Bessel beams. Nanoslit arrays fabricated on gold films exhibit excitation of surface plasmon polaritons. We extend the approach to single-atomic-layer systems such as graphene.

articleTitle: Analysis of dynamic properties of dispersion-tuned lasers
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We numerically investigate spectral changes due to sweep in dispersion-tuned lasers. We found that the sweep can be fast without spectral spread when the wavelength shifts to longer with anomalous dispersion and high modulation frequency.

articleTitle: High-Q optical nanocavities in bulk single-crystal diamond
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical nanocavities (racetrack resonators and photonic crystal cavities) are fabricated in bulk single-crystal diamond via angled-etching. Devices operating in the telecom band exhibited Q-factors exceeding 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>, while devices in the visible yielded Q-factors approaching 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>.

articleTitle: Inverse design of optical antennas for sub-wavelength energy delivery
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report using Inverse Electromagnetic Design to computationally optimize optical antenna shapes. Optimized antennas deliver 10% of incident power to a 50×40×10 nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> spot in a practical magnetic recording medium for Heat Assisted Magnetic Recording.

articleTitle: Third-order distortion elimination in phase-encoded analog-photonic links using a four-wave mixing comb source
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present all-optical distortion cancellation in phase-modulated analog-photonic links by combining the phase-encoded signal with lines from an optical comb generated from signal. Experimentally, we fully cancel third-order distortion increasing the link SFDR by >8.3dB.

articleTitle: Pilot-tone-aided two-stage carrier phase recovery in dual-carrier Nyquist m-QAM transmission system
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose an optically generated pilot tone aided carrier phase recovery scheme in dual-carrier Nyquist-mQAM systems. Both side channels can be compensated using one pilot, providing a high linewidth tolerance with small complexity.

articleTitle: Free-running single photon detector based on an InGaAs negative feedback avalanche photodiode with an extremely low dark count rate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate high performance operation of a single photon detection module based on an InGaAs avalanche photodiode in free-running mode. A dark count rate of 1 cps is measured for an efficiency value of 10%.

articleTitle: Broadband midinfrared comb-resolved Fourier transform spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We combine a Tm-fiber frequency comb, phase-locked doubly-resonant GaAs optical parametric oscillator, multipass cell, and Fourier transform spectrometer to measure comb-resolved spectra at wavelengths of 3.1 to 5.5 micrometers for multiple gases at trace concentrations.

articleTitle: Latching plasmonic switch with high extinction ratio
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a plasmonic latching switch (5 μm long) at 1550 nm with a 6 dB extinction ratio. It exploits the reversible formation of conducting nanofilaments in a plasmonic waveguide. It maintains its state without any power consumption.

articleTitle: Multi-octave acousto-optic spectrum analyzer for mid-infrared pulsed sources
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Demonstration of an acousto-optic filter based infrared spectrometer featuring a 5 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> resolution over more than 2 octaves (1 to 5 mm) is reported.

articleTitle: Locating fluorescence lifetimes behind turbid layers non-invasively using sparse, time-resolved inversion
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use time-resolved sensing and sparsity-based dictionary learning to recover the locations and lifetimes of fluorescent tags hidden behind a turbid layer. We experimentally demonstrate non-invasive target classification via fluorescence lifetimes.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope-offset frequency stabilization and noise analysis of a SESAM-modelocked thin disk laser
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first phase stabilization of the carrier-envelope-offset frequency of a SESAM-modelocked thin disk laser (<;120 mrad at 1 Hz-1 MHz) and measure the influence of different noise sources such as multi-transverse-mode high-power diode-pumping.

articleTitle: Ultra-broad bandwidth ultrasound detector using imprinted polymer microring resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel ultra-broad bandwidth ultrasound detector is demonstrated using imprinted polymer microring, with flat frequency response up to ~350 MHz at -3dB. A record high sub-3μm axial resolution in ultrasound/photoacoustic imaging applications is demonstrated.

articleTitle: IQ skew monitoring and alignment of optical quadrature amplitude transmitter using reconfigurable interference
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: IQ skew measurement of quadrature amplitude transmitter using reconfigurable interference is demonstrated with >20-dB dynamic range. The scheme is compatible with different modulation formats and patterns. Fast tracking scheme for large skew is discussed.

articleTitle: Optical damage performance assessment of Petawatt final optics for the Advanced Radiographic Capability
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: To predict in-vacuum optical damage performance of Advanced Radiographic Capability Petawatt final optics we have developed a ps-damage test station to measure damage density and compare results to R-on-1 tests.

articleTitle: Free space millimeter wave-coupled electro-optic high speed phase modulator based on nonlinear optical polymer in-plane waveguide structure
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report antenna-coupled electro-optic phase modulators operating at Ka-band based on in-plane polymeric waveguides using the nonlinear guest-host polymer SEO125. Design, simulation, fabrication, and experimental results are discussed.

articleTitle: Laser crystallization of silicon on lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Localized laser heating of amorphous Si deposited on LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> results in crystallization of the Si over-layer and the formation of a waveguide in the LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> substrate that supports guided modes in the visible and IR.

articleTitle: Electron energy-loss spectroscopy of surface plasmon modes in silver nanowires: Reconciling experiment and theory
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spectral shifts due to the excitation of higher-order modes occurred when an electric beam is directed near the silver nanowires. Three different theoretical approaches predict the main features of the observed spectra very well.

articleTitle: Tunable dual-wavelength ytterbium doped photonic crystal fiber laser based on a Mach-Zehnder interferometer
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tunable dual-wavelength ytterbium doped photonic crystal fiber laser based on a Mach-Zehnder interferometer is presented. The laser tunes from 1026nm to 1034nm by controlling the birefringence with a linewidth of 0.007nm and a contrast of 40dB.

articleTitle: Characterization of electrically-driven silicon photonic Mach-Zehnder switches
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new method to extract the electronic carrier-induced loss and coupling coefficients of modern thermo-optic and electro-optic silicon Mach-Zehnder interferometer based 2x2 switches (Sandia, IBM and Kotura-Oracle) from the transmission spectra.

articleTitle: Lidar velocity measurement using a GHz gated photon detector and locked but unequal optical pulse rate
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A lidar system with high tolerance to background light is described. Velocity sensitivity measurements using two different signal processing methods are compared. Sensitivity of -90 dBm is realized for up to 6.9 km/s emulated speeds.

articleTitle: Frequency-resolved optical gating with second-harmonic and sum-frequency generations
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A frequency-resolved optical gating (FROG) that simultaneously acquires two second-harmonic-generation FROG traces and a cross-correlation FROG trace is reported. This FROG allows robust and reliable characterization of two unknown pulses.

articleTitle: Nonlocal interferometry using macroscopic states and state discrimination
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A nonlocal interferometer that can violate Bell's inequality using macroscopic phase-entangled coherent states is described. An operating range of 400 km in optical fiber can be achieved using state discrimination techniques.

articleTitle: FCPA system at 2.08 µm and 7 MHz in all-PM design delivering pulses at 10 nJ and 390 fs pulse duration
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an all-PM fiber oscillator-CPA system at 2.08 μm running at 7 MHz pulse repetition rate with 10 nJ pulse energy and 390 fs pulse duration behind external compression.

articleTitle: Spectrally multiplexed solid-state memories for quantum repeaters
publicationTitle: 2014 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics (CLEO) - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental work that demonstrates frequency-multiplexed quantum state storage in solid-state quantum memories with readout on demand.
